Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Data Analyst - Join Our Innovative Team at think-cell Software




Our Story

At think-cell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.




What You Will Do

We're a Data Team that operates like a scaleup within an established company: real ownership, short decision paths, and room to shape things. No corporate bureaucracy – but the resources of a mature business. Our team is made up of experienced senior individual contributors who work independently, challenge each other constructively, and collaborate closely on solving complex problems. It is an environment with a high level of trust, autonomy, and strong opportunities to learn from experienced peers across both technical and business topics.

You don't just analyze – you drive. You proactively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, build the foundations to answer questions, and make sure stakeholders don't just receive dashboards, but know what to do with them.




Key Responsibilities:

Building and maintaining scalable data models and pipelines
Translating business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicating them in whatever format stakeholders actually need
Collaborating with teams across the company to improve data quality, transparency and accessibility
Contributing to the development of our data culture, standards, and ways of working




You will be great for this position if you have

3+ years of experience in Analytics, BI, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt
Experience with PowerBI
You guide stakeholders – not just serve them, both communication and domain wise
A proactive and ownership-driven mindset
Interest in improving processes and increasing efficiency, including through ML/LLM-based approaches




Our Values

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:

Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo.

Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.

Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value.

Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.

Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.




Why is think-cell the right place for you?

We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Boston, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 220 people, committed to innovation and excellence.

think-cell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Analytics Engineer

(€70K – €140K


Offers Equity
Offers Bonus)


Join our team as an Analytics Engineer, where you'll ensure our data is clean, accessible, and ready for analysis. As a core member of our analytics team, you’ll ensure our data infrastructure effectively supports self-service analytics, insightful reporting, and business intelligence across the organisation.

What You’ll Do 🎯


Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable, and performance-optimised data models using SQL and dbt.
Apply software engineering practices to analytics code, including version control, testing, and continuous integration.
Automate and streamline data validation, testing, and reporting processes.
Take ownership of data analysis for a designated domain, collaborating closely with Product Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to meet their analytical and reporting needs.
Proactively monitor data integrity, identify issues, and perform root cause analysis.
Maintain comprehensive data documentation and definitions for easy reference and understanding.
Train business users on utilising the data platform and data visualisation tools effectively.


What You’ll Bring 💡


2-4 years of experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, or similar role.
Experience in marketing analytics, with proficiency in SQL and Python.
Understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modelling, and performance optimization.
Knowledge of data validation, testing frameworks, and version control best practices (Git).
Familiarity with modern data stacks (dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, Dagster/Airflow) and cloud data platforms (GCP, AWS).
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, influencing data-driven decisions.


What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟


Passionate about transforming data into actionable insights.
A detail-oriented problem-solver who excels in a collaborative environment.
Eager to innovate and continuously improve data processes.


Why Almedia? 🎁


Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.
Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.


We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Data & Platform Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Willkommen.

NeXtWind betreibt und entwickelt Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, bis 2028 auf 3 GW zu wachsen. Unser Data & IT-Team baut die interne Dateninfrastruktur als Produkt: Airtable als operativer Kern, automatisierte Prozesse und AI-Use-Cases in der Pipeline. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Datenplattform — von der Architektur bis zur Adoption.

Deine Aufgaben

Datenplattform


Airtable-Architektur weiterentwickeln, pflegen und dokumentieren (Bases, Interfaces, Automations, Skripte)
Datenmodelle designen: Feldstandards, Naming Conventions, Tabellenbeziehungen — konsistent und zukunftsfähig
Schnittstellenmanagement ausbauen: Interfaces für Fachabteilungen bauen und iterieren
Automatisierte Reports aufsetzen und betreiben
Datenqualitätsprozesse definieren und gemeinsam mit den Teams einführen
AI- und Automatisierungs-Use-Cases identifizieren und mitumsetzen
Self-Service-Zugang für Fachabteilungen ausbauen


Dein Profil

Muss


Airtable: tiefes Verständnis von Bases, Interfaces, Automations und Scripting
Datenarchitektur: strukturiertes Denken in Datenmodellen, Abhängigkeiten und Standards
Sehr gutes Deutsch (Unternehmenssprache, schriftlich und mündlich)
Gutes Englisch (Teamkommunikation, externe Partner)
Eigenverantwortung: du bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch ohne Micromanagement
Kommunikationsstärke: du kannst technische Konzepte für Nicht-Techniker verständlich machen


Von Vorteil


Erfahrung mit weiteren No-Code/Low-Code-Tools (z.B. Claude, n8n, Power Automate) und API-Verwendung
Python oder andere Scripting-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Infrastrukturbranche


Warum wir?

Was dich erwartet


Kleines Team mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung
Hohe Eigenverantwortung von Tag eins
Aufbauarbeit: du gestaltest die Datenstrategie bei NeXtWind maßgeblich mit


Bringe frischen Wind in Deine Karriere.

Wenn Du Leidenschaft für erneuerbare Energien hast und die nötigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen mitbringst, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Über uns

NeXtWind ist ein innovatives Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das sich der Nutzung der Windkraft zur Schaffung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft widmet. Unser Engagement für saubere Energielösungen positioniert uns als starke Herausforderer im deutschen Windenergiesektor.

Title: Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing)
Description:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Pricing Analyst, Product Operations (Global Pricing) to join the Pricing Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As a Pricing Analyst, Product Operationswithin the Global Pricing Team, you will sit at the intersection of Product & Business. You will be responsible for analyzing and optimizing how we charge for our services—balancing customer affordability with sustainable unit economics. Your mission is to support the specification, testing, rollout & ongoing operation of pricing features (like Small Order Fees, Service Fees, and Delivery Fee ladders) and provide the insights needed to scale these globally.


Feature Impact Modeling & Forecasting: Based on your conversations with the different pricing teams in Delivery Hero, you will own the "Business Case" for new pricing product requirements. You will build predictive models to estimate the impact of proposed features (e.g., MOV adjustments, service fees) on key metrics like GPO, Conversion Rate, and Order Frequency before they hit the roadmap.
Accountability & Performance Tracking: Lead the testing efforts & rollout analysis for all new pricing features. You will hold stakeholders accountable to adopt new features and compare actual performance against the initial impact estimations, identifying "value leakage" and recommending data-backed pivots.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: Partner with Global Marketing and Regional Ops leads to translate business visions into actionable product requirements. You will refine and challenge stakeholder requests to ensure we are prioritizing high-impact initiatives which benefit the whole organisation.
Pricing Product Operations: Support the day-to-day "Product Ops" side of pricing by monitoring the health of fee structures globally, for example identifying an opportunity to change the distance-based fee increases. This also includes answering questions of the end-users of our product on a daily basis regarding best practices and how to set up a specific pricing strategy within the product.
Advanced Visualization & Tooling: Build accessible, creative, and engaging data visualizations in Tableau/BigQuery to facilitate access to insights. You will own the "Value Tracker" that aggregates incremental revenue generated by pricing features across all regions.
Data Stewardship & Governance: Own the data catalog for all Pricing dimensions, metrics, and KPIs. Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product to ensure that experiment data, fee points, and subsidies are correctly logged and scalable.


Qualifications


3+ years experience as a Product or Pricing Analyst within a fast-paced marketplace or e-commerce environment.
Mastery of BigQuery and SQL is essential with the ability to build Python-based modeling pipelines and experience with GitHub.
Strong grasp of applied statistics, specifically for A/B testing and price elasticity modeling.
Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, GPO, and Contribution Margin). You can explain why a $200 increase in a fee matters to the bottom line.
Fluent in English with the ability to translate complex data into a narrative for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing and Product.
Experience with Airflow for data pipeline management and familiarity with Google Analytics/Amplitude to track the customer checkout funnel.


Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.


Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.


Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

Title: Analytics Engineer, Marketing DSA
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As an Analytics Engineer in Marketing, you’ll design, build and maintain the business critical marketing data pipelines that teams rely on to optimize marketing performance and decision-making. Specifically, you will develop robust, future-proof pipelines that ingest, process, and monitor data from diverse external sources to ensure our teams have access to high-integrity data. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to build a deep understanding of the marketing domain while proactively identifying data-related process optimization opportunities.

As an Analytics Engineer in Marketing, you’ll design, build, and operate the marketing data pipelines that teams rely on to optimize marketing performance and decision-making.

You’ll partner closely with:


Marketing Operations Intelligence and Marketing Modelling Intelligence teams, who use this data daily for performance reporting and model-driven optimisation.
Other Analytics Engineers in Marketing, with shared ownership of the marketing data domain
A broader 40+ person Analytics Engineering Guild across Vinted, where you’ll benefit from established patterns, code reviews, reusable dbt and python components, and regular knowledge sharing.


This is an end-to-end role across BigQuery, dbt, Airflow: from raw ingestion and transformations through to trusted, well-documented datasets and domain-ready reporting.

You will report to the Manager of Data Science & Analytics, Marketing Analytics Engineering.

In this position, you’ll


Design and build scalable and reliable marketing data models in dbt/BigQuery/Looker that turn marketing operations and modelling data into Decision-ready datasets used for reporting, analysis and optimization.

Title: Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d)
Description:
kfzteile24 is Germany’s leading digital company for car parts and automotive accessories. Based in Berlin, we operate as a multichannel business comprising the successful online shops kfzteile24.de, autoteile24.de, carpardoo.fr, carpardoo.nl, and carpardoo.dk, alongside physical branches and workshops. We are Germany’s best-known brand in the online automotive aftermarket. Through expert advice, an extensive product range, and fast, reliable parts delivery, we help maintain individual mobility. Our goal now is to transform an already highly successful company into an innovative top player in one of the most exciting sectors of the German economy.

This is not a reporting role. You'll own hypotheses, challenge assumptions, and push back on gut-feel decisions with data. You'll work close to the business, close to the numbers, and close to decisions that have real commercial impact. If that sounds natural to you, read on.

What We Offer


Permanent employment contract and 30 days vacation
Possibility of home office 3 days a week
Internal and external training opportunities
Up to 50% employee discount in our branches and workshops
Various health and sport offers (e.g. Bike-Leasing, screen glasses / monitor glasses (VDU))
Additional benefits such as language courses via Babbel, company pension plan, corporate benefits


Your Responsibilities


Price Analysis & Market Intelligence You analyze price elasticities, track competitor movements, and identify demand trends. You don't just surface findings; you translate them into concrete pricing recommendations.
Performance Monitoring You measure the impact of pricing decisions in your area and actively steer based on what the data tells you. You know when a metric is moving for the right reason — and when it isn't.
Project Ownership You take smaller pricing initiatives from hypothesis to implementation independently. In larger projects, you're an active contributor.
Decision Papers You turn complex data into clear recommendations and communicate them at the right level of detail — for stakeholders who don't speak pricing, and for leadership who need to act fast.
Stakeholder Interfaces You coordinate pricing topics across Sales, Marketing, Procurement, and IT. You make pricing legible to people outside the discipline.


Your Skills


3–5 years of professional experience in an analytical pricing, revenue, or data role — ideally in e-commerce or retail
SQL is a prerequisite: You write your own queries, work with large datasets, and know what you're looking for before you start.
Tableau or Power BI: You visualize insights in a way that drives decisions
Google Sheets or Excel: You know when a pivot is enough — and when it isn't
AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT): You use them to accelerate your own analytical workflow — not as a substitute for thinking. You evaluate outputs critically, and know where AI breaks down
Critical thinking: You recognize when a number is right — and when it's lying. Especially when the data is incomplete
Languages: You communicate fluently in both German and English (minimum C1)


Nice to Have

These aren't required, but relevant experience that helps from day one:


Python or R - queries, large dataset analysis, automation
Experience with automated pricing systems or repricing tools
Background in the automotive aftermarket or spare parts industry


Apply now!

If you would like to be part of our motivated Pricing team, apply now for the position with us as Pricing Analyst - Dynamic Pricing (m/f/d) , stating your salary expectations and your earliest starting date. If you have any questions, please contact Irina Ring at +49 1520 315 4804.

Please note that we only consider applications via our online portal. Applications by post or e-mail will not be considered and deleted.

For more information on data processing, see our data protection declaration.

We are… a global food brand built for people who truly care about what they eat, even when life gets busy. From the US to Australia and across Europe, we support busy food lovers who see meals as more than a task.

We do… bring ease and inspiration into everyday eating — creating flexible, high-quality options that help people enjoy food that feels good, simply and naturally.

Our brand vision is… to make great food feel effortless and exciting every day, helping people build food habits that fit their lives.

The Role in a Nutshell

We're looking for an automation-first People Data & Systems Advisor to lead our data initiatives and serve as the architect and first point of contact of our HR tech stack. While you will support core compensation data—including benchmarking, job leveling, and EU Pay Transparency readiness—your primary focus will be on data analysis, integrity, systems integration, reporting and advanced automation.

You'll also drive the automation agenda: identifying manual processes across the employee lifecycle and re-engineering them into streamlined, AI-enabled workflows.


Serve as the go-to expert for People analytics, driving data compliance, delivering strategic analysis and quarterly People Reviews for key stakeholders, and partnering with Finance to spearhead People-related audits.
Support compensation end-to-end — salary benchmarking, range development, job leveling, and readiness for the EU Pay Transparency Directive
Lead compensation reporting — pay equity analysis, gender pay gap reporting, benchmarking, and STI/LTI program administration
Be the global owner of our HRIS and other tools — data accuracy, consolidation across tools, and support for audits and quarterly People Reviews
Drive process automation and AI adoption — auditing HR lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) and rebuilding them as automated, streamlined experiences
Bridge People and IT/Engineering — ensuring clean API integrations, provisioning workflows, and stack alignment
Build AI literacy across the People team — training others on prompting and automation shortcuts that save time


Is This You?

You're the person who spots a manual process and can't help but fix it. Numbers don't intimidate you — you use them to make the case. You've navigated compensation frameworks, equity plans, or pay equity work and actually enjoyed it. And you're excited by AI and automation, not just as buzzwords, but as tools to make people's work lives better.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

What You Bring


2–3 years of experience in data analysis and HR roles
Working knowledge of compensation frameworks and reward instruments
Experience with pay equity analysis, gender pay gap reporting, and compensation compliance
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; Power BI or Tableau a plus
Comfort managing cross-functional projects with competing stakeholder needs
Sharp communication skills — you can translate data into decisions for non-HR leadership
Fluent English
Experience with workflow automation platforms and LLM/AI productivity tools


Nice to Have

International payroll/tax exposure, startup or high-growth experience, equity incentive plans, German/Portuguese/Dutch fluency, HRIS experience (e.g., BambooHR).

Our Values


We are entrepreneurs — get things done, dare, always have a plan B.
We enjoy what we do — assume positive intent, treat problems as opportunities.
We act with integrity — radically candid, always asking why.
We are ambitious — details matter, data over opinions.
We are team players — own your work, no ego, disagree and commit.


Benefits


Vary by location

About us

At ablefy, we believe passion can turn into a career for anyone. With ablefy.io, we give coaches, consultants, creators, and entrepreneurs everything they need to build and sell digital products online — simply and efficiently. 70,000+ entrepreneurs already trust us to power their business.




Born in 2015, ablefy has grown into a true all-in-one solution — courses, memberships, payments, e-ticketing, and more. We take care of the hard stuff, so our users can focus on what truly matters: growing their business.




Today we're the #1 platform for coaches and creators in the DACH region — and we're not slowing down. That's where you come in.




Our mission; to build software that empowers everyone to start, run and grow a successful digital business - borderless, is supported by our high performance principles that are crucial to our success:

Radical Collaboration
Constructive confrontation
Adaptive execution
Collective ambition
Evolving expertise
Empathetic leadership




About the role

Data is at the core of how we build products at ablefy — not only to guide our own decisions, but also as a value we deliver to our customers. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. This includes delivering business-critical insights and reports, working on our AI-powered self-service analytics agent and the intelligence layer that powers agentic, data-driven product recommendations for our customers.




You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities and deliver end-to-end data projects. You will also stay close to customer needs and feedback to shape impactful data products — ensuring that data and AI-driven insights deliver maximum impact.




Responsibilities

Take responsibility for key analytics initiatives across the business, owning projects end-to-end and ensuring insights are translated into decisions.
Work closely with internal teams to understand business and customer workflows, challenges & goals, and translate these into meaningful analytics solutions.
Design and build customer-facing data products — from embedded dashboards and reports to AI-based self-service analytics tools and our intelligence layer — empowering internal stakeholders and our customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions more efficiently.
Collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to define and track KPIs, assess opportunities, and prioritize projects with the largest impact.
Drive experimentation and deep quantitative analysis — from A/B testing to customer behavior deep dives — to support product strategy and feature prioritization.
Contribute to the development of our data warehouse and ensure scalable, consistent metrics across the company.




Qualifications

Strong quantitative background and 3-5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst.
Proven experience with product analytics and experimentation.
Exposure to AI-driven analytics products or LLM applications (e.g. self-service analytics agents, chatbots and dashboarding tools). Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential.
Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently.
Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts.
Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics.
Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance.
Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools).
Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.




Benefits

Paid time off – 30 vacation days.
A competitive salary.
A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year.
Responsibility and trust from day one.
Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development.
A free BVG ticket.
Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores).
Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions.
A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are.




Diversity & Inclusion

At ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone!




We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you!




AI at ablefy

As an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. We believe the strongest results come from combining thoughtful technology with curious, driven people — and we’re excited to shape what’s next, together.

Title: Data Scientist / Data Analyst (w/m/d)
Description:
Wachstum braucht Freiheit.

Wir sind eine unabhängige IT-Management- und IT-Security-Beratung, die dort ansetzt, wo Digitalisierung anspruchsvoll wird: bei Informationssicherheit, IT-Services und -Betrieb, sowie organisatorischer Transformation. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern – individuell, strukturiert und mit einem klaren Blick für das Wesentliche.

Was uns antreibt ist der Anspruch, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirklich wirken. Dafür verbinden wir tiefgehende fachliche Expertise mit methodischem Know-how und einem partnerschaftlichen Beratungsansatz. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig, verantwortungsvoll und gesellschaftlich relevant – vom Mittelstand bis zu großen Organisationen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern.

Mindestens genauso wichtig wie unsere Projekte sind die Menschen bei HiSolutions. Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Bei uns arbeitest Du in engagierten Teams, mit ausgeprägtem Pioniergeist. Wir fördern fachliches Wachstum ebenso wie persönliche Entwicklung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Offenheit, Qualität und gegenseitige Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.

Freue Dich auf spannende Aufgaben.


Erhebe komplexe Datenmengen bei unseren Kunden, von vorhandenen Datenquellen (z. B. Inventar/Discovery, Lizenzdaten, Verträge, Procurement, Finance o.ä.)
Bewerte die Daten hinsichtlich Qualität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Aussagekraft und dokumentiere Datenmodelle sowie Datenflüsse
Führe Datenanalysen durch (z. B. Nutzung vs. Bereitstellung, Lizenz- und Kostenauffälligkeiten, Hersteller-/Produkt-Abhängigkeiten, Shadow IT-Indikatoren) und leite Erkenntnisse ab, die die digitale Souveränität unterstützen (z. B. Konzentrationsrisiken, Lock-in-Indikatoren, Vertrags-/Nutzungsrisiken, Datenzugänglichkeit)
Bereite Ergebnisse so auf, dass Entscheider sie verstehen: Dashboards, Reports oder Analyse-Berichte


Damit überzeugst Du uns.


Abgeschlossenes Studium sowie 1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder Datenanalyse
Gute Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse-, Reporting- und Visualisierungstools
Analytisches Verständnis, um Komplexität zu strukturieren und Zusammenhänge zu verdeutlichen, sowie hohe Eigenmotivation und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Deutsch verhandlungssicher)


Die Liste der Anforderungen ist eine Wunschliste. Bitte bewirb Dich auch dann, wenn Du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, vieles kannst Du während der Arbeit bei uns lernen.

Darüber hinaus haben wir noch viel zu bieten.


Grün unterwegs: Wir bezuschussen nicht nur Dein Jobrad, sondern auch Dein ÖPNV-Ticket, sodass die Umwelt und Dein Geldbeutel geschont wird.
In Bewegung bleiben: Wir fördern Deine Fitness-Mitgliedschaft und Deine Gesundheitsvorsorge.
Maximale Individualität: Wir ermöglichen die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Job nach Deinen Bedürfnissen, mit der Option des Mobilen Arbeitens.
Zeit für Erholung: Wir bieten Dir 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr. Nimm Dir mit nur einem Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester frei. Bei einer länger gewünschten Auszeit ermöglichen wir Dir ein Sabbatical.

Title: Business Data Partner (m/f/d)
Description:
As a Business Data Partner, you will help shape how Quantum Systems uses data to make decisions. Acting as the bridge between our business departments and the Data Platform team, you will work closely with stakeholders from Operations, Production, Engineering, Finance and Supply Chain to transform business challenges into trusted data products, strategic analytics and self-service capabilities that enable better decision-making across the company.

Your mission is to ensure that trusted data products are actively used across the organization while empowering departments to build their own reporting on top of a governed, company-wide data platform.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Business Partnership & Requirements


Evaluate, prioritize and shape analytics initiatives together with business stakeholders, balancing business priorities, technical feasibility and platform strategy to determine whether they should become strategic dashboards, certified data products or department-owned self-service reports.
Become the primary interface between business departments and the Data Platform team.
Develop a deep understanding of business processes, enterprise systems and how operational data flows through the organization.
Identify opportunities where new data products or analytics can create measurable business value.
Gather, challenge and translate business requirements into scalable data products and reporting solutions.
Facilitate the definition and governance of company-wide KPIs, business terminology and reporting standards together with business stakeholders.



Strategic Analytics & Data Products


Design, build and continuously improve strategic dashboards used across multiple business functions and executive management.
Own the business lifecycle of certified data products and shared semantic models.
Drive continuous improvement of company-wide reporting through stakeholder feedback and changing business needs.
Maintain documentation for KPIs, reporting standards and certified data products.



Business Validation & Quality Assurance


Ensure company-wide dashboards and business metrics remain accurate, trusted and aligned across departments.
Lead business validation for new dashboards, KPIs and data products before release.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.
Investigate reporting discrepancies.
Support continuous improvement of data quality through close collaboration with business and technical teams.



Data Adoption & Analytics Enablement


Promote data literacy throughout the organization.
Coach business users in Power BI, self-service analytics and data best practices.
Organize workshops, office hours and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Help define best practices for self-service analytics across the company.
Increase adoption of dashboards, certified datasets and data products.
Gather feedback from business users and continuously improve data products, dashboards and self-service capabilities.
Evaluate new Power BI and Microsoft Fabric capabilities that improve business value.



What you bring to the team:


You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics or a comparable field.
You have at least 3 years of professional experience in business analysis, business intelligence, process improvement or analytics consulting.
You enjoy working closely with business stakeholders and translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
You have experience defining KPIs, validating business logic and coordinating cross-functional projects.
You have excellent facilitation and communication skills and are comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You have experience working with Power BI or similar analytics platforms.
Basic understanding of SQL, data modeling, semantic models or Microsoft Fabric is an advantage but not required.
You are curious about technology and passionate about helping organizations become more data-driven.
You are proactive, structured and enjoy taking ownership.
You are fully comfortable communicating in English and German.



Why Quantum-Systems:


We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.
We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.



Our benefits:


Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.
Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.
Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.
Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.
Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.
Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.
Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.
Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.



About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle


Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen
Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten
Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten
Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen
Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen
Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen


Das bringst du mit


Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle
Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)
Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance
Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau
Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung
Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern
Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
Sales Analyst

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Sales Analyst within our Sales & Data Transformation team. This position falls under our Internation Vehicle Payments (IVP) line of business. and can be located in Berlin, Munich, Nuremberg, London, Birmingham, Swindon, Amsterdam, or Prague. This role is ideal for someone who is commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable working with sales, customer, and transaction data. The successful candidate should be able to go beyond numbers: they should understand what the data means, identify what is not making sense, challenge assumptions, dig into root causes, and provide clear recommendations that help improve sales performance. You will report directly to the Head of Sales Analytics, and will regularly collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Data & Transformation and leadership teams.




How We Work

As a Sales Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in our designated office location
Company-issued equipment
Formal, hands-on training




Role Responsibilities

Your responsibilities of the role will include:

Analysing sales performance across the full funnel, including lead generation, conversion, activation, sales revenue realisation, customer attrition, channel effectiveness, and sales team productivity.
Pull, organise, validate, and interpret data from data warehouse/sources to support sales analysis; work with BI to clarify logic, definitions, and data quality.
Owning weekly and monthly recurring sales reporting, ensuring reports are accurate, timely, and consistent; translate analysis into clear insights, recommendations, tactics, and actions that help improve sales performance and commercial outcomes.
Helping align metrics, data definition, reporting logic, and business interpretation across teams to ensure consistent and meaningful use of data.
Supporting forecasting, planning, building business cases, and ad-hoc analysis.




Qualifications And Skills

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect data, business context, and commercial performance across different markets, products, or business models.
Relevant experience working with sales analytics, preferably in a high-transaction industry such as payments, credit cards, fleet, telecom, banking, financial services, SaaS, or similar.
Strong business acumen, high attention to detail
Self-starter with strong ownership, curiosity, and a results-driven mindset
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis in a simple, practical, and business-oriented way
Excellent MS Excel skills are a must, intermediate SQL skills are preferred
Tableau/Power BI skills as an advantage




What We Offer

Competitive salary of €35-65K, based on experience
Paid annual leave plus bank holidays
Option to buy or sell up to 5 days of annual leave annually through the benefits enrolment window
Pension scheme
Private Medical Insurance
Access to the Gratitudes benefits platform, offering flexible discounts, supermarket savings of 4–5%, and a range of exclusive employee offers

Title: eCommerce Growth Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an eCommerce Growth Analyst to join our eCommerce Solutions team to lead data analytics and real-time tracking, ensuring the quality and stability of our rapidly growing white-label solution.




What you will do:

Performance Optimisation & Analytics: lead site performance optimisation through advanced analytics tools and data-driven insights.
Monitoring & Growth Analysis: monitor key metrics such as traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates to identify growth opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Analytics Tools & Tracking: leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and heatmaps to track, measure, and analyse website performance.
A/B Testing & CRO: implement A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) strategies to improve user engagement and conversion performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: collaborate closely with marketing, UX, and development teams to enhance user experience and overall site effectiveness.
Tag Management & Data Accuracy: ensure accurate website tracking, including the setup and management of tags in Google Tag Manager for reliable data collection.




Workplace: Germany & Remote // Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.




Who you are:

Experience & Background: 4+ years of experience in growth, product optimisation, or similar roles within B2C e-commerce or consumer digital products.
Conversion Optimisation & Experimentation: strong hands-on experience improving website and app conversion funnels through experimentation, user behaviour analysis, and data-driven decision making.
Analytics & Tools: strong hands-on experience with tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, SQL, Grafana, Hotjar, and A/B testing platforms like AB Tasty, Maxymizer, or Optimizely.
Ownership & Problem Solving: strong ownership mindset with the ability to proactively investigate root causes and drive solutions when metrics or user behaviour change unexpectedly.
Customer & Product Mindset: customer-focused and curious about user behaviour, with the ability to identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion and overall experience.
Analytical Thinking: ability to turn complex business problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable product improvements.
Collaboration & Ways of Working: comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and commercial teams.
Communication Skills: clear communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability & Impact: thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly to ambiguity, and is motivated by driving measurable business impact.




What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company




Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Benedetta, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Francesc Ferre.




For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability, scalability and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

Title: Sr. Product Analyst (m/w/x)
Description:
About Grover

Founded in 2015, Grover enables consumers and businesses across Europe to subscribe to tech devices and comprehensive technology solutions - from individual smartphones, laptops, and wearables to full corporate device setups. The company offers access to over 1,000 unique tech items on flexible and financially convenient terms. A pioneer of the circular economy, Grover refurbishes and recirculates devices to help eliminate e-waste.

To continue this incredible adventure, we are currently looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst to join our talented Product Team at our Berlin HQ (3 days per week - Tuesday-Thursday).

Reporting to the Product Director, you will act as a key strategic partner for Product, Engineering, and Design, with a specialized focus on optimizing our Acquisition and Retention domains. You will be responsible for enabling data-inspired product decisions that lift Grover’s user experience to a new level and have a considerable business impact. You foster an environment where data is leveraged effectively to shape product strategy, identify opportunities, and measure success. You do so by ensuring each team has access to the right data, delivering high-quality analyses that uncover actionable insights, and championing best practices in experimentation and data-inspired decision-making.

🎯 What You Will Contribute


Domain Expertise: Serve as the primary data partner for the Acquisition and Retention domains, uncovering insights that drive growth and long-term customer loyalty.
Advanced Experimentation: Own the end-to-end A/B testing lifecycle using our experimentation platform, Eppo, ensuring statistical reliability and continuous improvement.
Strategic Insights: Support and consult on company-wide decision-making through deep-dive product insights and behavioral analysis.
KPI Management: Contribute to defining and maintaining Grover's PIs/KPIs, ensuring they are socialized and understood by key stakeholders.
Roadmap Expansion: Drive new high-impact use cases by collaborating with Data Platform, Engineering, and Product teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


🤝 What You Bring


Analytic Power: A strong background in Product Analytics, ideally in fast-paced scale-up eCommerce and/or digital subscription environments, with a proven track record of delivering impactful insights.
Domain Versatility: Ability and excitement to work across different domains; prior experience supporting Acquisition and Retention is considered a strong plus.
Technical Stack: High proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Familiarity with Segment is a plus.
Experimentation Rigor: Proven experience designing and running A/B tests (experience with Eppo is a significant advantage) and measuring the impact of new features.
AI Adaptability: An "AI-first" mindset with an openness to using tools like Claude to fast-track reporting, enhance documentation, and optimize analytical processes.
Project Management: Strong project management skills - you can take a complex question from a vague idea to a structured, delivered insight.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for both technical and commercial stakeholders.


🚀 The Grover Way - How We Drive Success


Own It: We take ownership seriously and define what success looks like. We drive shared ownership and don't wait - we drive. We keep one another accountable and take responsibility when issues arise.
Challenge, Decide, and Commit: We engage in proactive support, active listening, and healthy conflict to reach the best outcomes. We value diverse perspectives and, once a decision is made, we commit to it fully.
Empower and Grow: We enable, trust, and coach one another toward high performance, always thinking and acting like owners. We seek growth, apply feedback, and support the development of our peers.
Respect, Transparency, and Clarity: We strive for clear, respectful, and open communication with no surprises. We simplify complex information so everyone knows the "what, why, and how".

BVG monthly discount to drive you everywhere in Berlin
Virtual or In-person Coaching Sessions with the Fürstenberg Institut
Physical health support with Urban Sports Club
Annual learning budget of 750€
15 remote business days per year to work abroad
Exclusive Grover Tech discount for you & your loved ones
Engaging, open office located in Berlin-Schöneberg with regular events

Embark on a rewarding journey with the Grover Rocketship, where your impact is felt, and together, we cultivate a more circular world. 💚

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. About This Role

As a Business Intelligence Engineer within the Customer Service Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as a data-driven decision enabler for our Customer Service Leadership Team. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization. Working with loosely defined problems, you'll transform complex data into clear, actionable narratives that anticipate leadership questions before they're asked. Your role will be pivotal in maintaining data governance standards while making insights readily accessible through efficient, self-service data solutions.

About You

You're a data storyteller who balances technical expertise with strong business acumen. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating business requirements into robust analytical frameworks. You're naturally curious, with an ability to look beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions. You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with minimal guidance while continuously improving data processes. Your communication skills are exceptional, allowing you to distill complex analyses into compelling insights for both technical and executive audiences.

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will...


Design, implement, and optimize BI solutions that effectively track KPIs and provide insights for monthly business reviews and executive reporting, ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability
Break down high-level business metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that provide actionable insights for leadership
Anticipate leadership questions and proactively develop analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs
Automate the identification of key contributing dimensions to metric variance, enabling faster root cause analysis
Develop concise, impactful data visualizations that communicate complex trends and insights effectively to executive audiences
Develop clear documentation that bridges technical implementation with business context, enabling both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand reporting methodologies
Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and actionable manner
Balance stakeholder requirements with technical constraints while maintaining a focus on long-term solutions
Serve as a data governance advocate, ensuring consistency in metrics definitions and data quality
Partner with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align reporting with strategic objectives


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications


Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
3+ years experience analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders


Preferred Qualifications


Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
Experience with process improvement initiatives that enhanced data accessibility or quality
Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews
Experience working in media, entertainment, or subscription-based businesses
Understanding of data governance principles and practices

Title: Transport Automation & Analytics Expert
Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Transport Automation & Analytics Expert who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with the Head of Global Transport, your focus will be on designing and optimising transport planning logic, analytics, reporting, and automation across all modes. In this role, you will combine your appreciation for operational insight with your capacity for strategic decision-making and process design. You will develop skills crucial to advancing a lean, centralised, and data-driven transport operation, all within a company that prizes dedication and results.

What You Will Do


Support the improvement of global transport planning logic across all transport modes, including routing principles, mode selection, service rules, allocation logic, and network assumptions.
Build scenario models and analytical tools to support decisions on cost, service, lead times, carrier mix, routing changes, service promises, contingency options, and network design.
Contribute to the analytical preparation of transport tenders, including lane strategy, bid packs, pricing comparison models, evaluation logic, award scenarios, and recommendations, working closely with operational leads and mode experts.
Develop and enhance transport dashboards, data models, KPI reporting, scalable data structures, and automation workflows using tools such as Power BI, Superset, BigQuery, Supabase, and n8n.
Identify and test practical opportunities to apply analytics, automation, and AI-enabled decision support to improve data quality, reduce manual work, strengthen operational decision-making, and deliver cost, service, and risk improvements.



What You Should Bring


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. An advanced degree or relevant thesis is desirable.
Experience or demonstrated knowledge in transport, logistics, warehousing, supply chain, data analytics, automation, or related areas, gained through professional, academic, internship, or personal projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex data, identify patterns, and translate operational requirements into practical solutions.
Experience with tools such as Power BI, Superset, BigQuery, SQL, or similar analytics and automation technologies, together with an interest in practical AI applications.
A proactive, curious, and delivery-focused mindset, with strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions and work cross-functionally with minimal supervision.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview
Leadership Interview

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

Title: (Senior) Data / Product Analyst (all identities)
Description:
What To Expect

Bring structure to complex data and shape the future of digital rehabilitation.

Caspar Health is the digital rehabilitation clinic with the vision of giving every patient access to the most effective rehabilitation treatment anywhere at any time. We provide individual, digital therapy combined with personal care from therapeutic healthcare professionals.

To elevate our data infrastructure and product analytics capabilities, we are expanding our Data Analytics! In this role, you are much more than a traditional BI analyst - you act as the central bridge between business, product, and tech teams. You turn ambiguous requests into well-defined data models, pioneer AI-supported workflows and help build our analytical foundation from the ground up.

Your Challenges


Problem Framing & Alignment: Translating ambiguous business, product, or operational requests into clear metrics, decision-ready problems and actionable recommendations
Product Analytics Foundations: Designing reusable domain models, semantic logic, data sources, and KPI definitions from scratch
Decision-Ready Dashboards: Building focused, reliable data visualisations in Tableau to support business-critical processes and decisions
AI & Workflow Automation: Designing and piloting AI-supported workflows (using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or n8n) to streamline analysis, coding and QA processes
Stakeholder Partnership: Challenging assumptions constructively while acting as a project-managing bridge between product, sales, and operations teams
Data Quality & Governance: Resolving complex analytical data, source-system and business-logic issues at their root cause within a regulated health-tech setup


Your Profile

Title: (Senior) Product Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a (Senior) Product Analyst at bunch, you'll be the first analyst dedicated to product decisions, spanning both product and ops, with direct input into what we build next.

You will:


Have real impact on the roadmap: turn product bets into testable hypotheses with PMs, design the analysis, and watch your read on the results actually change what we build
Understand our clients: dig into how fund managers and investors actually use bunch (onboarding, capital calls, reporting) and find exactly where they get stuck
Automate repeat requests: turn the questions you keep getting asked into data products PMs can answer themselves, so your time goes to the interesting problems
Work with real ownership: small analytics team, lean stack, high speed, low bureaucracy: you decide and you ship
Be a sounding board for leadership: you're who the VP of Product and VP of Engineering talk to before they commit to a decision.


About you


Experience: 2+ years in product analytics at a B2B company, ideally fintech or investing
Technical: strong SQL and dbt; bonus points for PostHog or similar event-tracking experience
Statistics: if a number's not statistically sound, you say so, even when everyone wants it to be true
Stakeholder management: you work with PMs and leadership to define the metrics that matter
Communicator: you have strong communication skills with the ability to explain insights in plain language
AI-native: you automate the repetitive parts so you can focus on the interesting insights


Our tech stack


Data warehouse: BigQuery
Transformation: dbt
Data ingestion: dlt
BI / visualization: Lightdash
Event tracking: PostHog


Workplace & Benefits


Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)
28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays
Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)
Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year
A great tech and work setup
Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains


Hiring process


Screening Interview (30 min)
Deep-Dive Interview (75 min): your track record and how you work
Case Study (45 min): a real bunch problem
Final Round (30 min): culture, growth, and strategic fit

Title: Risk Analyst B2B (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Risk Analyst – B2B (m/f/d) (unlimited, full-time)

Join our team at our location in Berlin, Verl, Amsterdam, Heerenveen, Luxembourg – flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Risk Analyst – B2B for our Risk Analytics team in the Client Underwriting Unit with a hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk assessment by mitigating risk in terms of affordability / solvency for the B2B end customer in a balanced risk decision environment.

The focus of the team lies on contributing to the definition of our risk strategy in the B2B space, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it.

In line with Riverty's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe, e. g. UK , Italy.

The Main Responsibilities Are


Lead the redesign of B2B underwriting models, including scorecards, decision engines, rule sets, and rating methodologies.
Continuous improvement of underlying data analysis and existing business processes to support our B2B product expansion in new countries.
Build harmonized multi-country credit frameworks while adapting strategies to local market dynamics, regulations, and data availability.
Establish best practices for ad-hoc & deep-dive analyses.
Partner with Data Science to build and deploy next-generation ML-based credit models for customers in the B2B space.
Enhance reporting frameworks, dashboards, and risk KPIs to support leadership decision-making.
You will work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Fraud Risk Steering, Data Science, Finance, etc.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the Functional Unit Lead for Client Underwriting.
The location is flexible, preferred locations are Germany (Berlin, Verl), Luxembourg or the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).


Qualifications

What you should bring:


Significant experience in B2B risk analytics, ideally within BNPL, lending, payments, or fintech.
Relevant experience in a credit risk management environment.
Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL / Python / R) to perform complex analytical tasks.
Experience in working in an international, agile, cross-functional environment.
You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics.
You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done.
Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus.


Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Business Intelligence (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, München und Stuttgart.

Als Consultant Business & AI Insights (m/w/d) steigst du in die Welte von KI und Analytics ein und baust erste Erfahrungen aus. Du arbeitest du im Team an kundenrelevante Lösungen mit, die einen Impact erzeugen. Lösungen, die auf Basis komplexer Daten echte Orientierung geben – von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung und dem zugehörigen Betrieb.


Beratung: Du unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen und übersetzt Anforderungen in strukturierte Lösungsansätze.
Lösungsdesign: Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team entwickelst Du Lösungdesigns für KI- und Analytics-Anwendungen, Datenpipelines und nutzerorientierte Analyticsanwendungen.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest hands-on in Kundenprojekten mit und unterstützt die Entwicklung von Prototypen sowie produktiven Daten- und KI-Lösungen.
Datenanalyse & Analytics Engineering: Du analysierst Daten, entwickelst Modelle, Algorithmen und Dashboards und machst Erkenntnisse für Kunden nutzbar.
Innovation & Zusammenarbeit: Du bringst Dich aktiv ins Team ein, arbeitest an hochwertigen Projektergebnissen mit und verfolgst neue Technologietrends und bringst Ideen ein, wie neue Ansätze in Kundenprojekten sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können.
