Erste praktische Erfahrung in KI-/ML-Projekten, Data Analytics oder Analytics Engineering sowie gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL
Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, DevOps, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Frontend-Technologien, GenAI-Frameworks oder RAG-Architekturen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, ETL, Datenplattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake sowie BI-Tools wie Power BI, Qlik, Tableau oder QuickSight
Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, analytische Ergebnisse verständlich zu kommunizieren und erfolgreich im Team zu arbeiten


Deine Chance:


Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
Work-Life-Balance durch mobiles Arbeiten, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, zum Beispiel durch diverse Zertifizierungslehrgänge im Bereich PowerBi, Teableau, Qlik und Scrum
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Business Intelligence (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, München und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Consultant Business & AI Insights (m/w/d) steigst du in die Welte von KI und Analytics ein und baust erste Erfahrungen aus. Du arbeitest du im Team an kundenrelevante Lösungen mit, die einen Impact erzeugen. Lösungen, die auf Basis komplexer Daten echte Orientierung geben – von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung und dem zugehörigen Betrieb.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Customer Care Analytics
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

In this analytics role, you will be the key analytical partner to Customer Care — the team that supports travelers when things don’t go as planned and protects trust in the GetYourGuide experience. You will work closely with Care leadership, Product, and the broader Analytics organization to ensure Care’s biggest decisions are grounded in rigorous measurement and clear trade-offs.

Care is inherently cross-domain: it spans Traveler (On-Trip), Supplier, and Partner Operations. You’ll be embedded enough to build context and influence, while staying anchored in Analytics to uphold standards, peer review, and alignment with company-wide metrics.

Your mission


Own the analytical problems that matter most for Care — define and drive the strategic Care analytics backlog and turn it into recommendations that shape priorities, policies, and investments.
Build the measurement frameworks Care relies on — create and evolve metrics, models, and dashboards that make efficiency, friction, and outcomes measurable and self-serve.
Deliver deep-dive modeling that unlocks step-change decisions — quantify drivers and trade-offs behind contacts, refunds, CSAT, and channel performance, including LTV-aware policy logic.
Be Care's analytical voice across the company for Travelers, Suppliers and Partners — turn what Care learns from travelers into insights Product, Marketing, and Operations can act on, aligned with On-Trip and Destination growth strategy.
Champion hypothesis-driven decision-making — raise the bar on rigor, evaluation, and impact measurement so Care decisions are consistently defensible and outcome-driven.


Your toolkit


5+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or a data science role
Production-grade SQL and strong working knowledge of Python (e.g., notebooks, modeling, analysis workflows).
Experience with experimentation (statistics, assumptions, and evaluation).
Strong statistical background and proficiency with advanced statistical methods (e.g. causal inference methods, difference-in-differences, regression analysis, propensity score matching)
Strong stakeholder management and the ability to operate with senior leaders in a high-context, ambiguous environment.
Proven ability to turn messy questions into structured analysis, crisp narratives, and decisions with measurable business impact.
Strong customer mindset: you understand user behavior and the “why” behind the numbers.
Excellent communication skills — you can influence without authority and align teams around shared metrics and priorities.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks).


Extras that give you an edge


Experience working in Customer Care within a marketplace.
Familiarity with ETL/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and/or big data tooling (e.g., Spark, Hive).
Experience working in agile product teams and cross-functional mission setups.
Exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic), especially for operational tooling or workflow augmentation.
Experience mentoring or managing analysts.


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern: https://greenmedical.health/de/cannabis

Du liebst es, aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und möchtest mit deinen Analysen echten Mehrwert schaffen? Dann werde unser  Data Scientist (m/w/d) und unterstütze uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Datenprozesse und datengetriebener Entscheidungen!

Deine Mission bei uns


Datenaufbereitung & Datenmodellierung: Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Datenstrukturen und -flüssen in Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, mit dem Ziel konsistenter und nutzbarer Daten.
Analyse & Visualisierung: Entwicklung von KPIs, Durchführung fundierter Analysen sowie Übersetzung von Daten in klare, entscheidungsrelevante Visualisierungen (z. B. inGrafanaoder Power BI).
Strukturierung von Fragestellungen: Eigenständige Zerlegung komplexer, offener Anforderungen in konkrete Analysen, Datenmodelle und umsetzbare Schritte.
End-to-End Umsetzung: Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Use Cases,von der initialen Fragestellung über Datenaufbereitung bis hin zu Dashboard und Interpretation.
Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.
Datenlogik & Modelle: Entwicklung, Anwendung und Validierung von Berechnungslogiken und Modellen (z. B. Performanceanalysen, Forecasts).
Weiterentwicklung der Datenlandschaft: Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen in Datenstrukturen, Tools und Prozessen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung.


Was du mitbringen solltest


Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im datenbezogenen Umfeld (z. B. Data Analytics, BI, Data Science).
Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards.
Kommunikation: Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu klären, zu hinterfragen und Ergebnisse adressatengerecht zu vermitteln.
Neugier & Weiterentwicklung: Interesse an neuen Technologien, Tools und Methoden sowie aktive Weiterentwicklung bestehender Ansätze.
Arbeitsweise: Fähigkeit, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig zu strukturieren und in umsetzbare Schritte zu übersetzensowie Fähigkeit, mit Annahmen zu arbeiten und diese iterativ zu validieren.
Ownership: Hoher Grad an Eigenverantwortung und proaktives Vorantreiben von Themen.
Problemlösung & Entscheidungsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, Probleme eigenständig einzugrenzen, Hypothesen zu entwickeln und pragmatische Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Business-Verständnis: Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an fachlichen Zusammenhängen (insbesondere Marketing und/oderOperations) sowie Fähigkeit, diese in Datenlogik zu übersetzen.


Was wir dir bieten


Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
Bike-Leasing: Nach erfolgreicher Probezeit hast du die Möglichkeit, ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike zu leasen.
Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
Sales Analyst

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Sales Analyst within our Sales & Data Transformation team. This position falls under our Internation Vehicle Payments (IVP) line of business. and can be located in Berlin, Munich, Nuremberg, London, Birmingham, Swindon, Amsterdam, or Prague. This role is ideal for someone who is commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable working with sales, customer, and transaction data. The successful candidate should be able to go beyond numbers: they should understand what the data means, identify what is not making sense, challenge assumptions, dig into root causes, and provide clear recommendations that help improve sales performance. You will report directly to the Head of Sales Analytics, and will regularly collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Data & Transformation and leadership teams.




How We Work

As a Sales Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in our designated office location
Company-issued equipment
Formal, hands-on training




Role Responsibilities

Your responsibilities of the role will include:

Analysing sales performance across the full funnel, including lead generation, conversion, activation, sales revenue realisation, customer attrition, channel effectiveness, and sales team productivity.
Pull, organise, validate, and interpret data from data warehouse/sources to support sales analysis; work with BI to clarify logic, definitions, and data quality.
Owning weekly and monthly recurring sales reporting, ensuring reports are accurate, timely, and consistent; translate analysis into clear insights, recommendations, tactics, and actions that help improve sales performance and commercial outcomes.
Helping align metrics, data definition, reporting logic, and business interpretation across teams to ensure consistent and meaningful use of data.
Supporting forecasting, planning, building business cases, and ad-hoc analysis.




Qualifications And Skills

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect data, business context, and commercial performance across different markets, products, or business models.
Relevant experience working with sales analytics, preferably in a high-transaction industry such as payments, credit cards, fleet, telecom, banking, financial services, SaaS, or similar.
Strong business acumen, high attention to detail
Self-starter with strong ownership, curiosity, and a results-driven mindset
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis in a simple, practical, and business-oriented way
Excellent MS Excel skills are a must, intermediate SQL skills are preferred
Tableau/Power BI skills as an advantage




What We Offer

Competitive salary of €35-65K, based on experience
Paid annual leave plus bank holidays
Option to buy or sell up to 5 days of annual leave annually through the benefits enrolment window
Pension scheme
Private Medical Insurance
Access to the Gratitudes benefits platform, offering flexible discounts, supermarket savings of 4–5%, and a range of exclusive employee offers
Free access to LinkedIn Learning, with thousands of courses to support ongoing professional and personal development




About Corpay

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.

At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. Description:
Data Allrounder (m/w/d) Fokus GH App

Als führender Getränkefacheinzelhändler in Deutschland begeistern wir mit einer umfangreichen Sortimentsauswahl von 11.400 Artikeln und einem Einkaufserlebnis mit regionalem Bezug. Wir treiben innovative Themen voran, um den Einkauf noch nachhaltiger und einzigartiger zu gestalten und ermöglichen unseren Kunden mit immer neuen Konzepten unser Warensortiment zu entdecken.




In unserer IT-Abteilung bündeln wir sämtliche Fäden für die digitale Transformation bei Getränke Hoffmann.

Unsere Teams sind spezialisiert auf POS-Systeme, Data Engineering & Analytics, Data Science, Softwareentwicklung, Netzwerke und Administration, IT-Sicherheit, ERP und IT-Projektmanagement.

Unsere Mission ist es, Getränke Hoffmann zu einem datengetriebenen, digitalen Handelsunternehmen zu entwickeln, das für jede kommende Herausforderung bereit ist!




Deine Aufgaben:

Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenmodellen und Datenpipelines für die Anbindung der Getränke Hoffmann App an unsere Daten Plattform
Analyse und Visualisierung von Daten zur Unterstützung von strategischen Entscheidungen
Implementierung und Pflege von Datenlösungen unter Verwendung moderner Technologien wie Snowflake
Erstellung dynamischer Berichte und Dashboards mit Power BI
Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Anforderungen zu verstehen und Lösungen zu entwickeln
Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und -konsistenz




Dein Profil:

abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Ausbildung
Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung und im Data Engineering
sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und der Arbeit mit relationalen und Cloud-basierten Datenbanken
Erfahrung mit Snowflake und Power BI ist wünschenswert
gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Teamfähigkeit sowie Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen
Interesse und idealerweise Erfahrung in der App-Entwicklung oder datengetriebenen App-Optimierung




Was dich erwartet:

Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
30 Tage Urlaub schon ab dem ersten Tag
Großzügige Sonderurlaubsregelungen
Mobiles Arbeiten (50%-Regelung)
Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit)
Sabbatical-Möglichkeit ab dem zweiten Jahr
Individuelle Weiterbildungen
Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und regelmäßige gesundheitsfördernde Maßnahmen
Bezuschussung einer Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen (Bella & Bona)
Kostenlose Snacks und Getränke
20% Mitarbeiterrabatt
Attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote dank Corporate Benefits
CityHitcher-App für Mitfahrgelegenheiten
JobRad-Fahrradleasing




Kontaktdaten:

Um dir den Lesefluss zu erleichtern, beschränken wir uns im Textverlauf auf männliche Bezeichnungen. Wir betonen ausdrücklich, dass bei uns alle Menschen - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung - gleichermaßen willkommen sind.

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
As Marketing Analyst, you will own the full marketing intelligence cycle across all 14 of our markets, from reliable web tracking and clean data collection to decision-driven dashboards, incrementality measurement, and the steering logic our growth teams rely on. Based in Berlin, you will be the person who ensures marketing decisions are grounded in accurate data, and you will help answer where the next Euro of media spend should go to maximise revenue, margin, and efficiency. This is a role with genuine scope to build the marketing analytics function and grow into senior analytics leadership as PERGOLUX expands.

PERGOLUX designs and delivers premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees and roughly €200M in revenue, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, and our marketing team combines performance marketing with rigorous data work.

What You'll Do


Own marketing tracking quality and measurement reliability across all markets, setting up and auditing GTM, GA4, ad platform pixels, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, and event taxonomy for clean, GDPR-compliant data across Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliates, and CRM.
Design, build, and automate dashboards in tools such as Looker and AI-assisted reporting workflows that explain what is happening, why, and what action to take, and own the metric definitions that make them the single source of truth.
Design and run structured incrementality tests, including geo-lift tests, holdout tests, and pre/post analyses, to measure the true marginal impact of media spend, promotions, channels, and campaigns.
Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead and Head of Marketing to define budget allocation frameworks across Google, Meta, SEO, affiliates, and email, and translate data on traffic, cohorts, funnels, and creative performance into clear growth recommendations for country managers and leadership.
Set analytics standards, documentation, and best practices, support and improve our MCP and data connector ecosystem, and challenge misleading metrics so decisions rest on sound data.


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Web Analytics, or Growth Analytics, ideally within D2C e-commerce, with hands-on knowledge of GTM, GA4, e-commerce data layers, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs, and conversion APIs.
High proficiency in SQL and experience working with cloud data warehouses and multiple marketing, CRM, and e-commerce data sources.
Solid understanding of attribution, incrementality, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and payback.
A strong statistical mindset with practical experience designing A/B tests, geo-lift tests, holdout tests, or conversion lift studies, and the communication skills to turn analytical topics into clear guidance for marketing and leadership.
Bonus: experience with AI-assisted analytics, API connectors, automated reporting, or marketing data infrastructure.


What We Offer

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary


Company pension plan
Capped overtime, fully paid


🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work with an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27


One week per year of remote workation in the EU/UK


🌟 Benefits And Lifestyle


Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)
Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products
Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting
Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats


📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin (easily accessible by public transport)

How To Apply

Ready to build the analytics backbone of a growing premium e-commerce brand? Apply through our Career Page or reach out via LinkedIn. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

Title: Fraud Business Analyst Data & Technology
Description:
Fraud Business Analyst Data & Technology (m/w/d)

DKB AG

Standort: Berlin

unbefristet

Teil- & Vollzeit möglich

ab sofort

Aufgaben


Du analysierst fachliche und technische Prozesse und übersetzt diese in umsetzbare Lösungen für Entwickler*innen und KI-Teams
Du begleitest Umsetzungsprojekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über Testing bis zur produktiven Einführung und führst selbständig Workshops durch
Du strukturierst Anforderungen, Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen und unterstützt die Integration neuer Services in einer cloudbasierten Fraud-Management-Plattform
Du bereitest nach der Implementierung Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen auf, prüfst deren Qualität, interpretierst sie und leitest daraus belastbare Erkenntnisse für verschiedene Einheiten ab
Du analysierst große und komplexe Datenmengen zur Identifikation von Betrugsmustern, Auffälligkeiten und Optimierungspotenzialen in der Cloud-basierten Fraud-Detection
Du entwickelst datenbasierte Fraud-Use-Cases, KPIs und Monitoring-Ansätze und
unterstützt die Optimierung von Regelwerken, Scoring-Ansätzen und AI-/Machine-Learning-Modellen


Profil


Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren quantitativen Studiengang bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Daten-Schwerpunkt abgeschlossen
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in Business Analyse von Prozessen sowie der Analyse, Aufbereitung, Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und Präsentation komplexer Daten - idealerweise im Finanz-, Fraud- oder Kreditkartenumfeld
Du bist routiniert, fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungsansätze, Datenflüsse und Datenmodelle zu übersetzen sowie komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln
Du kennst dich sehr gut mit SQL, Python, BI-Tools, Jira, Confluence aus und und hast ein gutes Verständnis cloudbasierter Datenarchitekturen, Datenpipelines sowie systemübergreifender Datenflüsse
Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Event Streams, Kafka, APIs und Echtzeitverarbeitung sowie ein gutes Verständnis für datengetriebene Fraud-Detection, Scoring-Logiken, Regelwerke oder Machine-Learning-Ansätze
Du zeichnest dich durch analytisches Denken, Eigeninitiative, Belastbarkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an komplexen Themen aus und sprichst sowie schreibst Deutsch und Englisch auf C1-Niveau


Die DKB steht für Vielfalt und Chancengerechtigkeit. Egal, woher du kommst, wie alt du bist, welches Geschlecht, welche Genderidentität, sexuelle Orientierung oder Religion du hast, ob mit oder ohne Behinderung - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.




What we need from you

Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.




What we offer you

An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.




Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.




If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Title: Risk Analyst B2B (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Risk Analyst – B2B (m/f/d) (unlimited, full-time)

Join our team at our location in Berlin, Verl, Amsterdam, Heerenveen, Luxembourg – flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Risk Analyst – B2B for our Risk Analytics team in the Client Underwriting Unit with a hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk assessment by mitigating risk in terms of affordability / solvency for the B2B end customer in a balanced risk decision environment.

The focus of the team lies on contributing to the definition of our risk strategy in the B2B space, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it.

In line with Riverty's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe, e. g. UK , Italy.

The Main Responsibilities Are


Lead the redesign of B2B underwriting models, including scorecards, decision engines, rule sets, and rating methodologies.
Continuous improvement of underlying data analysis and existing business processes to support our B2B product expansion in new countries.
Build harmonized multi-country credit frameworks while adapting strategies to local market dynamics, regulations, and data availability.
Establish best practices for ad-hoc & deep-dive analyses.
Partner with Data Science to build and deploy next-generation ML-based credit models for customers in the B2B space.
Enhance reporting frameworks, dashboards, and risk KPIs to support leadership decision-making.
You will work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Fraud Risk Steering, Data Science, Finance, etc.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the Functional Unit Lead for Client Underwriting.
The location is flexible, preferred locations are Germany (Berlin, Verl), Luxembourg or the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).


Qualifications

What you should bring:


Significant experience in B2B risk analytics, ideally within BNPL, lending, payments, or fintech.
Relevant experience in a credit risk management environment.
Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL / Python / R) to perform complex analytical tasks.
Experience in working in an international, agile, cross-functional environment.
You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics.
You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done.
Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus.


Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

Title: Consultant Business & AI Insights (m/w/d)
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Business Intelligence (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, München und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Consultant Business & AI Insights (m/w/d) steigst du in die Welte von KI und Analytics ein und baust erste Erfahrungen aus. Du arbeitest du im Team an kundenrelevante Lösungen mit, die einen Impact erzeugen. Lösungen, die auf Basis komplexer Daten echte Orientierung geben – von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung und dem zugehörigen Betrieb.


Beratung: Du unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen und übersetzt Anforderungen in strukturierte Lösungsansätze.
Lösungsdesign: Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team entwickelst Du Lösungdesigns für KI- und Analytics-Anwendungen, Datenpipelines und nutzerorientierte Analyticsanwendungen.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest hands-on in Kundenprojekten mit und unterstützt die Entwicklung von Prototypen sowie produktiven Daten- und KI-Lösungen.
Datenanalyse & Analytics Engineering: Du analysierst Daten, entwickelst Modelle, Algorithmen und Dashboards und machst Erkenntnisse für Kunden nutzbar.
Innovation & Zusammenarbeit: Du bringst Dich aktiv ins Team ein, arbeitest an hochwertigen Projektergebnissen mit und verfolgst neue Technologietrends und bringst Ideen ein, wie neue Ansätze in Kundenprojekten sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können.


Dein Skillset:


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Statistik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet; alternativ relevante Praxiserfahrung im KI- und Analytics-Umfeld
Erste praktische Erfahrung in KI-/ML-Projekten, Data Analytics oder Analytics Engineering sowie gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL
Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, DevOps, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Frontend-Technologien, GenAI-Frameworks oder RAG-Architekturen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, ETL, Datenplattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake sowie BI-Tools wie Power BI, Qlik, Tableau oder QuickSight
Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, analytische Ergebnisse verständlich zu kommunizieren und erfolgreich im Team zu arbeiten


Deine Chance:


Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
Work-Life-Balance durch mobiles Arbeiten, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, zum Beispiel durch diverse Zertifizierungslehrgänge im Bereich PowerBi, Teableau, Qlik und Scrum
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke


Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Title: Sr. Product Analyst (m/w/x)
Description:
About Grover

Founded in 2015, Grover enables consumers and businesses across Europe to subscribe to tech devices and comprehensive technology solutions - from individual smartphones, laptops, and wearables to full corporate device setups. The company offers access to over 1,000 unique tech items on flexible and financially convenient terms. A pioneer of the circular economy, Grover refurbishes and recirculates devices to help eliminate e-waste.

To continue this incredible adventure, we are currently looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst to join our talented Product Team at our Berlin HQ (3 days per week - Tuesday-Thursday).

Reporting to the Product Director, you will act as a key strategic partner for Product, Engineering, and Design, with a specialized focus on optimizing our Acquisition and Retention domains. You will be responsible for enabling data-inspired product decisions that lift Grover’s user experience to a new level and have a considerable business impact. You foster an environment where data is leveraged effectively to shape product strategy, identify opportunities, and measure success. You do so by ensuring each team has access to the right data, delivering high-quality analyses that uncover actionable insights, and championing best practices in experimentation and data-inspired decision-making.

🎯 What You Will Contribute


Domain Expertise: Serve as the primary data partner for the Acquisition and Retention domains, uncovering insights that drive growth and long-term customer loyalty.
Advanced Experimentation: Own the end-to-end A/B testing lifecycle using our experimentation platform, Eppo, ensuring statistical reliability and continuous improvement.
Strategic Insights: Support and consult on company-wide decision-making through deep-dive product insights and behavioral analysis.
KPI Management: Contribute to defining and maintaining Grover's PIs/KPIs, ensuring they are socialized and understood by key stakeholders.
Roadmap Expansion: Drive new high-impact use cases by collaborating with Data Platform, Engineering, and Product teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


🤝 What You Bring


Analytic Power: A strong background in Product Analytics, ideally in fast-paced scale-up eCommerce and/or digital subscription environments, with a proven track record of delivering impactful insights.
Domain Versatility: Ability and excitement to work across different domains; prior experience supporting Acquisition and Retention is considered a strong plus.
Technical Stack: High proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Familiarity with Segment is a plus.
Experimentation Rigor: Proven experience designing and running A/B tests (experience with Eppo is a significant advantage) and measuring the impact of new features.
AI Adaptability: An "AI-first" mindset with an openness to using tools like Claude to fast-track reporting, enhance documentation, and optimize analytical processes.
Project Management: Strong project management skills - you can take a complex question from a vague idea to a structured, delivered insight.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for both technical and commercial stakeholders.


🚀 The Grover Way - How We Drive Success


Own It: We take ownership seriously and define what success looks like. We drive shared ownership and don't wait - we drive. We keep one another accountable and take responsibility when issues arise.
Challenge, Decide, and Commit: We engage in proactive support, active listening, and healthy conflict to reach the best outcomes. We value diverse perspectives and, once a decision is made, we commit to it fully.
Empower and Grow: We enable, trust, and coach one another toward high performance, always thinking and acting like owners. We seek growth, apply feedback, and support the development of our peers.
Respect, Transparency, and Clarity: We strive for clear, respectful, and open communication with no surprises. We simplify complex information so everyone knows the "what, why, and how".


❤️‍🔥 What You Will Love About Us


BVG monthly discount to drive you everywhere in Berlin
Virtual or In-person Coaching Sessions with the Fürstenberg Institut
Physical health support with Urban Sports Club
Annual learning budget of 750€
15 remote business days per year to work abroad
Exclusive Grover Tech discount for you & your loved ones
Engaging, open office located in Berlin-Schöneberg with regular events
A diverse global team of 75 nationalities (and counting!) - genuinely the nicest group of colleagues who will soon become friends


Embark on a rewarding journey with the Grover Rocketship, where your impact is felt, and together, we cultivate a more circular world. 💚

Grover is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and welcome every applicant, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or background.

We are looking forward to e-meeting you! 🚀

Title: Mitarbeiter Data & Analytics - Business Intelligence (w/m/d)
Description:
Begleite KPMG bei den zukünftigen Herausforderungen unserer Kund.innen. Begeistere auch Du Dich für die Vielfalt unserer Fragestellungen - und mach gemeinsam mit uns den Unterschied. Mit Deinem Analytics Team aus dem Bereich Markets entwickelst du Datenprodukte für unterschiedliche interne Zielgruppen – immer mit dem Ziel, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst mit Daten echten Mehrwert schaffen, moderne Technologien einsetzen und unseren Go-to-Market aktiv unterstützen? Dann kannst Du Dich ab 01. Oktober 2026 hier einbringen:



Als Data Analyst in unserem internen Analytics-Teams gestaltest Du datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse auf Basis von internen KPMG-Daten und externen Datenquellen – mit Fokus auf Business Intelligence und ausgewählte KI-Use-Cases.
Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten mit SQL sowie der Entwicklung von Dashboards und Reports in Power BI. Dabei unterstützt Du insbesondere Marketing, Targeting und Sales bei der Steuerung und Optimierung ihrer Aktivitäten.
Zudem unterstützt Du die Entwicklung von KI-Use-Cases und übernimmst dabei die Schnittstelle zwischen fachlichen Anforderungen und technischer Umsetzung.
Komplexe Analysen übersetzt Du in verständliche Insights für unterschiedliche interne Stakeholder. Dabei stehst Du im engen Austausch mit den Nutzer:innen, um Anforderungen zu verstehen, Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln.
Erweiterte Analyse-Methoden, z. B. mit Python oder im Bereich Machine Learning, kannst Du bei Interesse in Use Cases wie Kundensegmentierung oder Lead Scoring einbringen und so Deine analytischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln.



Dein Profil



Analytics Professional wirst Du bei uns mit einem abgeschlossenen Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik/IT, Mathematik, Psychologie, oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
Du bringst erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence oder Marktforschung mit.
Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und einer Programmiersprache wie Python oder R und kennst Dich bereits mit BI-Tools wie Power BI, Tableau oder Qlik aus oder hast Lust, Dich schnell darin einzuarbeiten. Erste Kenntnisse in Machine Learning oder KI-Anwendungen sind ebenfalls ein Plus.
Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bereitest Ergebnisse klar und adressatengerecht auf. Zudem hast Du Freude daran, Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und stehst gerne im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.



Deine Benefits



Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.
Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Mit unserer Vielfalt an spannenden Kunden und Kundinnen sowie Fragestellungen bieten wir Dir interessante Karrieremöglichkeiten und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche.
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren.
Fort- & Weiterbildung Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Dich stetig weiter.
Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

Title: Decision Scientist, Marketing Modelling Intelligence, Marketing DSA
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, your work will have a tangible impact on the real world, empowering Vinted’s members to lead more sustainable lives. You will play a key role in shaping our product and business strategy by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Decision Scientists at Vinted are distributed across our family of domains: Strategy & Planning, Marketing, Member Lifecycle, Buyer, Seller, Pricing & Revenue, Purchase, Order, Payments, Trust & Safety, Security, Help Experience, Vinted Go OpsTech, Vinted Go Points, and Vinted Go Network, either embedded in cross-functional product teams or as part of data teams, collaborating closely with colleagues to identify opportunities, generate insights, and improve member experiences.

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Decision Scientist to join our Marketing Modelling Intelligence team to help guide high-stakes decisions across our channels and markets. As part of this team, you will maintain and improve Bayesian Media Mix Models, further develop our ROI and payback measurement, and apply statistical and econometric models to guide data-driven investment decisions and have direct impact on Vinted’s growth and ROI.

In this position, you’ll


Advance Marketing Intelligence: Co-create the development of our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and partner with experts to evolve our global ROI and payback frameworks.
Steer Investment Decisions: Act as a strategic advisor to Marketing leaders, using econometric insights and statistical modelling to guide high-stakes investments across channels and markets.
Validate Strategic Bets: Identify growth opportunities and answer critical business questions by designing rigorous tests and analysing impact using advanced statistical methods.
Scale Decision-Making: Design and deploy automated data products and self-service tools that empower the domain to make data-driven decisions independently and at scale.
Champion Data Excellence: Oversee key performance indicators and promote analytics best practices, ensuring our data culture translates directly into business results.


About You


Solid foundational experience (2–4 years) in data science, analytics, or a similar field. Experience in marketing analytics and measurement is a great benefit, but not a must.
A strategic mindset: You don't just provide data; you connect scientific findings to pragmatic business solutions that drive real-world growth.
Good communicator: You are skilled at influencing stakeholders and can present complex modelling results in a persuasive way to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong technical proficiency: Proficient in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using dbt and BI tools (like Looker or Tableau) to build scalable data products.
Strong theoretical foundation: Deep knowledge of principles behind data science, including statistical modelling and regression analysis. Experience with Bayesian statistics is a significant plus.
Educational background: A graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Math, Economics, Econometrics or a related quantitative field.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Advantage: Previous experience with Media Mix Modelling (MMM) or advanced attribution methods will be considered as advantage.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€61.200—€82.800 EUR

Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, your work will have a tangible impact on the real world, empowering Vinted’s members to lead more sustainable lives. You will play a key role in shaping our product and business strategy by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Decision Scientists at Vinted are distributed across our family of domains: Strategy & Planning, Marketing, Member Lifecycle, Buyer, Seller, Pricing & Revenue, Purchase, Order, Payments, Trust & Safety, Security, Help Experience, Vinted Go OpsTech, Vinted Go Points, and Vinted Go Network, either embedded in cross-functional product teams or as part of data teams, collaborating closely with colleagues to identify opportunities, generate insights, and improve member experiences.

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Decision Scientist to join our Marketing Modelling Intelligence team to help guide high-stakes decisions across our channels and markets. As part of this team, you will maintain and improve Bayesian Media Mix Models, further develop our ROI and payback measurement, and apply statistical and econometric models to guide data-driven investment decisions and have direct impact on Vinted’s growth and ROI.

In this position, you’ll

  • Advance Marketing Intelligence: Co-create the development of our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and partner with experts to evolve our global ROI and payback frameworks.
  • Steer Investment Decisions: Act as a strategic advisor to Marketing leaders, using econometric insights and statistical modelling to guide high-stakes investments across channels and markets.
  • Validate Strategic Bets: Identify growth opportunities and answer critical business questions by designing rigorous tests and analysing impact using advanced statistical methods.
  • Scale Decision-Making: Design and deploy automated data products and self-service tools that empower the domain to make data-driven decisions independently and at scale.
  • Champion Data Excellence: Oversee key performance indicators and promote analytics best practices, ensuring our data culture translates directly into business results.

About You

  • Solid foundational experience (2–4 years) in data science, analytics, or a similar field. Experience in marketing analytics and measurement is a great benefit, but not a must.
  • A strategic mindset: You don't just provide data; you connect scientific findings to pragmatic business solutions that drive real-world growth.
  • Good communicator: You are skilled at influencing stakeholders and can present complex modelling results in a persuasive way to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong technical proficiency: Proficient in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using dbt and BI tools (like Looker or Tableau) to build scalable data products.
  • Strong theoretical foundation: Deep knowledge of principles behind data science, including statistical modelling and regression analysis. Experience with Bayesian statistics is a significant plus.
  • Educational background: A graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Math, Economics, Econometrics or a related quantitative field.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Advantage: Previous experience with Media Mix Modelling (MMM) or advanced attribution methods will be considered as advantage.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events

  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

Title: Risk Analyst
Description:
Closing Date

2026-08-28

Job title: Risk Analyst

Location: Hybrid – Sussex area (2/3 days a week in office)

Salary: £50,000 + benefits

Help Shape the Future of Wastewater Risk and Resilience

At Southern Water, we're committed to delivering resilient wastewater services that protect our customers, communities, and the environment. We're looking for a Risk Analyst to play a pivotal role in helping us understand, prioritise, and manage risk across our wastewater assets and operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of our Asset Management function, using data-driven insight to influence investment decisions, improve operational resilience, and support the delivery of our long-term performance commitments.

Working closely with colleagues from Asset Management, Operations, Engineering and Planning, you'll help create a clear picture of risk across our wastewater business and ensure investment is targeted where it delivers the greatest value and benefit.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Asset Risk & Resilience Analyst, you will:


Analyse asset, operational, environmental, customer, and financial data to identify current and emerging risks across the wastewater network.
Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of wastewater asset risk, ensuring risks are accurately recorded, monitored, and tracked.
Support key regulatory and investment planning frameworks, including the Drainage and Wastewater Management Plan (DWMP) and PR29 submissions.
Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, and Planning teams to improve risk identification, reporting, and management practices.
Integrate reporting systems, operational intelligence, and subject matter expertise to provide a consistent and robust understanding of risk.
Produce meaningful risk reports, dashboards, and performance insights for a variety of stakeholders, including senior leadership teams.
Monitor trends and identify areas where performance may be outside agreed risk appetite levels.
Support the prioritisation of investment programmes and mitigation activities based on risk, resilience, and value.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk methodologies, reporting frameworks, and analytical processes.
Help drive better decision-making that improves customer outcomes, environmental performance, and asset resilience.


Essential

What We're Looking For


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and turn it into actionable insights.
Experience assessing, analysing, and communicating business, operational, or asset-related risks.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.
A proactive mindset with a focus on identifying opportunities for improvement and driving positive change.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively.


Desirable


Experience within the water, wastewater, utilities, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive sectors.
Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, or other data analysis and visualisation tools.
Experience using asset management, risk management, or investment planning systems.
Understanding of resilience planning, investment prioritisation, and regulatory performance frameworks.
Familiarity with wastewater asset management and operational performance reporting.


Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

"At Southern Water, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about making a positive impact and think you can bring value to our team, we’d love to hear from you—even if you don’t tick every box. Your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need."

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. The team is responsible for building technical Pricing models and monitoring the risk to support the market leading brand PetPlan as well as our growing LV pet proposition. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £41,000 to £43,000 per year. Pay is based on relevant experience, skills for the role, and location. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Previous experience working in a business environment
Experience of using data analytics tools like WTW tools (Emblem / Radar), SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA.
Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning.
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector


We support the government scheme “Access to Work” please feel free to ask us about the access to work scheme.

Desirable Skills


You embrace innovation and like challenge
You take ownership of your projects
Responsible Artificial Intelligence usage is desirable but not essential


What We Will Offer You

Recognised and rewarded for a job well done, we have a range of flexible benefits for you to choose from- so you can pick a package that’s perfect for you. We also offer flexible working options, global career opportunities across the wider Allianz Group, and fantastic career development and training. That’s on top of enjoying all the benefits you’d expect from the world’s number one insurance brand, including:


Flexible buy/sell holiday options
Hybrid working
Annual performance related bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Development days
A discount up to 50% on a range of insurance products including car, home and pet
Retail discounts
Volunteering days


Our Ways of Working

Do you need flexibility with the hours you work? Let us know as part of your application and if it’s right for our customers, our business and for you, then we’ll do everything we can to make it happen. Here at Allianz, we are signatories of the ABIs flexible working charter. We believe in supporting hybrid work patterns, which balance the needs of our customers, with your personal circumstances and our business requirements. Our aim with this is to help innovation, creativity, and you to thrive - Your work life balance is important to us.

Inclusive Support & Accessibility

At Allianz, we are committed to fostering building an inclusive, accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and offer tailored adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace, whether that’s assistive technology, ergonomic equipment, flexible working arrangements, mentoring or coaching. We want to encourage candidates to speak with us about any adjustments they may need. We’re here to support you.

If you have a disability or long‑term health condition and meet the essential criteria, you can choose to be considered through our Offer an Interview Scheme.

Contact our Resourcing team to opt into this scheme or for any assistance with during the recruitment process including larger text, hard copies, or spoken applications. Hr-recruitment@allianz.co.uk

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Kantar is the world’s leading AI-native marketing data and analytics business and an indispensable brand partner to the world’s top companies. We combine the most meaningful attitudinal and behavioural data with deep expertise and advanced analytics to uncover how people think and act. We help clients understand what has happened and why and how to shape the marketing strategies that shape their future.




Why this job is important




We’re known for our data. Help us turn it into insight that makes a real difference.




At Kantar, you’ll join a team that sits at the heart of how data becomes decisions. As a Data Analyst in our Panels Performance & Business Intelligence team, you’ll strengthen the analytical foundations that underpin our panel solutions. Working closely with colleagues across data science, engineering, technology and our Global Delivery Centres, you’ll help ensure our models are robust, scalable and genuinely useful for clients and internal teams alike.




This role is ideal if you enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical delivery – taking models from idea to production, spotting opportunities for improvement, and explaining complex findings in a way that others can act on.




What you’ll be doing

Maintaining and improving analytical models used in day-to-day panel operations
Analysing model outputs to identify performance issues and opportunities to enhance results
Working with global delivery and technology teams to support production-ready data models and BI solutions
Running statistical and exploratory analyses to uncover actionable insights
Communicating analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues







The ideal skills & experience

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a natural curiosity for data
Experience using SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python or R
A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals
Experience working with data transformation or ETL tools (DBT is a plus)
Confidence explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A collaborative mindset and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams




What’s in it for you

Flexible hybrid working (two to three days in the office)
25 days leave, 2 days paid for volunteering and life event leave
Competitive salary and bonus (bonus dependent on role)
Company pension
Enhanced parental leave
Healthcare options
Wide range of flexible benefits




Please note

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, either at the point of hire or at any point in the future. Applicants should only apply if they have the permanent right to live and work in the UK and will not require employer sponsorship during their employment.




Why join Kantar?

You’ll be joining our Profiles division, home to specialists in survey design, sampling and data science. With the world’s largest audience network (over 170 million people), we’re trusted by many of the world’s leading brands to provide amazing insights from real people.




What about Kantar itself? Well, we shape the brands of tomorrow by better understanding people everywhere. By understanding people, we can understand what drives their decisions, actions, and aspirations on a global scale. And if we combine the expertise of our people with the latest AI technology, we can really help brands discover some amazing insights.




And because we know people, we like to make sure our own people are being looked after as well. Equality of opportunity for everyone is our highest priority and we support our colleagues to work in a way works for them. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and sections of society. Even if you feel like you’re not an exact match, we’d love to receive your application and talk to you about this job or others with us.
