Description:
If you’d like to be considered for this opportunity we encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment as if applications are high the role will close before the closing date given.

Portfolio Analyst

 Location:   Aldermaston (Hybrid, by agreement with Line Manager)

Package: £39,500 - £59,350 (depending on your suitability, qualifications and level of experience) 

 Working pattern: AWE operates a 9-day working fortnight. We will consider flexible working requests so that your work may fit in with your lifestyle. Just let us know your preferred working pattern on your application. 

Turn Data into Decisions

At AWE, our P3M Digital, Data, Tools and Systems team enable informed decision-making across some of the UK's most complex projects, programmes and portfolios. We're looking for a Portfolio Analyst who is passionate about data, analytics and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to combine project, programme and portfolio delivery knowledge with modern digital tools, transforming data into meaningful insight that drives better outcomes.

What You'll Do


Build impactful dashboards and reports using digital solutions.
Analyse portfolio, programme and project data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging issues.
Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and turn data into actionable insight.
Improve reporting and management information through automation, innovation and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of P3M Digital and Data across AWE.


What We're Looking For


Strong data literacy and analytical thinking.
Experience using data and reporting tools to create meaningful visualisations and insights.
The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
Prior experience in a project or programme environment.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
A curious mindset with a passion for solving problems and improving how information is used.
An interest in coding, automation, data engineering or AI-enabled analytics.


Whilst not to be considered a tick list, we'd like you to have experience in some of the following: 


Building with tools within the Microsoft Suite (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query) and others.
Basic understanding of programming languages such as Python, SQL or DAX.
Portfolio, programme or project delivery experience.


Why Join Us?

We're looking for curious, digitally minded people who want to make an impact. Whether you're already developing data solutions or looking to grow your technical skills, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of P3M insights, reporting and analytics at AWE.

 Work hard, be rewarded:  

 We ask a lot and set the bar high because our work truly matters. In return we offer balance, with award winning benefits including:  

 


9-day working fortnight - meaning you get every other Friday off work, in addition to 270 hours of annual leave.  
Market leading contributory pension scheme (we will pay between 9% and 13% of your pensionable pay depending on your contributions). 
Family friendly policies: Maternity Leave - 39 Weeks Full Pay and Paternity Leave - 4 Weeks Full Pay. 
Opportunities for Professional Career Development including funding for annual membership of a relevant professional body. 
Employee Assistance Programme and Occupational Health Services. 
Life Assurance (4 x annual salary). 
Discounts - access to savings on a wide range of everyday spending. 
Special Leave Policy including paid time off for volunteering, public service (including reserve forces) and caring. 


 

The 'Working at AWE' page on our website is where you can find full details in the 'AWE Benefits Guide'. 

Next Steps

Everyone who works at AWE brings unique skills and perspectives to the table. We recognise that great people don’t always ‘tick every box’. That’s why we focus on your potential, your fit with our values, your transferable skills as well as your experience. Even if you don’t meet every point above, but you feel that this role and AWE are a great fit for you, please go ahead and apply, we’d love to receive your application.

Important Things You Need To Know


We encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment if applications are high and the role therefore closes.
You will need to obtain and maintain the necessary security clearance for the role. This will be funded by AWE. The nature of our work does mean you need to be a British Citizen who has been resident in the UK for the past 5 years in order to apply for SC clearance and 10 years for DV.
We want you to feel comfortable and able to shine during our recruitment process. Please let us know on your application form if you need any adjustments/accommodations during the process.
Our interviews typically take place over Teams and for most roles are a 1 stage process.


Our ambition is to create workplaces where we recognise and celebrate differences, encourage diverse contributions and our employees feel able to be themselves at work. We strive to create a genuine culture of openness and inclusion and encourage diverse applicants. Any inclusion information you provide will be stored in accordance with GDPR and kept separate from your application form and CV, and the information will not be shared with anyone involved in interviewing or making hiring decisions.

Please note that you must be a British Citizen to apply for a role with us.

Performance Analyst

Location: Basingstoke

Salary: £43,000 per annum

Full time, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8.30am – 5pm.

We provide Housing Management services right across the UK. We work in partnership with Central and Local Government, registered providers, tenants, landlords and investors to find solutions to homelessness, provide more social and affordable housing and create specialist housing for people with care needs.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly organised and analytical Performance Analyst to join our team in Basingstoke. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with strong reporting and data analysis skills who enjoys turning complex information into meaningful insights that support operational performance and business objectives.

In this role, you will be responsible for producing reports, analysing performance data, supporting client reporting requirements and responding to ad hoc information requests. You will work closely with operational teams and colleagues across the business to provide valuable insight, identify trends and support continuous improvement initiatives.

As a Performance Analyst, you will provide analysis and reporting solutions for operational teams using a range of reporting tools and systems. You will act as a key link between operational management and IT development teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into effective reporting and technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities Include


Specification and delivery of regular and ad hoc reporting to clients and senior managers
Analyse business requirements and propose effective business solutions
Support business process reviews, data management and system improvements
Act as the interface between operational teams, clients and IT developers
Produce intelligent analysis of performance indicators, trends and observations
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-led insight
Collaborate with operational teams to optimise IT support and reporting capability
Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, partners and suppliers
Support development and service desk teams with issue resolution
Undertake ad hoc projects and provide support across wider teams when required


Role Criteria


Excellent communication skills
Strong Excel skills and experience working with data and reporting tools
Proven reporting and analytical skills
Experience working within an office-based environment
Background within the property or housing sector
Ability to identify trends and provide meaningful business insight
Approach work with initiative and a proactive problem-solving mindset


Benefits We Can Offer You


25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Annual Mears Fun Day - Our annual Fun Day is organised as a massive thank you from the Executive team for all the hard work!
Volunteering Leave - Mears supports employees to undertake paid volunteering in the community, in support of our social value commitment.
Staff perks with Mears Rewards - discounts of up to 10% weekly groceries, holidays, eye test vouchers, Share save scheme, plus much more
Family friendly policies
Access to EAP Counselling sessions

You will be accountable for the support in the overview and alignment of our operational performance in networks including its year-on-year improvement in line with our upcoming AMP8 objectives.

Think the AA is just about roadside assistance? Think again.

Join Network Rail - Where People and Connections Matter

Some Of Our Great Benefits


Flexible/hybrid working arrangements considered.
Generous annual leave (28 days plus statutory days), with the option to buy/sell days.
Discounts at stations with your Network Rail pass.
Defined benefit pension scheme
75% subsidy on train tickets.
Interest-free travel loan for train and car park season tickets.
Volunteer leave to make a positive impact.


Plus more....

About The Role

What does the average day look like?

A typical day could involve working with safety, health and environmental data from a variety of sources, reviewing and validating information to identify gaps, inconsistencies and data quality issues. You will analyse trends, patterns and anomalies, transforming data into meaningful insights that help colleagues make informed decisions.

You may be responsible for developing, maintaining and quality-assuring Power BI reports and supporting datasets, as well as managing dataflows, semantic models and reporting pipelines. The role also includes responding to ad-hoc stakeholder, regulatory and Freedom of Information requests, and working closely with colleagues across the business to improve how data is captured, managed, shared and used.

Alongside analytical work, you will support continuous improvement activities, helping to strengthen data quality, streamline reporting processes and enhance the value of safety, health & environment data across the organisation.

A Little Bit About The Team...

You'll be joining the Health & Safety Systems & Analysis team, which sits within the wider Technical Authority function. The immediate team consists of five colleagues and is led by the Safety, Health & Environment Analysis Manager. The team provides independent safety, health and environment analysis, insight and reporting that supports evidence-based decision-making across Network Rail.

We are responsible for managing national safety, health and environment datasets, delivering periodic performance reporting, responding to ad-hoc and regulatory information requests, and providing technical assurance on data quality and reporting practices. The team develops and maintains data pipelines and Power BI reporting solutions, transforming complex information into trusted intelligence that enables the business to identify risks, monitor performance, drive improvement and meet regulatory obligations.

Next Steps

CV shortlisting will take place after the advert closes, with interviews planned from the week commencing 24th August, subject to business needs. Early applications are encouraged, as we may close the advert early due to high application volumes.

We encourage you to review our Safety Vision, as safety is an important part of the culture at Network Rail

All external offers of employment are conditional upon satisfactory completion of pre-employment checks. Click here for more information

Ref

Your experience and skills

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a technically capable and intellectually curious analyst who thrives on turning complex data into actionable insight. You will be highly organised, adaptable and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

The successful candidate will have experience working with complex datasets and analytical tools, delivering impactful analysis, dashboards and reporting that have influenced strategic or operational decision-making. You will be confident challenging assumptions, validating information, identifying trends and anomalies, and communicating findings in a clear and compelling way to a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leaders.

You will be comfortable working with modern reporting and business intelligence tools, using data to solve problems, support evidence-based decisions and drive continuous improvement.

Experience in Health and Safety, risk, operational performance or regulated industries would be beneficial; however, we welcome candidates from a broad range of analytical backgrounds. Above all, you will have a passion for data, a commitment to objectivity and integrity, and the ability to provide trusted insight that enables informed decision-making and organisational improvement.

Essential Criteria


Degree in a relevant subject such as statistics or business, or equivalent relevant experience
Proven experience in analytical techniques and data models
Proven experience in analytical systems, including Power BI
Previous experience of working within a reporting environment
Excellent analytical skills
Organised and strong time-management skills
Technical understanding of data reporting issues
Proven ability to accurately and concisely summarise, present and communicate information effectively and appropriately for the relative audience, both written and verbal
Confident influencing and challenging stakeholders of all levels

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
Job Title: Power BI Developer

Closing Date: 31 August 2026

About Us

At Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, our employees are at the heart of our business. Our colleagues provide a range of financial solutions designed around the changing needs of our diverse customers. It doesn’t matter the colour of your skin, the beliefs you value, the people you love or the tattoos you wear, we support you for being you.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you will find a passionate team working to support our customers and our colleagues. We ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to learn and develop.

We want to celebrate your individuality, embrace your personality and welcome you into our culture. It’s the differences of our colleagues that enable us to thrive. We believe our backgrounds, skills and cultures contribute to our shared culture and help us deliver outstanding Customer Experience. Inclusion is the driving force behind our ethos.

At MBFS, we are proud to be a Menopause Friendly Accredited Employer, reflecting our ongoing commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace. We offer wellbeing support options and resources for colleagues experiencing menopause and to those who are supporting someone through it.

How You’ll Play Your Part

In this role, you will work directly with finance stakeholders to understand reporting needs, shape requirements, build robust data models and deliver Power BI dashboards that are adopted by the business. Using data from multiple sources, you will create and enhance Power BI reports, semantic models and reusable reporting structures, ensuring outputs are accurate, trusted and well documented. You will also support the migration of legacy Cognos reporting into Power BI, drive user adoption through training and support, and mentor a Data Apprentice while sharing BI development knowledge across the Finance & Management Information community. The role combines technical depth with strong stakeholder engagement, so success will be measured not only by dashboard quality, but also by business value, usability and pace of delivery.

Main Accountabilities

Finance dashboard development and stakeholder delivery:


Partner with Finance & Controlling stakeholders to understand reporting needs and agree clear requirements, definitions and acceptance criteria.
Prioritise dashboard development based on business value, user impact and delivery feasibility.
Design, build, test and deploy Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models.
Create DAX measures, calculations, KPIs and common data elements that are accurate, reusable and well governed.
Identify and connect to appropriate data sources, including Databricks, SQL, data lake, data warehouse and Excel.
Apply data validation, reconciliation, unit testing and troubleshooting before release.
Create documentation covering data sources, model logic, measures, definitions and usage guidance.
Work with the wider Data & MI team to ensure reporting standards, governance and best practice are followed.


Head Office Dashboard Adoption And Reporting Alignment


Identify existing Head Office Power BI dashboards, data models and schemas that can support UK reporting requirements.
Promote adoption of relevant Head Office solutions to avoid duplication and support consistency across reporting outputs.
Adapt, deploy and explain Head Office reporting where appropriate for UK users.
Provide training, guidance and support to improve dashboard adoption and user confidence.


Cognos Migration And Legacy Report Modernisation


Support the decommissioning of legacy Cognos Data Warehouse reports by identifying reporting needs that should migrate to Power BI.
Rebuild, improve and optimise priority legacy reports using Power BI, modern data sources and improved reporting design.
Work with users to test migrated reports, confirm accuracy and support transition from legacy reporting.
Help reduce manual reporting effort and improve the consistency, reliability and usability of Finance MI.


Mentoring And Knowledge Sharing


Mentor and support one Data Apprentice, helping them build confidence in data, reporting and BI development.
Share Power BI knowledge and good practice with analysts and business users across the Finance & MI community.
Act as a trusted point of contact for Power BI dashboard questions, issue resolution and user guidance.


About You

Essential technical skills:


Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models.
Advanced DAX capability, including measures, calculations, KPIs, filter context and performance-aware design.
Experience creating robust data models, relationships, reusable reporting structures and business-friendly reporting layers.
Strong SQL skills for querying, validating and preparing data.
Working knowledge of Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure data lake or similar modern data platform technologies.
Advanced Excel capability, including use of Excel as a reporting input where structured data feeds are not yet available.
Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, testing, documentation and reporting governance.
Awareness of BI best practice, including performance optimisation, dashboard usability and controlled deployment.


Desirable Technical Skills


Experience with Power BI Service, workspaces, scheduled refresh, access management and deployment processes.
Knowledge of Power Query, Power Automate, Power Pivot, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.
Understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modelling and ETL or ELT frameworks.
Experience with legacy Cognos reporting is beneficial but not essential.
Experience working with finance, performance management, KPI reporting or management information is highly desirable.


Business And Behavioural Skills


Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate business questions into reporting requirements.
Ability to explain technical concepts and data insights clearly to non-technical users.
Customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to building dashboards that are useful, trusted and adopted.
Analytical, curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements or inconsistent data.
Organised and delivery focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in an agile environment.
Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to solving reporting and data issues.
Collaborative style, with a willingness to coach colleagues and support wider BI capability.


What’s in it for you?

We’ll offer you a competitive salary and discretionary bonus structure. We also hope you’ll love our products as much as we do, with access to our colleague car schemes. On top of that, you’ll be able to join our pension scheme and you’ll get a flexible benefit pot that can be used to find the benefits that are right for you.

We’re here to support you – we offer access to colleague wellbeing resources, including an Employee Assistance Programme, Mental Health First Aiders and the Inclusion Advocates as well as flexible opportunities to support work life balance. We’ll also encourage your development, with the training and knowledge you need to reach your potential.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you’ll find a passionate team working to put our customers first. We know that to keep this team motivated, we need to ensure that everyone has equal opportunity to learn and develop. We celebrate a culture of appreciation and respect, where everyone is valued for who they are. We believe our backgrounds, experiences and cultures contribute to our shared experience and shape who we are and what we do. The diversity of our colleagues reflects the diversity of our customers. This diversity is the driving force behind our ideas.

What’s next?

When you apply, you’ll be asked to complete a short online application where we’ll ask that you include your current CV. You’ll also be asked some application questions, including your current salary information. The Mercedes-Benz recruitment process reflects our obligations under relevant UK legislation. Whilst all applications are carefully considered, we are only able to progress applications from candidates who have the right to work in the United Kingdom.

Please be assured that we’re here to support you throughout the recruitment process and beyond, and reasonable adjustments are available to any candidates who need them. We’re also open to working flexibly and are happy to discuss flexible working options.

As applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, this vacancy may close before the advertised closing date. Early applications are encouraged.

Managing your data

We care about your personal data. The General Data Protection Regulation provides you with more control and by submitting an application to us, we consider this to be an agreement to process your personal data in support of our recruitment and selection process.

Data categories that we process in relation to your application are the ones that you provided as part of the application process. We process your personal data in relation to the application, in accordance with the legal requirements. Recipients of your personal data within our company are the managers of the specialist unit in charge of filling the position and the responsible colleagues from HR.

Your application data is held within our secure application tracking system called Taleo – you’ll be given access to a candidate zone in this system where you can monitor and manage your application and see status updates. We will communicate with you, by email or phone throughout the recruitment process so that we can keep you updated and inform you of your progress through the recruitment process. You can also seek ‘job alerts’ once you are registered in Taleo and it’s possible your details may be returned in searches we conduct for new positions and we may contact you by email to let you know about them. We limit the storage of your data to the necessary period. Contact us at careers@mercedes-benz.com for further information.

If you have any questions about any matter relating to data protection or the personal data that we process about you for the purpose of personnel recruiting, please contact the Chief Officer of Corporate Data Protection for the Mercedes-Benz Group AG at the following address: Mercedes-Benz Group AG, HPC E600, 70546 Stuttgart, data.protection@mercedes-benz.com.

Main Accountabilities

Finance dashboard development and stakeholder delivery:

  • Design, build, test and deploy Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models.

  • Identify and connect to appropriate data sources, including Databricks, SQL, data lake, data warehouse and Excel.
  • Apply data validation, reconciliation, unit testing and troubleshooting before release.
  • Create documentation covering data sources, model logic, measures, definitions and usage guidance.
  • Work with the wider Data & MI team to ensure reporting standards, governance and best practice are followed.

Head Office Dashboard Adoption And Reporting Alignment

  • Identify existing Head Office Power BI dashboards, data models and schemas that can support UK reporting requirements.
  • Promote adoption of relevant Head Office solutions to avoid duplication and support consistency across reporting outputs.
  • Adapt, deploy and explain Head Office reporting where appropriate for UK users.
  • Provide training, guidance and support to improve dashboard adoption and user confidence.

Cognos Migration And Legacy Report Modernisation

  • Support the decommissioning of legacy Cognos Data Warehouse reports by identifying reporting needs that should migrate to Power BI.
  • Rebuild, improve and optimise priority legacy reports using Power BI, modern data sources and improved reporting design.
  • Work with users to test migrated reports, confirm accuracy and support transition from legacy reporting.
  • Help reduce manual reporting effort and improve the consistency, reliability and usability of Finance MI.

Mentoring And Knowledge Sharing

  • Mentor and support one Data Apprentice, helping them build confidence in data, reporting and BI development.
  • Share Power BI knowledge and good practice with analysts and business users across the Finance & MI community.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for Power BI dashboard questions, issue resolution and user guidance.

About You

Essential technical skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models.
  • Advanced DAX capability, including measures, calculations, KPIs, filter context and performance-aware design.
  • Experience creating robust data models, relationships, reusable reporting structures and business-friendly reporting layers.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, validating and preparing data.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure data lake or similar modern data platform technologies.
  • Advanced Excel capability, including use of Excel as a reporting input where structured data feeds are not yet available.
  • Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, testing, documentation and reporting governance.
  • Awareness of BI best practice, including performance optimisation, dashboard usability and controlled deployment.

Desirable Technical Skills

  • Experience with Power BI Service, workspaces, scheduled refresh, access management and deployment processes.
  • Knowledge of Power Query, Power Automate, Power Pivot, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.
  • Understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modelling and ETL or ELT frameworks.
  • Experience with legacy Cognos reporting is beneficial but not essential.
  • Experience working with finance, performance management, KPI reporting or management information is highly desirable.

Business And Behavioural Skills

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate business questions into reporting requirements.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and data insights clearly to non-technical users.
  • Customer-focused mindset, with a commitment to building dashboards that are useful, trusted and adopted.
  • Analytical, curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements or inconsistent data.
  • Organised and delivery focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in an agile environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to solving reporting and data issues.
  • Collaborative style, with a willingness to coach colleagues and support wider BI capability.

We’ll offer you a competitive salary and discretionary bonus structure. We also hope you’ll love our products as much as we do, with access to our colleague car schemes. On top of that, you’ll be able to join our pension scheme and you’ll get a flexible benefit pot that can be used to find the benefits that are right for you.

We’re here to support you – we offer access to colleague wellbeing resources, including an Employee Assistance Programme, Mental Health First Aiders and the Inclusion Advocates as well as flexible opportunities to support work life balance. We’ll also encourage your development, with the training and knowledge you need to reach your potential.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you’ll find a passionate team working to put our customers first. We know that to keep this team motivated, we need to ensure that everyone has equal opportunity to learn and develop. We celebrate a culture of appreciation and respect, where everyone is valued for who they are. We believe our backgrounds, experiences and cultures contribute to our shared experience and shape who we are and what we do. The diversity of our colleagues reflects the diversity of our customers. This diversity is the driving force behind our ideas.

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Role Summary


Responsibilities: Be the data-driven partner the Finance team relies on. Translate business needs into analytics, deliver Power BI dashboards, and define meaningful KPIs across functions to inform decisions
Salary: £40,000 to £45,000 per annum (please note that we have established salary bands that are determined by your level of educational attainment to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations)
Benefits: Discretionary profit share bonuses paid twice per year, hybrid and flexible working options, generous holiday allowance, private medical insurance, critical illness cover, income protection, full funding for external training, and more
Role Type: Full-time, permanent role
Start Date: The role will ideally commence in September or October 2026, and you will be asked to state your availability on your application form
Application Deadlines: The application deadline for this role is August 3rd, 2026
Location: This role is available in our Global Headquarters in Cambridge


About The Role

We are looking for a curious, commercially minded Data Analyst to join our Finance and Operations team and play a key role in how data drives decision-making across the business.

This is more than a reporting role. It's an opportunity to influence strategy, improve performance, and build scalable data solutions that senior leaders rely on.

Key responsibilities:


Analyse financial and operational performance to identify trends, risks and opportunities
Define, track and evolve KPIs and key financial metrics
Communicate insights clearly through strong data story telling
Design and Deliver engaging Power BI dashboards and reports to support business decisions
Support forecasting, budgeting and scenario modelling through robust, data-led insights


You will combine strong analytical thinking with hands-on technical expertise, working across tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL (where relevant) and programming languages like Python or VBA. This includes:


Using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, automation and scripting to streamline data processes
Applying programming skills to automate workflows, deepen analysis and enhance reporting capabilities
Building scalable data models and continuously improving processes through automation and optimisation


Working closely with Finance and the People team, you'll help transform how data is used to plan, forecast and drive performance across the organisation. A core part of the role will involve:


Bringing together data from multiple systems, including from multiple systems, including data via APIs across different ERP platforms
Creating a single, reliable source of truth to enable consistent and scalable reporting
Driving improvements in governance and automation


You'll also have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies, including agentic AI, using intelligent automation and AI-driven workflows to further enhance insight and efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across the full data lifecycle and is confident both technically and commercially, from extracting and modelling data through to delivering clear, impactful insights.

About Costello Medical

Costello Medical has grown organically since our foundation in 2008 to become one of the most established independently owned agencies delivering medical communications and health economic services. We work with a wide range of clients, including the industry's most successful pharmaceutical and medical technology companies, patient and public health bodies, and charitable organisations. We have been listed in the Top 100 Best Companies to Work For list since 2017, the Boston Globe's Top Places to Work list in 2025 and were proud to receive B Corporation accreditation in 2022. Learn more about us, our work, and our mission on our website: https://www.costellomedical.com/

Requirements

About You

Essential requirements for the role are:


Degree in a quantitative field (minimum 2:1 or equivalent). We welcome applications from a diverse range of specialisms, including but not limited to; Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Data Science, Data Analytics
A minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in data analytics work in a finance context
Strong Power BI skills, including building and maintaining dashboards/reports
Solid finance/FP&A knowledge, including the ability to define and track KPIs and financial metrics
Data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance with a focus on data accuracy and reliability
Understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices
Excellent communication and data storytelling, including the ability to be able to present insights to both finance and non-finance audiences
Proven cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management
Ability to document data sources, transformations, methodologies, and dashboards; maintain data lineage
Strong time management, prioritisation, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment


Desired requirements for the role are:


Experience with a coding tool (e.g Python) for advanced analyses or familiarity with statistical methods
Proficient SQL for data extraction, joining sources and shaping datasets
Advanced Excel skills (Power Query, Power Pivot)
FP&A experience, including budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling
Experience designing robust data models (star/snowflake schemas) and scalable analytics solutions
Ability to automate/report scheduling and improve dashboard delivery processes
Familiarity with data storytelling frameworks and dashboard usability improvement
Experience within the ‘'big 4'' professional services networks


Benefits

What We Offer

Alongside our award-winning company culture, where every team member is celebrated, respected, and has their voice heard, we are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:


A starting salary of £40,000 to £45,000 per annum, depending on your previous experience, as well as a discretionary profit share bonus paid twice per year. Please note that we have established salary bands to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations
25 days' annual leave plus bank and public holidays, as well as a holiday buy and sell scheme
Flexible working hours and the chance to work from home for up to half of your working time after passing probation
Flexible benefits scheme offering cash payments, additional pension contributions and more
Private Medical Insurance which offers comprehensive cover on a "medical history disregard" basis
Paid study leave and funding for external qualifications
Critical Illness Cover, Income Protection and Life Assurance
Paid and unpaid sabbaticals based on length of service


Learn more about our full reward package and the other benefits of working for Costello Medical: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/benefits-package-in-china/

Hybrid Working Policy: We believe that having face-to-face time in the office holds many benefits and is central to ensuring that the community we have created, where people have a workplace they belong to and feel part of, is never lost. At the same time, we recognise that homeworking can improve work life balance, reduce commuting times and costs, and provide the opportunity to juggle personal commitments.

Therefore, we offer flexible working arrangements that allow our colleagues who have passed probation to work from home up to half their time, measured across a 2-week rolling period. During your probationary period (normally the first 6 months of the role), you will be able to work from home 1 day per week.

The Application Process

You are required to submit your CV and a cover letter via our online application form. In your cover letter, you must explain why you think you would be suited to the role and why you would like to join Costello Medical, with examples to support both. Your CV should clearly state the dates of all qualifications and grades achieved where applicable.

Then, our recruitment process includes a telephone interview, and a technical assessment for you to complete in your own time. If successful, you will be invited to an on-site interview.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce and, throughout the recruitment process, there are a number of reasonable adjustments we can provide: https://www.costellomedical.com/reasonable-adjustments/

Please note that, whilst we embrace AI to innovate and improve processes, your role may involve working with confidential data that cannot be uploaded to AI. Therefore, it is important for us to assess your own skills and abilities, so we recommend that you do not rely solely on this technology to generate any application materials.

Visa Sponsorship

Dependant on the salary you are offered and due to the Skilled Worker visa regulations, you will only be eligible for visa sponsorship if you meet at least one of the following criteria:


You are classified as a New Entrant, which includes applicants who are under the age of 26, currently studying in the UK or a recent graduate in the UK, amongst other qualifying criteria. Please read more about the New Entrant criteria: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/skilled-worker-visa-caseworker-guidance/skilled-worker-caseworker-guidance-accessible#bookmark63
You have a PhD in a subject that is relevant to the Financial Data Analyst role
You obtained your first Skilled Worker visa in the UK prior to 4th April 2024 and have continuously held a Skilled Worker visa since then (i.e., you will be switching employer)


You will be asked to provide details of your right to work in the UK within your application, which will be used to help assess your eligibility for visa sponsorship.

Please check the following link to read more about the criteria on the UK government website: https://www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa/when-you-can-be-paid-less. Please contact recruitment@costellomedical.com should you have any questions.

Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven leader who wants to transform player behaviour into meaningful insights that shape the future of one of the world's most iconic MMORPGs?

As Lead Analyst on Old School RuneScape, you'll lead a team of analysts responsible for uncovering the insights that drive better player experiences, smarter product decisions, and long-term business success. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership, you'll help shape the roadmap of Old School RuneScape by turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a highly influential role where you'll combine technical expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to ensure data sits at the heart of decision-making across one of gaming's most successful live service titles.

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and analytical excellence.
Build strong relationships with Old School RuneScape teams to develop a deep understanding of product strategy, player needs, and business priorities.
Deliver insights and business intelligence that directly influence product strategy, feature development, and roadmap planning.
Transform complex datasets into clear recommendations that support better decision-making across Product, Design, and Leadership.
Query, analyse, and interpret large datasets to uncover opportunities to improve player engagement, retention, and overall game experience.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design teams to develop and enhance game telemetry and data collection.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define data requirements and contribute to the evolution of shared data products.
Develop deep knowledge of Old School RuneScape's gameplay systems, mechanics, and player behaviours to provide meaningful context to analysis.
Champion data-driven thinking across the game team and promote best practices in analytics and reporting.

Title: Digital Analyst - Fixed Term
Description:
This is a fixed-term contract for 12 months** This vacancy can be located at any of our headquarters within the market locations. This role sits within Analytics Sales Platform of our Customer Analytics & Data Solutions Division and reports into the Lead Digital Analyst.


As a Digital Analyst you will transform data into actionable insights that drive business improvements and enhance customer experience. You'll work closely with stakeholders across the business, creating compelling reports and visualizations that support data-driven decision making as we work towards becoming the leader in technology within the travel industry.

About Our Offer


Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.


About The Job


You'll collect, process, and analyze data from various sources to provide insights that support business objectives, extracting data from relevant systems, cleaning and preparing it for analysis, and identifying trends and patterns that drive business value.
Creating and maintaining regular reports and dashboards will be central to your role, as you build and update visualizations in tools like Tableau and Power BI, producing performance reports that effectively communicate key metrics to stakeholders with clarity and impact.
Responding to ad-hoc data and analysis requests means you'll provide timely and accurate information to support business needs, clarifying requirements, prioritizing multiple requests, and delivering analysis within agreed timeframes while documenting approaches for future reference.
You'll identify and investigate data anomalies and discrepancies, monitoring key metrics for unexpected changes, investigating root causes of data issues, and working with relevant teams to resolve problems and ensure data quality.
Collaborating with team members and stakeholders to understand business context and requirements ensures your analytics work delivers relevant and valuable insights, as you participate in requirements gathering meetings, translate business questions into analytical approaches, and present findings to business stakeholders.
Supporting the implementation and adoption of analytics tools and capabilities will be part of your day-to-day, as you create user guides, provide basic training to business users, promote data-driven decision making, and help build a data-driven culture within the organization.


About You


You have advanced education in a quantitative field such as Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience in analytics or reporting.
Proven experience in analytics or reporting demonstrates your ability to transform data into actionable insights, with proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools including Excel, GA4, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, and Power BI.
Your data storytelling skills and ability to communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders show you can explain complex data clearly and make information accessible.
Understanding of basic statistical concepts including A/B testing, combined with basic knowledge of SQL or other data query languages, enables you to perform robust analysis and extract data efficiently.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to data accuracy ensure you deliver reliable insights that support business decision making.
Managing multiple priorities, meeting deadlines, and taking a collaborative approach to working with teams and stakeholders comes naturally to you.
Experience in travel, hospitality, or e-commerce industries would be beneficial, as would knowledge of web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics, understanding of customer journey and funnel analysis, experience with additional programming languages, data visualization best practices, agile environments, and data governance principles.


From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Frive – At Frive, we’re redefining what food should be – real, wholesome and made without artificial stuff, because your body deserves better than the ultra-processed products that flood supermarket shelves. 
Our mission is simple: to fuel you with real nutrition that supports your health and vitality – not just for today, but for the long run.

About the Role
Frive is a fast-growing meal kit subscription business in London. The Data Analyst will own the reporting and forecasting the business runs on each week.
The postholder will work alongside the Senior Data & Analytics Manager, who leads the team and owns Looker, while taking full ownership of forecasting and operational reporting. This work feeds directly into what Frive cooks, what it buys, and what lands in customers' boxes each week.
Frive builds a lot of its own internal tools rather than waiting on engineering, so there is plenty of room to experiment with how problems get solved.
Key Responsibilities
Forecasting & Reporting



Own the weekly forecasting and cutoff process end to end.

Maintain and extend automated data pipelines that keep reporting tables up to date.

Menu, Production & Margin Analysis



Support menu and production decisions with analysis of menu allocation, production variance, and meal-level margin.

Run the analysis behind changes to the meal assignment algorithm, covering margin and efficiency impact.

Data Infrastructure & Self-Serve Analytics



Build and scale the Looker instance to support a self-serve analytics culture across the business.

Identify, develop, and implement new approaches and processes across the business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication



Collaborate closely with teams such as Menu Planning, Procurement, Ops, and Finance.

Communicate findings in a way that is simple, clear, and actionable.

Candidate Profile
Experience & Credibility



Writes solid SQL and is comfortable working with large datasets, debugging complex queries, and thinking about how data models fit together; this is the one skill the team can't be flexible on.

Has used a BI tool like Looker or Tableau to build dashboards people actually use.

Bonus: has built things beyond dashboards, such as a Streamlit app or a Python script, to solve a problem.

Personal Attributes



Comfortable with ambiguity and messy operational data.

Curious about the business itself, not just the numbers; the best analysis here comes from understanding how the kitchen, the menu, and the supply chain actually work.

Proactive and excited to shape how the business uses data.

Doesn't need to tick every box on this list, or hold a specific degree; mindset, skills, and willingness to learn matter more.

Competencies & Style



Can explain analysis to people who don't work with data, in a way they can act on.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative team where things can change quickly.

Knowledge & Skills



Strong SQL skills, with the ability to debug complex queries and reason about data models.

Practical experience with BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) for dashboard-building.

What Success Looks Like



A weekly forecasting and cutoff process that runs smoothly and reliably.

Menu, production, and margin analysis that directly informs what gets cooked and bought each week

A scaled Looker instance supporting genuine self-serve analytics across the business.

Clear, actionable findings that non-technical teams can act on with confidence.

Title: Data Operations Analyst
Description:
Application Deadline: 21 August 2026

Department: Engineering

Location: London



Description

About UsWe are a fast-growing Series A SaaS startup at the forefront of the next big shift in marketing, transforming the way brands connect with audiences in virtual worlds. This is a shift on par with the rise of social media, and we are building the analytics engine to power it. You will be joining a tight-knit, high-impact team of 40 people, including a product team of 3 and an engineering team of 10, meaning your work will directly shape the trajectory of our platform and company.

About the RoleOur platform runs on data, and this role owns the work that keeps it flowing: pulling, validating, importing and quality-checking so the wider team can move quickly and with confidence. Sitting within the product team, you will own the operational data layer: the day-to-day work of getting accurate, trustworthy data into the hands of product, client services and the wider business, fast.

This is a hands-on product & operations role, not an engineering or a pure-analysis one. You are the dependable go-to who unblocks the team's data needs and keeps everything flowing and accurate. You write SQL confidently, lean heavily on AI tools to move quickly, and you are comfortable reading code and data models, but you take your pride from being the person who keeps data reliable and accessible, not from building pipelines or chasing the next engineering project.





Key Responsibilities


Own data access across the product lifecycle: Be the team's first port of call for data requests, pull, shape and deliver data in the format product, CS and sales need.
Validate and quality-check: Sanity-check, validate and QC data across the platform so the team can trust every number. Spot anomalies, chase them down, and keep our data honest.
Manage imports and ingestion ops: Run routine data imports and ingestion tasks, making sure data lands cleanly, completely and on time.
Work AI-first: Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot and similar) to rapidly translate business logic or SQL into complex database queries (including NoSQL / Elastic / Mongo), accelerating repetitive work, and continually improve how the team gets and checks data.
Document and share knowledge: Document data sources, queries and processes so knowledge never sits with just one person. You make the team less dependent on any single individual, including yourself.
Own the long tail: Take ownership of the steady stream of ad hoc requests that keeps the wider team moving.
Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with data engineers and product team, translating between technical data and real business needs.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


An operations and service mindset: You take genuine pride in being the reliable go-to who keeps data flowing and accurate. You enjoy solving a team's everyday data needs and you are not looking to use this role as a stepping stone into a pure engineering job.
Data Fluency (SQL & NoSQL): You write and debug SQL confidently, but you are also comfortable navigating non-relational/document databases (like MongoDB and Elasticsearch). You don't need to have raw NoSQL syntax memorized, but you should know how to read nested JSON structures.
AI-first working: You already lean heavily on AI tools to work faster and better, and you are always finding new ways to use them.
Technical literacy: You can read code and data models (including how relational data maps to NoSQL/JSON structures), understand how different systems fit together, and pick up light Python.
Rigour and attention to detail: You are meticulous about data accuracy and quality, and you notice when a number looks off.
Bias for action: You are comfortable in the ambiguity of a Series A startup and happy to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Clear communicator: You can translate between technical data and business stakeholders without friction.
AI-first working: You already lean heavily on AI tools to work faster and better. Crucially, you possess the critical thinking to audit and validate AI-generated outputs, ensuring code/queries are safe and optimised before running them.
Experience: Around 2–4 years in a data operations, data analyst, BI, revenue/business operations or similar hands-on data role.

Bonus Points
Experience in a data operations, analytics operations or revenue operations function.
Familiarity with the modern data stack and BI tooling.
Background in marketing-related SaaS, virtual environments or gaming.
Familiarity with tools such as Linear and Notion.


Why join us?


Join a business at the forefront of the next big shift in marketing.
Be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, innovative and supportive team.
Be genuinely indispensable, this role unlocks something the whole company depends on, so your impact is visible from day one.
A real, non-engineering growth path: grow into owning our data-quality function, take on ROI and attribution research as the team scales.
25 days holiday as standard, plus a bonus GEEIQ Day to use whenever you choose.
We offer Heka, a monthly wellness allowance you can spend across a wide range of fitness and wellbeing providers, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.
We have a thriving company culture with regular socials, team offsites, and events - quizzes, sports days, Hackathons, Bake Offs, and more. Our eNPS is 52, nearly double the industry average, and it shows, the team genuinely loves working here and learning from each other.
You pick your start time, we just ask that everyone's available during core hours of 10am–5pm. That might mean 8am–5pm, 9am–6pm, or 10am–7pm, whatever works best for you.

Description:
Location: Farnborough GU14 0FB

Rate: 18.72 PAYE

Contract: ongoing – initial 12 months




Hays are delighted to be working with our global client, one of the world’s most successful premium manufacturers of cars, motorcycles, and provider of premium services. Our client demonstrates a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and product responsibility all the way from development to production. Their aim is to play a dynamic and innovative role in shaping the face of mobility. Our client highly values each and every person; their passion, commitment, uniqueness and contribution to shaping the future success of their business.




About the job:

Support the achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs) such as customer consent, addressability and data capture, loyalty and VOC NPS for the National Sales Company (NSC) in the UK and Ireland through comprehensive analysis, insightful reporting, and strategic project support.
Collaborate with the local Customer Data Delegates (CDDs) to ensure the seamless maintenance and improvement of compliance documentation, fostering a culture of regulatory excellence.
Deliver impactful ad-hoc reports, including targeted marketing audience selection lists, detailed segmentation analyses, customer insight and the development of dynamic data dashboards that empower decision-making.
Support lead management processes involving delivery of leads to retailers, including testing of new lead sources.
Support the Customer Data Manager and Customer Experience Manager with data integration initiatives by providing insights and rigorous testing, facilitating large-scale transformations within the customer IT landscape.
Write and execute precise SQL queries on the customer database platforms to ensure data integrity and campaign effectiveness.
Support the Customer Data Manager and Customer Experience Manager to ensure the accuracy and relevance of data within internal systems, including the timely incorporation of new models and campaigns, and the successful delivery of the VOC programme to support business objectives.
Coordinate the resolution of customer-related data issues for both campaigning and VOC through the IT ticketing system, ensuring prompt and effective solutions.
Engage with AG departments on central projects related to customer data and customer experience, fostering collaboration and alignment across the organisation.
Enhance departmental knowledge management by updating and maintaining Confluence pages and process documentation related to areas of responsibility, ensuring accessibility and clarity for all stakeholders




What will you bring to the global premium automotive brand:

Educated to GCSE/A-Level equivalent.
Strong interpersonal skills at all management levels.
Effective organizational and time management skills.
Proactive and able to react quickly.
Able to work autonomously and use own initiative.
Familiar with Purchase Orders, Contracts, and Tenders processes.
Proficient in English; additional language skills (Italian, Spanish, German, or French) are beneficial.




How will we support you:

The business core values are integral to their corporate culture and guide their actions and decisions. These values include:

Openness – Embracing change and new opportunities, learning from mistakes and acting with integrity, Responsibility – Making consistent decisions and committing to them personally, fostering trust and effective teamwork.

Appreciation – Reflecting on actions, respecting each other, offering clear feedback and celebrating success

Transparency –Acknowledging concerns and identifying inconsistencies constructively

Trust – Relying on each other to act swiftly and achieve goals

Diversity – Valuing diverse backgrounds and experiences to enhance innovation and competitiveness




Compensation

We offer a competitive hourly wage plus an annual performance-related bonus. You will receive a generous annual leave up to 35 days which is inclusive of bank holidays. There’s free on-site parking available and you’ll have access to a subsidised restaurant. We offer hybrid working where employees split their time between working remotely (often from home) and working in the office




Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion policy is centered around creating a diverse and inclusive work environment that values and respects differences. The company promotes diversity through various initiatives and has integrated diversity, equity, and inclusion into its HR strategy1.

Key aspects of policy include:

Promoting equal opportunities in recruitment and personnel development

Ensuring protection against discrimination and fostering respect in everyday business

Title: Pensions Analyst (Accounts & Member Data)
Description:
Pensions Analyst (Accounts & Member Data)

Location: Crawley | Salary: £37,000 - £42,000 (Depending on experience) plus 7.5% bonus | Contract: Permanent | Closing date: 09/08/2026




Are you an analytical pensions or finance professional who enjoys working with complex data, improving controls and turning information into clear insight? UK Power Networks is looking for a Pensions Analyst to join our in-house pensions team and support the accuracy, validity and reporting of member, scheme and financial data.




Reporting to the Pensions Project Manager within the Human Resources directorate, you will play a key role in preparing pension scheme accounts, producing management information and supporting high-quality reporting across member benefit data. You will work with internal teams and external partners including Finance, HR, Payroll, administrators, actuaries, auditors, custodians and investment managers.




You will help prepare quarterly pension scheme management accounts, analyse and validate member data, support actuarial valuations and accounting disclosures, and identify trends, anomalies and opportunities to improve data quality. You will also contribute to governance, regulatory compliance, audit trails, data controls and continuous improvement activity across reporting and reconciliation processes.




This is a great opportunity to apply your pensions, accounting and data analysis experience in a role where accuracy, insight and collaboration really matter. You will be trusted to investigate data issues, present findings to non-technical stakeholders and support decision-making through clear, reliable reporting.

Permanent role based in Crawley, with blended working available after probation: 3 days in the office and 2 days remote.
Salary £37,000 - £42,000 (depending on experience) plus 7.5% bonus.
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
Personal Pension Plan with UK Power Networks contributions of 8% or 10% depending on your contribution rate.
Access to benefits including Cycle to Work, Home & Tech, Green Car Leasing, discounted gym membership, Employee Assistance Programme and retailer discounts.




You will bring experience from pensions, finance, accounting or a related analytical environment, along with advanced Excel skills and the ability to work confidently with large datasets. Knowledge of SQL-based languages, data validation, reconciliation, reporting tools such as Power BI and pension scheme structures will help you succeed. Experience with DB/DC schemes, SAP, Aviary, Pensions Office, APIs or pension scheme accounting requirements would be beneficial.




If you are methodical, proactive and confident turning complex data into meaningful insight, we would like to hear from you. Apply by 09/08/2026 to join UK Power Networks as a Pensions Analyst and help strengthen the quality, integrity and reporting of our pensions data.

For more information and to view the full job description please click apply!




If you have any queries in connection to this vacancy or your application, please contact us at careers@ukpowernetworks.co.uk quoting the vacancy reference number and a member of the team will get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Title: Geospatial Data Analyst
Description:
Geospatial Data Analyst | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | Hatfield (2 days in the office)

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About The Role

As a Last Mile Geospatial Analyst in the Global Technology Services (GTS) Analytics team, you'll use data to transform final-stage order fulfilment across the Ocado Smart Platform. Based in Hatfield, you'll deliver insights that improve delivery efficiency, customer satisfaction, and partner performance, with a focus on network planning, resource strategy, and routing optimisation.

Working across technology, operations, and international partners, you'll lead high-impact analytics projects, influence strategic decisions, and help drive lower costs and reduced carbon emissions. You'll also champion data best practices and mentor colleagues, combining technical expertise with leadership to shape the future of last-mile operations.

Key Responsibilities


Support the strategic roadmap for last-mile analytics, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and industry trends.
Partner with Last Mile leadership to develop data-driven strategies for route optimisation, network planning, and customer experience.
Build advanced forecasting and optimisation models to improve delivery efficiency, routing, and capacity utilisation.
Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to uncover actionable insights from complex delivery and customer datasets.
Track, analyse, and report on performance trends to identify operational bottlenecks and drive cost-saving initiatives.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools using Looker to provide stakeholders with real-time performance insights.
Collaborate with software development teams to integrate analytics solutions into operational workflows and inform platform enhancements.
Provide strategic guidance and actionable insights to international partners and strategy planners across the globe.
Mentor, coach, and provide constructive feedback to team members, championing analytical best practices and supporting career development.


Essential

What We’re Looking For


Experience applying geospatial analytics and location-based data to optimise (things like) delivery networks, routing, and operational decision-making.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a passion for driving the implementation of recommendations that deliver measurable results.
Technical proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Programming experience with Python or R is beneficial.
Proven experience creating data visualisations and dashboards using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
Strong analytical, numerical, and statistical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience utilising AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics workflows, from initial data exploration through to insight generation.


Nice to Haves


Experience in last-mile logistics, home delivery, network strategy, or retail/eCommerce fulfillment operations.
Experience in last-mile logistics and network planning, including holistic operational cost-to-serve modeling.
An understanding of eCommerce customer behavior and key operational metrics such as drop densities and on-time delivery rates.
Professional experience within a consulting or advisory role, bringing structured problem-solving to projects with varied stakeholders.
A proven track record of working closely with external partners to deploy and operationalise data solutions at scale.


Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:


Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).


Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.

Title: BI Developer EMEIA
Description:
Job Title: BI Developer EMEIA




Reports to: Director & Head of Strategy Implementation EMEIA




Location: Europe




Role summary

We are seeking an experienced BI Developer to develop, enhance and maintain EMEIA’s strategy implementation tracking and reporting solutions, together with selected finance reporting capabilities. Reporting to the Director & Head of Strategy Implementation of the Division, the role will be part of an international team and will translate business needs into scalable BI solutions by working closely with business stakeholders and data/source owners to identify, access and integrate the required data.

The role will collaborate with EMEIA BI Solution Architects, the EMEIA BI team and AI experts to deliver robust, governed and user-friendly reporting solutions, with an increasing focus on AI-powered insights and data-driven decision-making across EMEIA.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric and associated languages such as DAX, SQL and Power Query. Familiarity with Azure DevOps and PySpark/Python would be beneficial as would experience of working with cloud-based data solutions.




Principal Responsibilities




Report Development:
Develop and deploy Power BI reports in line with EMEIA governance and frameworks.
Create specifications and design data models to support report requirements.
Transform data using Fabric Notebooks, Pipelines and Power Query.
Model data for efficient reports.
Write DAX measures and develop calculated tables/columns.




Collaboration and Communication:

Collaborate with EMEIA BI Team and relevant stakeholders to align solution design and delivery.
Respond to support issues and communicate effectively with business users.
Store code and artifacts in DevOps repositories in line with agreed practices.
Partner with EMEIA BI Solution Architects and AI experts to explore and deliver AI-enabled reporting capabilities.




Data Analysis and Integration:

Connect and analyze data from various sources (Finance system, Scorecards, CRM, ERP, PIM, Data Warehouse, etc.).
Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Design, build, and deploy BI and analytics solutions.




Quality Assurance and Documentation:

Conduct testing to ensure quality and accuracy.
Document and support developed solutions.
Participate in peer-reviews and ensure code quality.
Create and maintain technical documentation and user manuals.




Maintenance and Governance:

Maintain business analytics platforms and adhere to Data Governance policies.
Ensure solutions are accurate, secure, and scalable according to the EMEIA IT Guidelines.
Identify and suggest improvement areas.
Troubleshoot and resolve defects.




Education, Work Experience and Personal Qualities

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience as a BI Developer or in a similar role.
Proficiency in Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
SQL skills and experience with data warehousing.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to read and interpret technical journals, specifications, and international technical standards.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Experience working in agile teams.
Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
Proficient in M365 applications, such as Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Analytics Engineer

Customer Service Data Team | Crawley, UK or Madrid, Spain

Help shape the future of data, analytics and AI

We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Customer Service Data team and help transform data into trusted insights that drive business decisions.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between data engineering and analytics, building scalable data models, semantic layers and automated data pipelines that power reporting, dashboards and next-generation AI solutions. You'll work with modern technologies including Snowflake, Power BI, dbt and AI-enabled analytics platforms to create a single source of truth for our business.

What You'll Do


Design and develop analytics-ready data models and semantic layers in Snowflake.
Build scalable data transformations and automated data quality processes.
Create trusted datasets and standardised KPIs that support consistent reporting.
Partner with Data Engineers, BI Developers and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights.
Drive data governance, documentation and business-friendly data definitions.
Support self-service analytics and AI-powered reporting capabilities.
Improve data reliability, performance and automation across the analytics ecosystem.


What You'll Bring


Experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, BI Development or a similar data-focused role.
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake.
Experience building semantic models and analytics solutions in Power BI.
Understanding of data warehousing concepts, including fact and dimension modelling.
Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations and testing frameworks.
Familiarity with version control and modern data development practices.
Interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.


Why join us?

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact data initiatives that support a global healthcare business. You'll play a key role in building the foundations for advanced analytics, self-service reporting and AI-driven decision-making while working with modern cloud technologies and a highly collaborative team.

If you're passionate about turning data into insight and shaping the future of analytics, we'd love to hear from you.

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
