Title: Data Analyst, SMB Self-Serve
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data and analytics are at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to support our Self-Serve segment — the fastest-growing part of Lyft's B2B portfolio, serving small and mid-size businesses across North America. This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, dbt) is a plus
Comfortable using AI coding and analytics tools — LLM assistants, agentic SQL/analysis workflows — to accelerate extraction, exploration, and reporting, while reviewing and validating every query, result, and insight before it reaches stakeholders; you own the correctness of the output, not the tool
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, game designers, and quality teams to enhance player experiences and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, gameplay features, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Analyse player and product data to uncover patterns and recommend opportunities to improve performance, stability, automation and test coverage and bug metrics
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to independently manage assigned tasks including work planning for assigned deliverables


Pay Transparency - North America

Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$147,900 - CA$221,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Design and maintain advanced reporting solutions and dashboards that support stakeholder decision-making across multiple teams and business segments
Lead end-to-end data analysis projects, defining technical requirements for ETL processes and data models

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on reporting needs, probe assumptions, and communicate findings clearly at all levels
Own and deliver a portfolio of recurring and ad-hoc stakeholder reports with minimal supervision
Build or optimize at least two automated reporting workflows using available tools (including AI tools such as Claude or Gemini)
Establish strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders across the Advertising Technologies department

Participate actively in sprint planning and backlog prioritization for the BI team
Leverage AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and draft documentation

3+ years of experience in a data analytics role, with a strong track record of delivering advanced reporting for multiple stakeholder teams
Advanced SQL skills; ability to define ETL requirements and work with complex, heterogeneous datasets
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) and building client-facing or executive-ready dashboards
Strong communication skills with experience presenting data-driven findings to senior management and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to identify data quality root causes and implement systematic solutions

Department: Performance Analytics & Reporting

Salary Grade: 6 ($86,210 - $101,349)

Job Posting Close Date: 08/06/2026

The Ontario Energy Board is proud to be recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for four years running.

Our success resides with our people and we take great pride in fostering a workplace culture that attracts top-tier professionals passionate about shaping Ontario’s energy future. Our reputation as a preferred employer reflects our commitment to helping deliver clean, reliable, affordable and secure energy that enables economic growth across the province.

Our One OEB culture promotes a values-driven, collaborative workplace where diverse perspectives come together to deliver regulatory excellence, and where we encourage curiosity and agility in an environment that is grounded in mental health, wellbeing and a foundational commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

We are the ONTARIO ENERGY BOARD.

Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Performance Analytics and Reporting, the Analyst is responsible for supporting the OEB’s utility performance analysis and reporting activities. This includes working with other OEB groups to manage utility data submission processes and providing analytical insight to assist the Board in policy development and decision making. The Performance Analytics and Reporting department monitors financial and non-financial performance of Ontario’s electricity and natural gas distributors, as well as other regulated entities.

Responsibilities


Initiates and develops plans to achieve, and deliver data analytics based on financial accounting, customer and performance reported by utilities.
Identifies relevant issues and provides in-depth analysis associated with financial and non-financial data for regulated entities.
Provides analytics expertise to internal and external stakeholders regarding data gathered and insights into correlations & trends seen through utility reporting.
Working closely with other departments supports policy implementation through specialized reporting requirements and data analysis.
Conceptualizes and builds analytical models to improve reporting and industry analytics and presents information to both internal and external stakeholders.
Delivers on projects related to performance assessment (e.g., enhancement of utilities scorecard).
Collaboratively works with other team members on analytics best practices and utility operations.
Prepares and/or reviews monthly, quarterly, and annual statistical and project status reports/publications, ensuring information published is accurate and thorough.
Develops and/or enhances new and/or existing policies and procedures.


Qualifications


Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance; Economics; Data Science; Engineering or a related field.
An accounting, engineering or finance professional designation is highly preferred.
3+ years of relevant experience in the energy sector including performance assessment, industry insights, asset management or system planning.
2+ years’ experience translating large data sets into actionable information and valuable insights for decision making purposes.
Experience and knowledge of electric utility performance metrics, including key drivers and challenge.
2+ years’ experience in a utility or regulatory environment is preferred.
Previous working experience with data analytical solutions and tools such as Excel, SQL, VBA, Oracle BI, SAS, R, Tableau, Alteryx.
Knowledge of financial/management reporting.
Practical knowledge supporting projects with interdisciplinary teams, understanding stakeholder expectations, and managing own project timelines / deliverables.
Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of the Ontario Energy Board Act, 1998 and related regulatory policies is an asset.

Reporting to the Manager, Performance Analytics and Reporting, the Analyst is responsible for supporting the OEB’s utility performance analysis and reporting activities. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Science Analyst
Description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Data Science Analyst to join our growing data science practice. In this role, you will support the development and delivery of quantitative models and analyses across a portfolio of marketing clients, including predictive modeling, regression analysis, and statistical work spanning media, pricing, and promotional data. This is a great entry point for someone with a strong statistics background who wants to apply analytical skills in a fast-paced, client-service environment.




Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain data science models such as Marketing Mix Models using regression-based techniques, working with weekly or monthly time-series data across media, pricing, and promotional variables.
Conduct data validation, cleaning, and QA on client-provided datasets to ensure model-ready inputs.
Run statistical analyses including adstock transformations, diminishing returns curves, and decomposition outputs.
Support model documentation and prepare structured outputs (Excel workbooks, charts, summary tables) for internal and client review.
Collaborate with senior team members on methodology decisions and model refinement.
Contribute to internal tooling and process improvements as the team scales.




Desired Skills & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
Strong foundation in statistical modeling, particularly regression analysis and time-series methods.
Comfort working in Python or R for data manipulation, modeling, and visualization (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, or equivalent).
Familiarity with concepts such as multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity, model fit diagnostics, and variable selection.
Attention to detail and the ability to work carefully through large, messy datasets.
Clear written communication skills for documenting analytical work.
Exposure to Bayesian methods or hierarchical modeling.
Experience with marketing data (media spend, impressions, GRPs) or consumer datasets.
Prior internship or academic project experience in an applied analytics setting.




What we offer

Hands-on experience working across multiple industry verticals and client types.
A collaborative, learning-focused team environment with senior mentorship.
Exposure to the full MMM lifecycle, from data intake through to client delivery.
Competitive compensation and benefits.

Title: Junior Data & AI Analyst
Description:
You live, We Care!




Redion, part of Generali Group, is looking for a forward-thinking Jr. Data & AI Analyst to join our IT team in Canada.




Join our dynamic, fast-moving, international group and help shape the future of care.

If you are the kind of person people turn to in times of need, we want to meet you. We are looking for people who truly care: who are willing to roll up their sleeves to help others and are energized by being there when it matters most. If you think fast, are open to change, and strive to be the best you can be, this is the place for you.




We are a company driven by cutting-edge technology and a culture of care. We design insurance solutions and deliver assistance services that make a real difference to people’s lives.

And just as we are always there for our customers, we are always there for you too. We will help you build a meaningful career full of purpose, pace and possibility.

Reporting directly to the Head of IT, with dotted line to the Lead Data & Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building our local operations by managing and optimizing data flows across our hybrid cloud environment.




About our company:




We are the world’s premier care partner, providing the world’s leading institutions and their customers and employees with insurance, assistance and prevention services that free them to make the most of every moment.

Our roots in assistance, and long history in insurance, have shaped a culture of care and innovation that sets us apart. Unlike major insurers, we are a fast-paced, agile and growing organization. We empower our people at all levels to act with confidence and authenticity. We believe it helps them take initiative, make quicker decisions, and build real, enduring relationships and effective solutions. We keep our structure streamlined and deploy industry-leading technology so our people can act faster, and with greater agility, to help our customers.

Care is at the heart of who we are and extends far beyond just our customers. We are one, international team — shaped and enhanced by the many cultures and perspectives we represent. We are committed to ensuring everyone that works with us feels valued and equipped to flourish. And we also care for our planet: taking pride in our industry-leading initiatives towards building a sustainable business.




The position is based in Toronto, and the working environment is a mix of in-office and remote work, though always in close collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.




Responsibilities Include:

End-to-End Data Engineering: Support the automated movement and lifecycle of data from source systems (Policy/Claims) into AWS Redshift and Microsoft Fabric. Use AWS Glue and Dataflow Gen2 to build robust ETL pipelines.
Semantic Modeling & DAX: Assist in the design and optimization of high-performance Power BI Semantic Models. Use DAX and Power Query to ensure accurate, high-impact reporting.
Visual Analytics & Insights: Create and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and advanced Excel reports. Analyze complex datasets to identify actionable trends, patterns, and operational insights.
AI & Model Support: Utilize AWS SageMaker and Fabric’s integrated AI tools to assist in training and deploying predictive models aimed at improving operational efficiency.
KPI & Strategic Reporting: Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and provide data-backed recommendations to leadership to drive process improvements and organizational performance.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to explain data lineage and translate complex technical findings into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.




Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Education: University or College Degree in the field of Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Data Science or related field.
Cloud Architecture: High interest or foundational experience in AWS (Redshift, Glue) and Microsoft Fabric (Dataflow Gen2).
Technical Proficiency: Strong command of SQL, Power BI (DAX focus), and Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, complex formulas).
Programming: Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy) is highly preferred for data manipulation within SageMaker or Fabric Notebooks.
Industry Context: A foundational understanding of insurance concepts (underwriting, claims, risk assessment) is highly valued.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to map out and explain complex data flows through various systems.




Language Requirement: Fluency in English

Hours of Work: Monday to Friday

Work Location: Toronto

Total Compensation: $60k – 70k (plus 8% bonus)

Vacancy: 1 full time position (new role)




Redion supports all accommodation requests from applicants with disabilities; please contact Human Resources at careers@redion.com if any accommodation is required. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.




Artificial Intelligence (AI) Usage Disclosure: Please note that our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist in screening, assessing, and selecting applicants. These technologies are used to enhance efficiency, ensure consistency, and support fair decision-making. All AI-assisted evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable privacy and employment regulations.

We thank all applications for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re Hiring!

Data Analyst

Toronto, ON | Montreal, QC

www.socan.com

POSITION TYPE: Permanent Full-Time

HIRING RANGE: $71,920 to $89,900

REASON FOR HIRING: Replacement

WORK MODEL: Hybrid

LANGUAGE: English, French is an asset

Who We Are

SOCAN is a not-for-profit copyright collective dedicated to ensuring music creators and publishers receive what they have rightfully earned for the use of their work. SOCAN supports and represents nearly 200,000 songwriters, composers, and music publishers. Through licensing, global royalty collection and advocacy, we help creators to keep making the music that entertains, moves, and inspires us

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION, AND ANTI-RACISM   

SOCAN thrives with a variety of viewpoints, identities, and backgrounds, and we are committed to anti-racism. Everyone is welcome to apply for our wide range of roles, regardless of gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, race, age, culture, sexual orientation, religious belief, or physical ability. Learn more about SOCAN’s commitment to Inclusion & Anti-Racism.  

WHY WORK WITH US?


Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living


What We Offer


35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment 


About The Role

SOCAN is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Analytics department. In this role, you’ll be accountable for turning raw data into actionable business insights through various reports and dashboards, driving improvement in our key organizational initiatives. You must be comfortable working closely with data engineers, BI analysts, and business leaders. The ideal candidate has a solid grasp of data fundamentals and is eager, curious, and possesses a drive for continuous learning and self-improvement, especially with modern cloud data stacks.

The knowledge of English is required for this position as the position requires to interact on a constant and regular basis with English-speaking stakeholders outside of Quebec

What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities


Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.
Perform exploratory data analysis to clean, transform, and analyze large datasets within Databricks to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve our data.
Support data quality assurance by creating data quality tests and plans for various reporting and Lakehouse projects that can assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and pipeline issues.
Work with each department leader to define and document KPIs.
Perform root-cause analysis on KPI fluctuations to provide actionable insights to department leaders.
Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

WHAT YOU WILL BRING / QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE


Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented


ACCESSIBILITY & ACCOMMODATION

SOCAN is committed to providing an inclusive workplace environment that meets the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities. Should you require accommodations please contact us directly at hr@socan.com and we will make the necessary accommodations. Applications submitted to this email address will not be accepted.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

SOCAN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Hiring and other employment decisions at SOCAN are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, ancestry, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, citizenship, veteran status, sexual orientation, record of offences, marital status, family status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, or local law, regulation, or ordinance.

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive, and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply

How To Apply

If you’re interested in joining us, we’d love to hear from you: http://www.socan.com/careers/

Thank you for your interest in our company; we will be in touch with those candidates we wish to interview.

To learn more about SOCAN, go to www.socan.com. You can also follow us on LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook (@SOCANmusic/@SOCANmusique).

Scope Of Position

The Market Data Analyst serves as the central data and reporting resource for Used Vehicle Sales Operations and Remarketing. The role is responsible for extracting, validating, and managing data from multiple internal and external sources, and transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights. The position ensures delivery of timely, accurate reporting and dashboards that support decision-making across the organization. Success is measured by the quality, consistency, and usability of reporting outputs that enable stakeholders to identify trends, optimize strategies, and drive business performance. 

Principal Functional Responsibilities


Extract, validate, and manage market, sales, and operational data to ensure accuracy, reliability, and availability for reporting and analysis. 
Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized and ad hoc reports and dashboards to provide visibility into key performance metrics and trends. 
Analyze vehicle pricing, residual values, and market conditions to identify risks and opportunities across the portfolio. 
Translate complex data findings into clear, concise insights and recommendations for business stakeholders. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting needs and refine analytics requirements. 
Maintain data integrity through quality checks and adherence to governance standards. 
Automate and optimize reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
Document data sources, reporting methodologies, and workflows to ensure consistency and scalability. 


Position Profile And Qualifications


Minimum College Diploma required; University degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, or related field preferred. 
1–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or analytics roles (co-op/internship experience considered). 
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data manipulation). 
Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) considered an asset. 
Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets accurately. 
Ability to translate technical data into clear, business-friendly insights. 
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to manage multiple reporting requests in a fast-paced environment. 


Relationship Responsibilities


Collaborates with Sales, Remarketing, Credit, and Risk teams to support reporting needs and data-driven decision-making. 
Supports senior leadership through delivery of reporting, dashboards, and insights for business reviews. 
Works with brand teams to provide data and analysis on program performance and market trends. 
Partners with IT teams to support data sourcing, issue resolution, and reporting enhancements.

Normal

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

As Data & Insights Analyst, Employee Onboarding, you will be responsible for measuring, monitoring, and reporting on onboarding performance across the employee lifecycle. You will transform operational data into actionable insights, helping stakeholders understand onboarding effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and track progress against key business outcomes.

What will you do?

Performance Measurement & KPI Management


Define and maintain onboarding performance metrics and KPIs.
Establish baseline measurements and performance targets for the Employee Onboarding team.
Monitor onboarding outcomes and identify emerging trends.
Measure employee readiness, fulfillment timelines, and experience outcomes.
Develop scorecards, executive reporting, and dashboards that leverage automation and reduce manual effort where possible.


Dashboard & Reporting


Build and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions.
Develop operational, tactical, and executive-level reporting views.
Improve accessibility and transparency of onboarding performance data
Reduce manual reporting activities through automation.
Ensure reporting accuracy and consistency


Analytics & Insights


Analyze onboarding data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Conduct root cause analysis for onboarding issues and delays.
Support prioritization decisions using quantitative insights.
Develop Recommendations based on trends and performance data.
Translate complex data into actionable business insights.


Data Governance & Quality


Establish reporting standards and data definitions
Validate data quality across onboarding systems and platforms.
Partner with tech teams to improve data availability and integrity.
Maintain KPI definitions and measurement methodologies.


Continuous Improvement Support


Measure benefits realization for onboarding initiatives.
Support business case development and prioritization exercises
Monitor adoption and effectiveness of new capabilities
Provide analytical support for process improvement initiatives.


What do you need to succeed?

Must-have Experience


2-5 years of experience in analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data analysis, or operational reporting.
Building dashboards and performance reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
Ability to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-have Experience


SN Performance analytics
Power BI, tableau, or similar tools
Employee experience, service management, HR or Tech ops
SQL and data visualization experience.
Supporting transformation programs.


What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Ability to make a difference and lasting impact by building world-class product capabilities.

A world-class training program in financial services.
Opportunities to do challenging work that delivers real value to users and the enterprise.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Changing the World, One Kibble at a Time

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Data Analyst to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food crafter with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. From our humble beginnings, founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry.

Our purpose, To Earn Pet Lover Trust Every Day so Pets Thrive for a Lifetime, provides the foundation for our highest aspirations as a company. Being a partner to the communities that surround us – and the environment that sustains us – are top priorities.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here’s The Scoop - Summary

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Analyst, preferably within the pet food or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

In this role, you will support end-to-end supply chain operations by providing actionable insights across multiple functions and serve as the centralized resource for supply chain data and KPI governance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about using data to enhance operational efficiency and support Champion Petfoods’ commitment to delivering high-quality nutrition to pets worldwide.

The Supply Chain Analyst works out of our Corporate office in Edmonton (AB) or Nashville (TN) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze data across supply chain to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvements
Identify supply chain performance gaps through data analysis, proactively engage with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes, and lead cross-functional efforts to develop and implement innovative solutions.
Develop and maintain real-time dashboards, data objects, and reports that track key supply chain metrics
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align analytics outputs with business needs
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels, enabling data-driven decision-making.
Assist in the deployment and continuous improvement of supply chain analytics tools and technologies


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in supply chain analytics or data analysis, preferably within the food or pet food industry.
Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Python.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Experience with data visualization platforms (preferably Power BI).
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams.
Experience with advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning or predictive modeling preferred.
Experience in Generative AI development preferred.
Familiarity with Databricks preferred.
Understanding of E2E supply chain processes preferred.


What can you expect from Champion?


Safety: A strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.
Earnings: Competitive wages, annual bonus eligibility, 401k/RRSP with company matching.
Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.
Continuing Education: In house & online learning & development, as well as an education assistance program.
Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.
Other Perks: Free bag of premium pet food each month.


What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

Title: Data Analyst - Marvel Strike Force
Description:
Scopely is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Marvel Strike Force remotely in the United States or Canada on a remote basis

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Marvel Strike Force is Scopely's squad-based Hero Collector RPG, housing heroes and villains across the Marvel Universe.

What You Will Do


Use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to accelerate analytical workflows, including data exploration, SQL/Python development, documentation, QA, summarization, and insight generation, while maintaining strong judgment around data quality, accuracy, privacy, and business context
Partner with product, design, economy, live operations, marketing, and leadership teams to turn data into clear insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and long-term game health
Own recurring business-health reporting for Marvel Strike Force, including KPI reads, trend context, variance explanations, and executive-ready narratives for what changed, why it changed, and what to do next
Analyze player behavior across onboarding, progression, events, offers, combat modes, and other core game systems to identify risks, opportunities, and player-impacting friction
Design and validate analytics tracking for new features, live events, player offers, and experiments so teams can measure performance accurately from launch onwar


What We're Looking For


B.Tech/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, Physics or other quantitative disciplines
2+ years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business analytics, financial analysis, data science, or a similar quantitative role
2+ years’ experience using SQL/Python, including complex queries from multiple data sources
2+ years’ experience creating reports using Tableau/Looker or a similar reporting system
Curiosity and hands-on interest in using AI tools to improve analytics workflows, with the judgment to validate outputs, protect sensitive data, and distinguish useful acceleration from unsupported conclusions
Familiarity with experimentation, including A/B test design, metric selection, statistical significance, guardrail metrics, and post-test interpretation
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn detailed analysis into concise, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical partners
Comfort working quickly in a live-service environment where priorities shift, data is imperfect, and decisions often need both speed and rigor


Bonus Points


Demonstrates openness to using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical workflows, accelerate insight generation, and support high-quality data-driven decision-making
Passion for games and curiosity about what motivates players, especially in RPG, hero collector, strategy, or squad-based combat games
Advanced degrees a plus
2+ years within the mobile gaming domain
Experience analyzing player lifecycle metrics such as onboarding, funnels, retention, engagement, progression, monetization, economy health, offers, events, or churn
Experience with modern analytics workflows such as dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Git, notebook-based analysis, or reusable data models

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

About WCS Canada

WCS Canada (wcscanada.org) was established as a Canadian conservation organization in July 2004. We are committed to championing accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity. Our mission is to save wildlife and wild places by improving our understanding of and seeking solutions to critical problems that threaten key species and large wild ecosystems throughout Canada. We implement and support comprehensive field studies that gather information on wildlife needs and then seek to resolve key conservation problems by working with a broad array of actors. WCS Canada has a track record of our science being recognized as relevant, credible and legitimate by researchers, NGOs and agencies. WCS Canada is independently registered and managed, while retaining a strong collaborative working relationship with sister Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) programs in more than 60 countries.

Diversity and inclusion are core WCS Canada values. WHY WE NEED YOU? GLAD YOU ASKED...




 







At Pelmorex, we’re on a mission to transform weather and environmental data into decision-grade insights for businesses and consumers. Our B2B products help organizations make smarter, safer, and more profitable decisions.




To support this mission, we’re growing our Engineering Insights team and investing in a scalable data analytics and insights platform. We’re looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data solutions and is passionate about turning raw data into high-quality datasets that power products and business decisions.




The Opportunity
You will play a key role in building and maintaining the data systems that power multiple B2B products.. Your work will directly shape how data is ingested, validated, transformed, and consumed across our B2B product portfolio, ensuring it is reliable, scalable, and decision-ready for our customers. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with a small, entrepreneurial team of Engineers, Product Managers, and Data Scientists to turn raw data into real-world impact.







Please note, we are only considering candidates who are eligible to work in Canada and can work in a Hybrid model at our Oakville or Montreal location. 




WHAT DOES THE DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE






Build the Backbone: You will develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using modern distributed compute frameworks such as Apache Beam and Snowpark.








Orchestrate Complex Workflows: You will build, monitor, and optimize data workflows using tools like Apache Airflow, Google Workflows, and Snowflake Tasks.








Manage Cloud Data Platforms: You will implement and optimize data models and storage across BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Storage to ensure scalable and efficient data solutions.








Own Data Quality & Rigor: You will implement robust data validation frameworks, write unit/integration tests for data pipelines, establish CI/CD, and set up proactive monitoring for data integrity and system health.








Optimize Performance: You will help improve data system performance, reduce costs, and increase reliability.








Collaborate Across Teams: You will partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Data Scientists to deliver high-quality data solutions that support business needs.


















WE ARE HOPING YOU HAVE






Education
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent technical field.








Experience & Ownership
2-5 years of professional experience in Data Engineering with hands-on experience building and supporting production data systems at scale.








Data Fundamentals
Solid understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, data modeling, partitioning strategies and pipeline design.








Cloud Expertise
Experience deploying, managing, or supporting data workloads in the cloud (GCP preferred).








Coding Fundamentals
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience writing clean, modular, and maintainable code optimized for heavy data processing.








Engineering Rigor
Strong commitment to automated pipeline testing, continuous integration, comprehensive documentation, and proactive system observability.












NICE TO HAVE






Experience working with high-volume geospatial, weather, or time-series datasets.








Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and managing data workloads on cloud compute (e.g., Cloud Run, GKE).








Exposure to infrastructure-as-code principles (e.g., Terraform)








 

DON’T MEET ALL THE REQUIREMENTS? DON’T WORRY…
Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Pelmorex values and welcomes diverse experiences. While having “desired” qualifications makes for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Pelmorex. We are always looking for people who will be a culture add (yup, that's right, we don’t subscribe to culture fit, we want you to add to what we think is an amazing culture and work environment

Open and transparent communication, including All Hands Meetings with our CEO

Your mental health is important to us! 🧠 We partner with Inkblot for virtual counseling sessions

Free online doctor visits 👩‍⚕️ with Maple Online Healthcare


While we encourage 1:1 conversations, we recognize that not everyone is comfortable with speaking up 🗣 We have an anonymous reporting platform to ensure everyone’s voice is heard

We’re highly focused on doing the right thing.

We’ll discuss issues and timelines professionally, so you have the time you need to do the best work you can

You will see the result of your work pushed out to real users quickly

We’re a team that enjoys learning new technologies and we’re open to trying new things

Job Description:

This position is responsible for the support of AltaLink's Energy Management System (EMS) utilized primarily by AltaLink's Control Center (ACC). This support includes the construction, operation, maintenance and security of the computer equipment, network equipment, software, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) connections, and other subsystems required to operate and maintain AltaLink's Transmission System assets. The successful candidate will enjoy a work environment which is fast paced, high-pressured, yet structured, which ensures the mission critical EMS high availability systems are in service at all times.

Responsibilities:


Support the EMS and associated infrastructure to ensure the control center has the services required to manage AltaLink's transmission assets
Application of new software and upgrades to existing software used in the EMS, its databases and operating systems
Maintaining the external interfaces required at the control centers.
Troubleshoot EMS/SCADA problems with Field Technicians/Engineers and system vendors. Construct, integrate, test and document new hardware and software following processes to adhere to requirements such as Alberta Reliability Standard including Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) and Operational and Planning (O&P), Information Security Management System (ISO 27001 & 27019), and CSC
Utilize existing processes and procedures, propose improvements, and implement new processes and procedures
Monitor EMS/SCADA system performance and applications to optimize performance and identify opportunities for improvement
Implement changes in the EMS/SCADA and associated system which may include network infrastructure (i.e. firewalls, routers, switches) or applications (i.e. OS, SolarWinds, Tripwire)
Test and commission new SCADA Remotes or points to the system
Regularly scheduled standby duties to support the EMS 24/7
Demonstrate key behaviors and meet identified expectations outlined in our four cultural pillars - one team, continuous improvement, customer focus and personal accountability.


Requirements


A diploma or degree in Information Technology, Telecom, Electronics, or Electrical Technology
Minimum of one year experience in an EMS or data centre environment
Proven ability/experience in the above noted responsibilities
Previous experience supporting high availability mission critical systems and Real Time SCADA Systems.
Previous experience with ticketing systems such as Change Gear and Service Now
Demonstrated fundamental experience with cyber security best practices
A systematic approach to task completion, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Strong attention to detail, self-motivated, and takes initiative to pursue goals
Strong written communications skills and documentation experience in creating process and procedure
Good verbal communication skills are required as this position is often in contact with other support team members, field operators and outside contractors
Effective interpersonal skills to interface with team members and customers to promote positive customer outcomes
Creative problem solving coupled with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced high-pressure environment
Demonstrated experience with hyperconverged infrastructure; experience with VMWare and VXRail is preferred
Demonstrated experience in networking and security equipment; experience with Palo Alto, Cisco, and RSA is preferred
Working experience with enterprise applications such as Tripwire Enterprise, Tripwire Log Center, Cyberark and Trellix suite of tools would be an asset
Demonstrated experience with SQL Databases
Demonstrated experience with hardware platforms such as Dell, HP, Lenovo
Demonstrated experience with scripting with Powershell, batch files, wmi queries
Working experience in Windows support systems, such as Active directory, patch management and deployment of software, and system builds, WSUS,
Working knowledge of Linux Operating Systems and associated support tools.
Must be able to perform regular standby duties including weeknights, weekends and holidays
Proven track record of good attendance and performance

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
About Highspring

Highspring is a next-generation consulting and professional services firm. We deliver modern, agile, and forward-thinking solutions to our clients across North America. We work with some of the most innovative organizations in financial services, technology, and enterprise industries to help them solve complex business and technology challenges. At Highspring, we believe in empowering our people, fostering technical leadership, and delivering measurable business impact.




The Opportunity

Highspring is seeking a Database Engineer to join a high-performing team responsible for enterprise-scale database platforms and data infrastructure. This role is ideal for a technology professional who is passionate about data, database performance, and platform modernization.

You will contribute to the engineering, optimization, and evolution of large-scale transactional database environments while supporting strategic modernization initiatives involving cloud technologies and next-generation data platforms. The position offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with technical and business stakeholders, participate in architectural discussions, and influence the future direction of critical data services.




What You’ll Do

Engineer and support enterprise database platforms across large database estates, including Sybase, DB2, and emerging database technologies.
Analyze and optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, workload analysis, and capacity planning.
Design, test, and implement database changes with a strong focus on resiliency, quality, and operational excellence.
Participate in database modernization and migration initiatives, including transitions toward platforms such as Snowflake and SingleStore where applicable.
Perform database version upgrades, patching activities, and platform lifecycle management.
Improve operational readiness through automation, standardization, and process optimization.
Support database deployment and distribution strategies across cloud-based environments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile delivery model while balancing speed, stability, and governance.
Contribute to technical discussions, architecture reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Partner with geographically distributed teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions.




What You Bring to the Table

Passion for data technologies and database engineering.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative mindset with a willingness to share ideas and actively listen to others.
High degree of ownership, accountability, and professional integrity.
Self-motivated learner with a strong interest in expanding both technical and business knowledge.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, Agile environment.




Core Skills Required

Intermediate knowledge of major relational database platforms, including Sybase and DB2.
Experience or strong interest in modern data platforms such as Snowflake and SingleStore.
Strong Python scripting skills for automation, diagnostics, tooling, and data utilities.
Working knowledge of Unix/Linux operating systems.
Database performance tuning and optimization expertise.
Understanding of database resiliency, scalability, and operational best practices.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.




Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of logical and physical data modeling concepts.
Understanding of normalization and dimensional modeling techniques.
Experience with Git or other version control systems.
Familiarity with data replication technologies, including CDC, transactional replication, and streaming-based architectures.
Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban.
CI/CD mindset and experience supporting database delivery practices.
Experience collaborating within geographically distributed teams.




Our Stack

Databases: Sybase, DB2, Snowflake, SingleStore
Programming & Automation: Python
Operating Systems: Unix, Linux
Version Control: Git
Data Technologies: CDC, Transactional Replication, Streaming-Based Data Patterns
Delivery Frameworks: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, CI/CD
Cloud & Platform Engineering: Cloud-based database deployment, automation, and standardization




Why Join Highspring

Work alongside highly skilled consultants and technology professionals on mission-critical initiatives.
Contribute to large-scale, enterprise-grade data platform modernization projects.
Participate in innovative cloud and database transformation programs.
Access continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Collaborate in a supportive, team-oriented culture that values technical excellence and innovation.
Make a direct impact on the performance, reliability, and evolution of business-critical data platforms.

Title: Excel Specialist - Remote
Description:
Job Description

Role Title: Excel Specialist

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Scope Of Work


Design and simulate challenging, realistic business scenarios that require expert-level use of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, mirroring tasks from your professional experience.
Engage in structured, multi-turn conversations with an LLM, presenting complex document-related prompts and evaluating AI-generated deliverables.
Create and review Office documents (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx), assessing two AI-generated solutions against professional standards and selecting the preferred output.
Document feedback and provide detailed, side-by-side preference data to inform AI model improvements, focusing on quality, accuracy, and business relevance.
Contribute domain-specific insight across multiple industries and business functions, ensuring the data collected covers diverse, real-world use cases.
Communicate clearly and thoughtfully in both written and verbal formats to ensure precise understanding and actionable feedback for the AI training team.

Minimum 3+ years of professional experience working in Fortune 500 environments using Excel, PowerPoint, and Word on high-impact business projects.
Demonstrated expertise in creating complex models, reports, analyses, and presentations across various industries such as finance, healthcare, tech, consulting, or retail.
Background in business roles such as private equity associate, investment banking analyst, junior consultant, FP&A analyst, HR, or marketing strategist, with hands-on involvement in deal or project work.
Proficiency in designing use cases reflecting functions like strategy, operations, sales, marketing, finance, or HR.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and clarity in articulating feedback.
Experience interacting with LLMs or writing long-form prompts for AI tools is a strong plus.
Strong analytical mindset and ability to evaluate nuanced differences in document quality and business applicability.
