Title: Data & Research Lead
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Research Strategic Lead will lead the systems and processes used to manage Canopy's data, research, and technical knowledge.

The role coordinates research across the Impact team, sets standards for data quality and governance, spearheads seminal research projects, and oversees development of tools that support program strategy, partner engagement, and thought leadership. This role translates academic research and modelling into accessible findings for corporate decision-makers, and manages a team plus external researchers and technical specialists.

Key Responsibilities


Drive Canopy's research and knowledge systems program, reinforcing Canopy as a trusted solutions partner and leader in low-carbon and Next Gen materials
Develop and maintain a shared architecture connecting Canopy's core datasets, research, technical knowledge, source documentation, and decision tools
Coordinate research needs across the Impact team, including surveys, audits, market/policy research, and commissioned studies
Organize information from spreadsheets, PDFs, APIs, public datasets, field research, and expert input into documented, reusable resources
Establish standards for source tracking, quality assurance, version control, access, confidentiality, and responsible AI use
Manage a roadmap for dashboards, maps, calculators, and other decision-support tools based on campaign needs and user feedback
Work with subject-matter experts to capture scientific, technical, and market knowledge and convert it into accessible tools/assets
Lead the underlying data, analysis, methods, and citations behind public reports and external outputs
Introduce AI-enabled workflows where they improve research, analysis, or knowledge management, with appropriate human review and safeguards
Train colleagues on relevant systems and tools; maintain clear documentation
Manage a team and oversee external researchers, data specialists, and consultants


First-Year Priorities


Document and organize Canopy's priority datasets, including ownership, sources, and update cycles
Establish shared standards for data quality, provenance, confidentiality, and AI-supported analysis
Introduce a coordinated process for commissioning and managing research across the Impact team
Develop and begin implementing a prioritized roadmap for internal data and decision-support tools
Improve capture and use of technical knowledge related to Next Generation materials and regional cohort development
Strengthen data and research workflows supporting Canopy's major reports and external outputs
Establish a thought leadership content calendar with the Communications Director
Partner with senior Impact team members on marquee thought leadership and campaign assets, including tools, reports, and op-eds


Qualifications — Essential


Experience leading complex data, research, or knowledge-management systems across multiple teams
Experience developing or managing data products, dashboards, research platforms, or decision-support tools
Strong knowledge of data governance: source tracking, QA, documentation, permissions, version control, confidentiality
Ability to commission, manage, and synthesize work from external researchers, data specialists, and subject-matter experts
Working fluency with AI-enabled research/analysis tools, with sound judgment on validation, security, and appropriate use
Ability to communicate complex data and evidence clearly to non-specialist audiences
Ability to judge when a new tool improves a decision/workflow versus when a simpler approach suffices
Experience managing staff, consultants, or technical partners
A sense of humour


Qualifications — Desirable


Experience with geospatial data, supply-chain mapping, data visualization, or decision-support tools
Knowledge of forest, fibre, paper, packaging, textile, or agricultural residue/materials supply chains
Scientific or technical experience in environmental science, carbon, biodiversity, materials, circular economy, or industrial decarbonization
Experience supporting public research and major reports
Familiarity with survey, audit, market-research, life-cycle assessment, or policy-analysis methods
Experience in a nonprofit, advocacy, or market-transformation organization


This role includes occasional domestic and international travel. Flexibility in working hours is important to support collaboration across time zones with Canopy's global partners.

How To Apply

Submit a CV, cover letter, and a separate response to the prompt below. Applications missing either the cover letter or the prompt response will not be considered.

On AI use: AI tools may be used to brainstorm, edit, or proofread, but not to write the cover letter or prompt response itself — we want your voice and perspective. If AI was used for minor editing, add a short note at the end of your response (e.g., "I used [tool name] to proofread this response").

Cover Letter: A standard cover letter expressing interest in Canopy and this role.

Prompt Response (include as a clearly labelled section in your cover letter document):

Canopy Holds a Carbon-footprint Dataset Covering 14 Fibre Feedstocks Across 8 Regions, Compiled From Multiple LCA Studies With Different System Boundaries, Reference Years, And Time Horizons (20 And 100 Years). A Campaign Director Wants To Publish a Public-facing Comparison Chart Showing "Next Gen Fibres Vs Virgin Wood Pulp" Within Three Weeks. In No More Than 500 Words, Address


What you would need to verify before this data goes public
How you would present the comparison credibly given the inconsistencies
Whether you would recommend a static chart, an interactive tool, or something simpler — and why


Canopy is committed to an inclusive, accessible recruitment process. Let us know if you require accommodations at any stage.

Canopy embraces equity and diversity and is committed to a workplace enriched by the people, needs, and desires of our diverse community. We thank all applicants; only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Participate in the promotion of Alimentiv as a global research organization, by contributing to the development, publishing, and reporting of project data. Please note we are hiring for multiple positions at this time.

Description:
Job Title: SENIOR SNOWFLAKE ENGINEER




Hirematic Talent Solutions is hiring on behalf of a confidential client for an experienced Senior Snowflake Engineer to help build, enhance, and operate a modern enterprise data platform centered on Snowflake.




This role requires a highly experienced Data Engineer with strong expertise in ETL/ELT development, Snowflake data pipelines, SQL, Python, and scalable data engineering solutions. The successful candidate will combine advanced Snowflake development, data architecture, and platform engineering to deliver performant, secure, and governed data products, developer utilities, and Snowflake-based applications that enable analytics and data products across the business.




Candidates must have experience within the FinTech or Payments domain.




Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada (Onsite – 5 Days/Week)

Compensation: CAD $53/hour

Job Type: Full-Time Contract

Experience: 10+ Years

Reports To: Director, Data and AI




Responsibilities

Title: Junior Support Role - Abandonment Engineering
Description:
VERSATILITY. EXPERTISE.

With these two words, Vertex makes the promise that we will always be versatile in developing solutions to our clients’ unique needs and that we will always demonstrate expertise in our designated fields.

Since 1962, Vertex has been a leading North American provider of environmental services. With over 60 years of expertise, Vertex helps clients achieve their development goals through our versatile suite of services. From the initial site selection, consultation and regulatory approval, through the construction, operation and maintenance phases, to conclusion and environmental cleanup, Vertex offers a diverse range of services throughout the life cycle of our clients’ projects.

Overview

The Junior Abandonment Engineering Support role provides technical and administrative assistance to the engineering team in the planning and execution of well abandonment projects. Working under the supervision of senior engineers and project managers, this position develops a strong understanding of AER regulatory requirements, well integrity, and asset retirement while contributing to the successful delivery of closure programs.

Candidate Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Geoscience, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
EIT designation or eligibility for registration with APEGA is considered an asset.
TT designation or eligibility for registration with ASET is considered an asset.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
Experience with programming and automation, particularly Python, for engineering applications and data analysis.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and experience with advanced formulas or VBA is considered an asset.
Familiarity with industry software such as geoSCOUT, AccuMap, Petrinex, and AER OneStop is considered an asset.
Eagerness to learn Alberta well abandonment regulations, engineering practices, and emerging technologies.


Responsibilities


Assist in the preparation of well abandonment programs in accordance with AER directives and industry best practices.
Review well files, drilling and completion records, production history, and offset well data.
Identify formation tops, porous zones, and protected intervals using geological and well log data.
Prepare regulatory applications, technical reports, engineering assessments, and supporting documentation.
Support project scheduling, cost tracking, and contractor coordination.
Maintain project databases and ensure accurate record keeping.
Assist with quality assurance reviews of field reports, pressure tests, cementing operations, and abandonment documentation.
Provide engineering support during field operations as required.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and the development of engineering standards, procedures, and automation tools.
Utilize programming and automation, particularly Python, to improve engineering workflows, analyze data, automate repetitive tasks, and develop internal tools where applicable.


LOCATION


This position is based out of Calgary.
Vertex allows a hybrid structure for working from home.
The position is permanent and Full-time (40hrs/week)


Additional Information


Compensation is commensurate with education and experience
A comprehensive benefit package is provided


APPLY NOW

With a track record of success, Vertex provides a fast-paced environment where people thrive. We recognize that each member brings a valuable skill set to the Vertex team and we make health, safety and community well-being a priority by supporting numerous endeavors at each of our locations across North America.

At Vertex, we value teamwork through collaboration and provide support across the entire organization.


We would like to thank all applicants for their interest in this position, however only those selected for interviews will be contacted*

Title: Jr Application Support / Network Intern
Description:
We are hiring for this position out of our Vancouver office. Successful candidates who apply outside of these areas will be expected to relocate and reside in a location that is within a commutable distance.

This a 6 month Fixed Term opportunity (with potential to convert to full-time employment).

The regular schedule will primarily consist of weekday shifts and one weekend day per week. Most shifts will be scheduled from 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM, with occasional weekday shifts from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. Flexibility to work both daytime and evening hours is required.

About The Role

As a SMOC Intern, you'll play an important role in maintaining the stability and reliability of critical technology services by monitoring alerts, triaging incidents, and supporting operational processes within the Security & Monitoring Operations Centre. Working alongside experienced team members, you'll gain hands-on exposure to enterprise monitoring tools, incident management practices, and operational support procedures in a fast-paced technology environment.

In your first 30 to 90 days, you'll build proficiency with monitoring platforms, alert prioritization and escalation procedures, and shift handover processes, progressing toward independently managing day-to-day monitoring queues and incident triage activities. Success in this role is measured through key operational metrics, including timely acknowledgement of critical and high-priority alerts and consistent completion of shift handover documentation.

You'll also play a vital role during major incidents by ensuring the appropriate response process is initiated quickly and accurately. This includes assessing incident priority, coordinating communications, opening incident bridge calls, and engaging the appropriate on-call resources to support incident resolution. Rather than acting as the primary resolver, you'll help facilitate a rapid and effective response by ensuring the right teams are engaged at the right time.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to launch a career in IT operations, infrastructure, network operations, cybersecurity, or incident management while developing highly sought-after skills in a supportive, team-oriented environment.

About The Day-to-day


Complete shift start procedures within the first 15 minutes, including reviewing the outgoing operator's handover log and verifying access to all required tools (Datadog, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, MS Teams).
Perform the shift-start Datadog health check across infrastructure, network performance, and APM service maps to confirm system status.
Continuously monitor PagerDuty, Datadog, and ServiceNow queues and escalations from other teams.
Acknowledge PagerDuty alerts within the SLA and begin triage immediately.
Follow documented runbooks to triage incidents, confirming or adjusting priority based on observed business impact rather than the automated score alone.
For confirmed critical incidents, follow the System Monitoring Procedure.
Document incident timelines, findings, and actions accurately and within required timeframes.
Complete the shift handover log and confirm handover with the incoming operator before ending a shift, ensuring open incidents, watch items, and notes are clearly documented.
The regular schedule will primarily consist of weekday shifts and one weekend day per week. Most shifts will be scheduled from 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM, with occasional weekday shifts from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. Flexibility to work both daytime and evening hours is required.

About The Qualifications


Bachelor's degree (or recent graduate) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
Coursework, labs, internships, or personal projects involving system monitoring, IT support, or networking are a plus.
Familiarity with monitoring and incident management tools such as Datadog, PagerDuty, or ServiceNow is a plus, but not required.
Comfort following structured runbooks and documented procedures, with the discipline to follow defined escalation steps.
Basic knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python) for automation and alert setup.
Foundational understanding of networking concepts, operating systems (Windows, Linux), and security principles.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, particularly when confirming incident priority against observed impact.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document incident timelines and handover notes accurately under time pressure.
Willingness to work rotating shifts, including evenings, weekends, or overnight coverage as required.


About Us

Peoples Group is a trusted financial services company for the innovators at the forefront of Canada’s economic future. With offices in Vancouver, Calgary and Toronto, we are driving change by working alongside challenger banks, fintechs, brokers, and merchants to foster a dynamic and competitive financial ecosystem.

Our culture is built on four core behaviors: Grit to Grow, Connect to Collaborate, Putting Clients First, and Owning the Outcome. We believe people do not simply choose a company to work for—they choose a company that makes a positive impact in the lives of Canadians. Above all, we value people, build meaningful relationships, focus on individual strengths, and approach our work with passion.

About The Work Environment

Peoples Group offers a flexible and hybrid work environment. In this role you will work a combination of in-office and remotely from home. Typically, you'll be working regular business hours, Monday to Friday between 8:00am and 4:30pm with flexibility around start/end times.

We Offer


A hybrid work environment, enabling you to balance your personal and professional life seamlessly.
A commitment to your well-being in five key areas: Financial, Physical, Social, Career, and Community.


Hiring Process

If your application is selected, you will be invited for a first interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Business Partners. Depending on the role, interviews may be conducted virtually or in-person. The hiring team will communicate any in-person requirements throughout the process.

Compensation

The expected pay for this role is approximately $27-$28 hourly. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

NOTE: This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Peoples Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Please accept our utmost appreciation for your interest; however, only those applicants under consideration will be contacted.

We value and celebrate individuality while fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. If there's any way we can support or accommodate you during the selection process, please don't hesitate to let us know.

Title: Administrative Assistant II, General
Description:
Company Description

UHN is Canada’s #1 hospital and the world’s #1 publicly funded hospital. With 10 sites and more than 44,000 TeamUHN members, UHN consists of Toronto General Hospital, Toronto Western Hospital, Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, Toronto Rehabilitation Institute, The Michener Institute of Education and West Park Healthcare Centre. As Canada's top research hospital, the scope of biomedical research and complexity of cases at UHN have made it a national and international source for discovery, education and patient care. UHN has the largest hospital-based research program in Canada, with major research in neurosciences, cardiology, transplantation, oncology, surgical innovation, infectious diseases, genomic medicine and rehabilitation medicine. UHN is a research hospital affiliated with the University of Toronto.

UHN’s vision is to build A Healthier World and it’s only because of the talented and dedicated people who work here that we are continually bringing that vision closer to reality.

www.uhn.ca

Shifts: Days

Join UHN's Laboratory Medicine Program, Canada's largest hospital diagnostic lab and a global leader in academic labs. Embrace innovation and contribute to ground-breaking research, education, and exemplary service. Join our dynamic team of 700 dedicated staff and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of laboratory medicine.

As a valued member of TeamLMP, you will play a key role exercising judgment and independence in the performance of administrative activities.

Utilizing knowledge of medical terminology and advanced functions to provide word processing/typing services to facilitate the production of moderate and/or complex documents/materials for assigned personnel
Performing reception responsibilities
Maintaining written and/or electronic calendar/schedule
Administering and monitoring billing procedures and departmental budgeting records
Modifying and maintaining electronic and paper information filing/retrieval methods, systems and/or formats



Qualifications


Completion of Grade XII (12) or recognized equivalent
Completion of a recognized medical or business post secondary secretarial arts program at the diploma level
Three (3) years related secretarial support experience
Previous on-the-job computer/word-processing, database and spreadsheet software experience
Experience in a Microsoft Office environment
Experience working in a health care environment, an asset
Experience with Epic, preferred

Why join UHN?

In addition to working alongside some of the most talented and inspiring healthcare professionals in the world, UHN offers a wide range of benefits, programs and perks. Competitive offer packages
Government organization and a member of the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP https://hoopp.com/)
Close access to Transit and UHN shuttle service
A flexible work environment
Opportunities for development and promotions within a large organization

Job Description

Role Title: Powerpoint Specialist

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Scope Of Work


Design and initiate realistic, complex business tasks relevant to professional PowerPoint, Excel, and Word use, simulating scenarios from Fortune 500 environments.
Collaborate with an advanced language model (LLM) to discuss, edit, and create Office Open XML files, especially focusing on .pptx formats.

Minimum 3+ years of recent experience working on complex projects within Fortune 500 companies or top-tier consultancies.
Advanced skills in PowerPoint, with significant exposure to Excel and Word, and a strong track record in professional business document creation and review.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute projects in sectors such as finance, healthcare, consulting, tech, or retail and across functions like strategy, operations, sales, marketing, finance, or HR.
Experience crafting realistic business scenarios and workflows for use in modeling, reporting, and executive presentations.
Comfortable communicating in-depth, both in writing and verbally, and adept at formulating clear, actionable feedback.
Prior engagement with LLMs or AI-powered tools is highly desirable, especially in iterative, conversational formats.
Titles such as private equity associate, investment banking analyst, consultant, FP&A analyst, HR professional, or marketing strategist are a strong fit for this opportunity.

Choosing BDC As Your Employer Also Means


Flexible and competitive benefits, including an Employee Savings and Investment Plan where BDC matches part of your voluntary contributions, a Defined Benefit Pension Plan, a $750 wellness and health care spending account, to name a few
In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1
A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life
Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more...


Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book

Position Overview

At BDC, the only bank dedicated exclusively to Canadian entrepreneurs, your work contributes directly to the success of small and medium-sized businesses across Canada. As a KYC Analyst, you will provide administrative and analytical support to the Financing team by managing the Know Your Client (KYC) process for loan applications. You will review client files, gather and analyze KYC documentation, identify potential compliance concerns, and work closely with the Business Development Lead (BDL) and Underwriter to ensure complete and accurate submissions. At BDC, we value inclusion, equity, and diversity, and you can be yourself at work.

CHALLENGES TO BE MET


Lead the KYC process from end to end, ensuring the timely collection, review, analysis, and validation of required KYC documentation.
Review customer files to understand the overall financing request and identify missing information or documentation.
Analyze KYC information and documentation to identify potential non-compliance issues, risks, or concerns.
Escalate KYC-related findings and concerns to the Business Development Lead (BDL) as required.
Follow up directly with clients to obtain required information and documentation.
Manage multiple KYC files simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
Collaborate closely with the Business Development Lead, Underwriter, and internal partners to ensure all KYC requirements are met.
Submit complete and error-free KYC documentation in accordance with established policies, procedures, and standards.
Provide timely, accurate, and professional service to existing and prospective clients.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
Stay up to date on changes to KYC policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and industry trends that may impact BDC.
Support BDC's commitment to delivering a high-quality experience to Canadian entrepreneurs.


Required Qualifications

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field.
Ability to analyze and interpret financial statements.
Strong business acumen.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional attention to detail.
Client service orientation with the ability to listen, identify issues, and support resolution.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including:
Microsoft Word
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft Outlook
Ability to review, analyze, and validate KYC documentation and information.
Availability to work on-site a minimum of three (3) days per week.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting KYC (Know Your Client), compliance, anti-money laundering (AML), customer due diligence (CDD), or lending-related processes.
Experience working in a financial services, banking, lending, or commercial financing environment.
Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration skills.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
Creative problem-solving skills.
Bilingualism in English and French


Locations: Calgary, Regina, Winnipeg, Edmonton, Saskatoon.

Title: Technical Support Specialist
Description:
The Langley School District is situated on the traditional unceded territories of the Matsqui, Kwantlen, Katzie, and Semiahmoo First Nations. At Langley School District, we prioritize student success through a holistic approach to education, valuing both academic achievement and personal growth. Our dedicated team of educators, support staff, and administrators work collaboratively to create dynamic learning experiences that inspire curiosity, critical thinking, and creativity.

Joining our team means becoming part of a supportive community that celebrates diversity, innovation, and collaboration. Whether you're a seasoned educator or embarking on your journey in the field of education, Langley School District offers ample opportunities for professional growth and development.

This position will be responsible for intermediate level technical support at a secondary school. At times this position will also be assigned to special projects that require a routine set of instructions to be followed towards the completion of the project. This position will report to the Manager, Technical Services.

POSTING DETAILS


Position - Technical Support Specialist 1
Start Date - As soon as possible
Employment - Permanent, Full-time (40 hrs/wk)
Hours - Monday to Friday (7:30am to 4:00pm)


Duties And Responsibilities


Provides technical support to end users in the form of troubleshooting and fixing problems related to Windows and Macintosh computers, tablets, printers, mobile and peripheral devices.
Installs and configures basic desktop applications, desktop images and provides application support.
Maintains user accounts on Active Directory including basic administration on File, Print and Application Servers as designated.
Troubleshoots Internet connectivity issues and minor network and wireless problems.
Writes basic instructions for end users when necessary.
Maintains relevant technical documentation when changes are implemented.
When assigned to special projects, follows instructions set by the Manager.
Uses an Incident Management System/ Work Order System.
Liaises and collaborates with team members, stakeholders and user groups to discuss technology enhancements or changes required.
Performs other assigned comparable duties which are within the scope of knowledge, skills and abilities required by this class specification.


Required Qualifications


High School Diploma plus a two-year Diploma in a relevant Information Technology track or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
Four years' experience in the technology department of a complex environment supporting a large and varied user base.
Ability to use good judgment and initiative in identifying, adapting, and applying procedures and approaches to resolve problems.
Ability to communicate effectively in the explanation and clarification of information both verbally and in writing.
Demonstrated evidence of sound interpersonal skills with a positive customer-oriented attitude.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Physical ability to perform the required duties.
Valid B.C. driver's license.


For your application to be considered, all required documents must be included:


Resume
Email addresses for a minimum of three references (ideally, former supervisors from your most recent/relevant role)
Proof of completion of Grade 12 / graduation from high school (or completion of other post-secondary education)
Scanned copy of your valid BC Driver’s license
Recent copy of your driver’s abstract/history (obtained from ICBC)
Copies of any relevant post-secondary certificates


PLEASE NOTE


In accordance with the Criminal Record Review Act, successful applicants will be required to consent to a Criminal Record Check prior to employment.

Description:
Description

Position at Dynacare

Job Posting: Forensic Technologist

Where YOU work, makes a difference.

Life is precious and every moment matters. Dynacare is helping Canadians achieve a healthy future with care and wellness solutions that are convenient, understandable, and accessible. When you join our team, every day is an opportunity to get better and be inspired. It’s an environment where you can grow your career in any direction you choose. We’re evolving our technology and optimizing our processes, so you can do your best work, make a meaningful impact, and thrive.

Are YOU our next Forensic Technologist ?

We’re looking for a Forensic Technologist to join our Toxicology team in London, Ontario. You will be responsible for performing extraction and/or data pulling of various laboratory tests following standard operating procedures. Ensures quality control and performance checks and standards are run as required. Operates and maintains laboratory equipment as appropriate. Participates in all quality assurance programs and ensures company and external regulatory bodies’ policies are observed.

Status: Contract Full Time (18 months)

Vacancy Type: Existing

Shift: Rotational shifts, Monday through Saturday, 1:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.

Hours per week: 37.5

Discipline: Toxicology

Work Style: Onsite

Location: 245 Pall Mall St, London, Ontario

Internal Posting Deadline: August 6, 2026

Why Dynacare Is An Amazing Place For YOU


Join an award-winning "Top Employer" with meaningful and impactful career opportunities
Access a health and wellness benefits program that supports you and your loved ones
Grow and thrive with a dynamic, successful company through internal mobility opportunities
Invest in your future through RRSP match benefits and an employee stock purchase program
Experience a collaborative, diverse workforce that prioritizes dignity and respect for all


How YOU Will Make a Difference


Perform extractions of the drugs using a variety of chemicals
Pull data from GC/MS and/or LC/MS/MS, Headspace GC, and check for flagged abnormalities, run repeat or additional testing according and established guidelines
Operate equipment, monitoring operating, reviewing results before handing the batches to the Certifying Scientist
Ensure sample ID and preparation are correct before commencing testing
Ensure chain of custody and the accuracy of documents are maintained
Responsible to preserve and safeguard all confidential information
As directed, prepare for regular accreditation inspections; communicate and cooperate with inspectors
Provide testimony in legal procedures if required
Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis based on application and outcome of specified criteria
Ensure all inquiries and problems are handled in a courteous and professional manner
Ensure an adequate amount of supplies are on hand and that validated standards and quality controls to be used are in date order
Require entry of results into company’s databases
Required to accurately pipette samples, adding specified standards and controls according to set test methods
Set up and adjust laboratory equipment by calibration of instrument and performing quality control according to established guidelines
Provide routine basic care, perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting
Assist in validation/reverification plans authorized by the RP or designate
Observe, report and document malfunctions in equipment and maintain required log-books for routine equipment maintenance
Responsible to follow all relevant pre and/or post analytical QA protocols as described in the company QA manual


What YOU Bring To The Role


Bachelor’s Degree in relevant fields
2 years of relevant experience required
Experience working in Toxicology considered an asset
Ability to work unsupervised
Ability to perform under pressure, multi-task while ensuring the integrity of the test results in a fast-paced environment
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide recommendations for resolution.
Proficiency in MS-Office Word, Excel, and Outlook at an intermediate level
Demonstrated high level of interpersonal skills required to succeed in a collaborative working environment
Demonstrated ability to self-manage and prioritize in a results-driven environment


Working Conditions


Forensic Toxicology Laboratory environment
Perform duties in stationary standing/sitting positions with repetitive fine motor movement of hands
High visual requirements
Ability to lift up to 45 lbs. (pounds)
Exposure to biohazard materials, fumes, chemicals, and noise
Shift work required


Pay rate: $28.00-$30.50 per hour

Title: Community Librarian
Company: The Corporation of the County of Lambton
Description:
Division: Cultural Services

Job Status: Full Time

Number of Positions: 1

Closing Date: Monday, August 3, 2026

Location: Region 2 Libraries (Forest, Grand Bend, Arkona, Thedford, Port Franks, and Watford)

About Us

The County of Lambton is located in Southwestern Ontario, nestled along Lake Huron and the St. Clair River, next to the state of Michigan and is home to a diverse and welcoming population of approximately 128,000 residents.

The Corporation of the County of Lambton is one of the area’s largest employers with approximately 1,300 employees. The County’s seven divisions deliver hundreds of services and programs to our residents, such as emergency medical services, provincial offences court, three long-term care homes, 25 library branches, three museums, an art gallery, archives, public works, public health services, social services, planning and building services.

We are committed to sustainability, economic growth, environmental stewardship and an enhanced quality of life through the provision of responsive and efficient services and collaborative efforts with our municipal and community partners.

About The Role

As a member of the Lambton County Library system, the Community Librarian is responsible for providing front line customer service to visitors of Lambton County Library and support services to staff members. In addition to promoting a welcoming and inviting library environment, the Community Librarian will develop, plan, coordinate and provide outreach programs inside in the library and throughout the local community. This will be accomplished by liaising with the community to help determine programming needs, often in collaboration with Public Services Coordinators. The Community Librarian will also provide specialized programming inside the library and provide training to library staff. The Community Librarian is responsible for delivering a library service that meets the strategic direction set forth by senior management and Lambton County Council.

Duties

Job Duties & Responsibilities


Organize and deliver programs, outreach and partnership opportunities with organizations, groups, agencies businesses and other stakeholders in collaboration with Public Services Coordinators, Technical Librarian, and Library Supervisors, to increase the use of library resources and services in response to the current and future needs of the community
Collaborate with Public Services Coordinators, Technical Librarian, Library Operations Supervisor, and Library Supervisor(s) to accomplish strategic initiatives in alignment with library goals and objectives
Assist in identifying community needs, trends and demographics
Provide in-depth information and readers' advisory services to the public
Provide reference services to library patrons
Promote reading and lifelong learning in the community
Deliver presentations within the library and the community, along with library tours, orientations and class visits
Seek opportunities to promote library services through presentations, membership on appropriate committees and through participation in community events
Organize and deliver instructional programming to members of the public
Act as a professional librarian resource for Branch Assistants
Instruct the public and staff in the use of the catalogue and the library’s online resources
Deliver training to library staff
Provide coverage for Branch Assistants when required, undertaking those duties including circulation, administration, readers’ advisory, reference and programming
Maintain necessary corporate files in accordance with the County of Lambton's Records Retention By-law
Maintain necessary files and statistics as required
Conduct research, produce reports, as required
Apply circulation policies and procedures
Perform a wide variety of clerical tasks related to circulation and in support of borrowing and lending services using a variety of manual and automated systems


Customer Service / Communication Responsibilities


Represent the library effectively in the community
Interact pleasantly and courteously with the public, community partners and staff, promoting a harmonious workplace
Provide instructions or assistance to the public in the use of new technologies and / or electronic platforms


Other Job Tasks / Responsibilities


Ensure the effective use of the Integrated Library System (ILS)
Develop an understanding of electronic platforms and resources that can be used by patrons to enhance their library experience
May be required to travel to various facilities for purposes of employment.


General


Incumbents must keep up-to-date on all relevant legislation, collective bargaining agreements, County Policies and Procedures, etc. ensuring that these are implemented as prescribed
Incumbents must possess the physical ability to meet the duties and responsibilities of the job description and/or the requirements identified within the position's Physical Demands Analysis


These describe the general nature and level of work being performed by incumbents in this classification. They are not an exhaustive list of all job duties in the classification. Other duties may be assigned.

Supervision Requirements

Direct Supervision: None

Indirect Supervision: None

Functional Authority: None

What We Are Looking For

Minimum Formal Education


University Degree - Masters of Library and Information Science


Experience


Minimum six months in a service related job or previous volunteer work in a Library
Computer experience including Microsoft Office products, Outlook, Internet, electronic database, digital platforms, etc.
Interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills
Previous library experience, and experience using an Integrated Library System (ILS) an asset


Credentials


A satisfactory Police Vulnerable Sector Check and / or Police Information Check, as applicable

Title: Document Controller
Description:
Description

Our Major Projects group is currently looking to add a Document Controller to our growing team, based in Edmonton, AB, Calgary, AB or Markham, ON.

Reporting to the Project Manager, we are seeking a Document Controller who has knowledge and experience to manage the project document databases, including the collection, digitization, classification and loading of critical project documents and fundamental project information, with accurate and timely transmission and distribution.

Duties And Responsibilities


Communicate with client contacts regarding document control and DDM requirements
Liaise with both internal and external customers in a timely and professional manner
Manage the client DDM system on behalf of Valard
Ensure correct electronic format, metadata and filing of all project documents
Ensure project documents are transmitted and distributed correctly in an efficient manner
Perform regular quality checks of the project databases for accuracy
Identify and report any deficiencies in the DDM system, documents and procedures
Assist the project team with the DDM systems (access, training, troubleshooting)
Assist the project team in locating documents and/ or related information
Communicate with internal and external helpdesks pertaining to any DDM system issues
Offer suggestions for improvements in processes and system functionality
Create project information (summaries, status updates, reports, instructions) as requested
Administrative duties to assist the project team


Requirements


5+ years of experience in managing project documentation in an engineering or construction environment
Post-secondary education in a related field
Working knowledge of various databases, including implementation, development, training and troubleshooting
Highly proficient with the Microsoft Office suites of software
Highly proficient in data and document management systems
Experience with engineering/ construction document management


Preferred Skills / Qualifications


Specific experience with Aconex and SharePoint

Description:

Department: Government Reporting

This position is represented by the agreement between the Professional Staff Association and the University of Guelph

If you are a current employee of the University of Guelph you must apply on the internal Career Page in order to be considered as an internal applicant.

Career Opportunities (sapsf.com)

General Purpose

The Office of Institutional Research & Planning serve as advisers and consultants to the University of Guelph in academic activities and decision-making processes. Through quantitative analysis, collection and dissemination of data, we provide both academic and administrative departments in all aspects of planning, research, enrolment, and budget.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Manager Data Reporting, the Data Analyst provides on-going support for University-wide projects. This position is an integral part of a team, which supports the planning, policy formulation, and decision-making activities at University of Guelph. This position is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and compiling large amounts of complex information; analyzing requests for information and providing reliable quality information in a timely fashion. Duties include managing data, preparing reports, and conducting various analyses relating to all functional aspects of the University, including resources, enrolment, admissions/applications, courses, programs, program costs, tuition and fees, compensation, etc. In addition, this position is responsible for ensuring compliant reporting to both the federal and provincial governments. A comprehensive understanding of all university data systems/sources and how they relate to the projects at hand is required. Many of the work assignments and issues addressed are confidential and may only be disclosed at the executive level. A high level of discretion and confidentiality is required.

Requirements


Master’s degree in math, statistics or a field with emphasis on data analysis along with at least three years related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience;
High level of organizational skills along with the ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks in order to provide timely and accurate information in a client-focused environment. Required to prepare accurate reports for internal sources to help faculties, departments, and committees in decision-making;
Knowledge of in-depth programming and querying (e.g. used in the accessing of University databases in both a host and personal computing environment.)
Ability to work with complex sets of data and analyses and various data systems
Excellent quantitative, analytical and problem solving skills, and an aptitude for research and analysis
Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills along with sound professional judgement, tact and diplomacy;
Ability to co-ordinate the information elements of a project, including engaging other units, gathering of information sources and a communication plan
Ability to program and work in SAS, R, and SQL to write macros, perform queries, data analyses (e.g. means testing descriptive analyses) and basic data manipulation
Experience with PowerBI (preferred), and/or Tableau and Fabric
Must possess a high degree of commitment to the job, be highly motivated, and well organized to deal with a high volume of work


Employee Type: Regular

Position Number: 10927350

Classification: P&M FT- Band 04

Professional/Managerial Salary Bands

The target hiring salary for this position is minimum and up to 96% of midpoint for the salary grade.

This is a full-time perm position. 5 days/week onsite in Newmarket, ON. You will be getting paid hourly. Overtime (Remote) will be expected and compensated.

Reporting to the Lead Data Analyst, you will be responsible for managing data generated through their proprietary mobile applications, ensuring data quality, developing analytics and reporting tools, and supporting continuous improvements to their data environment.

Responsibilities


Manage, validate, and analyze data collected through the proprietary field reporting platform.
Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for both internal teams and utility clients.
Perform quality assurance on incoming datasets and investigate data inconsistencies or anomalies.
Utilize strong analytical analysis, using excel and other methods (excel capabilities are a requirement).

Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and clients to understand reporting requirements and implement data solutions.
Prepare data extracts and support integrations with external systems, including GIS and enterprise databases.
Train internal staff and clients on reporting tools and dashboard functionality.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.


Must Have


Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.


Nice To Have


Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics, turning raw retail data into trusted, scalable assets and the insights that bring them to life. As a collaborative member of our data team, you'll contribute to the data models that power solutions across the Roots business and help build the data products, semantic layers, and self-service tools that empower every team at Roots to access trusted data independently. Our data team is small and collaborative, meaning you'll wear multiple hats and have broad exposure across the business.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Support end-to-end data transformation, converting raw omnichannel source data (POS, e-commerce, inventory, CRM, and marketing) into clean, structured layers within Snowflake.
Contribute to the design and build of components of the Snowflake data mart, applying dimensional modelling best practices including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions, to help create reliable, performant data products that serve ad hoc analysis, BI dashboards, and AI data solutions.
Support Power BI report development end-to-end, from semantic model design to polished, publish-ready reports, giving commercial, merchandising, marketing, and finance teams self-service access to trusted data without analyst dependency.
Perform ad hoc analysis using SQL and Python directly in Snowflake to help answer pressing business questions, uncover trends, and deliver timely insights that inform planning, buying, and operational decisions.
Assist in maintaining data quality standards, including testing frameworks, pipeline alerting, and documentation, to help ensure the data mart is trustworthy and well-understood across the business.
Support the development and maintenance of Gen AI data solutions, including natural language interfaces enabling any business user to query the data mart in plain English.
Partner cross-functionally with merchandising, planning, marketing, and commercial teams to understand analytical needs and help translate them into scalable data products.
Participate in the continuous improvement of our data platform, contributing ideas around new tools, patterns, and AI capabilities that keep Roots ahead of the curve.


Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or an equivalent data analytics role.
Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL platforms, with Matillion or a similar cloud-native transformation tool preferred.
Proficiency building data models and dashboards with Power BI.
Solid understanding of dimensional modelling methodologies including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions.
Experience with version control using Git.
Familiarity with data quality practices including testing, documentation, and pipeline monitoring.
Exposure to Gen AI solutions such as Snowflake Cortex or Microsoft Fabric Copilot is preferred.
Retail or apparel industry experience across omnichannel environments is an asset.
Python proficiency for data transformation, ad hoc analysis, or automation is a plus.


At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

As a collaborative member of our data team, you'll contribute to the data models that power solutions across the Roots business and help build the data products, semantic layers, and self-service tools that empower every team at Roots to access trusted data independently. Our data team is small and collaborative, meaning you'll wear multiple hats and have broad exposure across the business.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support end-to-end data transformation, converting raw omnichannel source data (POS, e-commerce, inventory, CRM, and marketing) into clean, structured layers within Snowflake.
  • Contribute to the design and build of components of the Snowflake data mart, applying dimensional modelling best practices including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions, to help create reliable, performant data products that serve ad hoc analysis, BI dashboards, and AI data solutions.
  • Support Power BI report development end-to-end, from semantic model design to polished, publish-ready reports, giving commercial, merchandising, marketing, and finance teams self-service access to trusted data without analyst dependency.
  • Perform ad hoc analysis using SQL and Python directly in Snowflake to help answer pressing business questions, uncover trends, and deliver timely insights that inform planning, buying, and operational decisions.
  • Assist in maintaining data quality standards, including testing frameworks, pipeline alerting, and documentation, to help ensure the data mart is trustworthy and well-understood across the business.
  • Support the development and maintenance of Gen AI data solutions, including natural language interfaces enabling any business user to query the data mart in plain English.
  • Partner cross-functionally with merchandising, planning, marketing, and commercial teams to understand analytical needs and help translate them into scalable data products.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of our data platform, contributing ideas around new tools, patterns, and AI capabilities that keep Roots ahead of the curve.

Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or an equivalent data analytics role.
  • Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience with ELT/ETL platforms, with Matillion or a similar cloud-native transformation tool preferred.
  • Proficiency building data models and dashboards with Power BI.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modelling methodologies including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Experience with version control using Git.
  • Familiarity with data quality practices including testing, documentation, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Exposure to Gen AI solutions such as Snowflake Cortex or Microsoft Fabric Copilot is preferred.
  • Retail or apparel industry experience across omnichannel environments is an asset.
  • Python proficiency for data transformation, ad hoc analysis, or automation is a plus.

At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

Make a difference by supporting and collaborating with a vibrant and creative community
Enjoy many options for workplace flexibility and work-life balance
Get involved in the rapidly changing creative space
Advocate for and empower the creative community
Together, we’ll help music creators earn more income and make a living

35-hour workweek schedule (possible flexible work options i.e., 4-day work week (position based)
Twelve paid sick days annually (including five personal days)
Access to SOCAN fitness facility
Annual Performance Incentive bonus (dependent on a personal and company performance)
Defined contribution Pension Plan
Comprehensive, health and dental benefits program
Inclusive and collaborative working environment

Work directly with data engineers, BI analysts, other data analysts, and business leaders to document reporting requirements and understand business processes and how they affect data.

Collaborate on the continuous development of interactive Databricks AI/BI dashboards and reports, designing and maintaining clear dashboards to communicate findings to various stakeholders.
Curate and document semantic layers to power natural language querying (Genie) for business users.
Participate in, and contribute towards daily standup meetings, project planning sessions, and retrospectives.
Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad hoc requests for data analysis.


Required

Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work on large data sets, while keeping the big picture in mind.
Strong SQL skills and intermediate Python. An understanding of Spark and distributed compute environments.
Experience and proficiency performing data analysis using Databricks or similar technologies (2+ years).
Strong communicator, with the ability to tackle loosely defined problems with a solution oriented mindset.
Business writing skills as well as the ability to create technical documentation, communicating clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Stats, Economics, Business Analytics) or equivalent experience.


Nice To Have


Passion & love for music.
Fluency in French


COMPETENCIES


Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
Emotionally intelligent
Commitment to Continuous Learning
Process Oriented

Title: Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
About Float

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

Our Product

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 7,500 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

AI Use in Our Hiring Process

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

About The Role

Float runs on data — and this role exists to make sure the business can see itself clearly.

As our Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, you'll be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the decisions that leadership, Finance, RevOps, and GTM teams make every day. This isn't a support queue role — it's a strategic BI function. You'll own our reporting layer: designing, building, and governing the dashboards, metrics, and self-serve tools that let Float's teams move faster and with more confidence.

You'll sit on the data team and work in close partnership with our Analytics Engineer, translating business questions into durable data products — not one-off answers. Where the analytics engineer builds the models and the pipelines, you build the intelligence layer on top: the dashboards, the metrics definitions, the reporting cadences, and the frameworks that turn clean data into business clarity.

You're also someone who is curious and treats AI as a genuine part of how you work — using it to move faster, build more, and stretch the bounds of what a data team can actually do.

You'll report to the Head of Data and partner closely with Finance, RevOps, GTM, Sales, and the Chief of Staff.

What You'll Be Doing


Design, build, and maintain Float's core dashboards and reporting infrastructure — audit for quality, assign ownership, archive stale content, and set the standard for what good looks like
Work closely with the Analytics Engineer to translate business requirements into data models — write clear specs, validate outputs, and drive metric definition alignment across stakeholders before anything gets built
Use AI as a force multiplier — not just for drafting SQL, but for building self-serve tooling, scaling analysis and making BI more accessible to non-technical stakeholders. You bring the business context that makes AI outputs actually useful, and you know where the guardrails need to go.
Define and maintain Float's authoritative metrics library — what they measure, how they're calculated, and who owns them; surface and resolve discrepancies when Finance and RevOps aren't working from the same number
Partner with the Chief of Staff and Head of Data on QBRs, board prep, and performance reporting; turn leadership questions into clean analysis, and run exploratory deep dives to answer specific questions
Build a self-serve BI environment that reduces dependence on the data team — verified dashboards, documented metrics, and Metabase collections that Finance, Ops, Support, and Sales can navigate without filing a ticket
Flag data model gaps and quality issues to the analytics engineer; help prioritize infrastructure work based on business impact


What Success Looks Like


Land and Stabilize: BI and metric governance has a clear DRI — existing dashboards have been audited for accuracy and relevance, every key metric and report has a named owner, and outdated content has been archived.
Build the Infrastructure: The BI environment is structured and trustworthy — dashboards are verified, collections are logically organized, and AI has been used to build or scale something the team couldn't have done with headcount alone.
Enable the Flywheel: Self-serve is meaningfully better and ad-hoc request volume reflects it. Leadership is making faster decisions because they have someone who understands both the data and the business context.


What We're Looking For


2–4+ years of experience as a BI or business analyst, ideally at a high-growth fintech or SaaS company
Strong SQL — CTEs, window functions, aggregations; you write clean queries and can explain them to a non-technical stakeholder
Deep experience in a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Sigma) — you've owned a BI environment.
Comfortable reading dbt models and understanding data lineage; prior dbt experience is not necessary but ability to contribute to dbt project is expected
Comfortable using AI tools as an accelerator — LLMs for SQL drafting, documentation, or structuring analysis; you know where they're useful and where they need guardrails
Structured thinker who turns ambiguous questions into clear analytical frames — and doesn't wait to be handed one. You spot what's worth investigating and drive it yourself.
Strong written communication — your analysis only lands if the narrative does
Proactive and collaborative — you share context before being asked and work with the analytics engineer, not around them
Genuinely curious about the business, not just the data
Experience supporting a senior audiences is a strong plus
Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse is a plus
Python experience is a plus, particularly for automation or analysis outside of SQL


Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

Why You Should Join


Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies
Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role
Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters


In Short

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

  • Structured thinker who turns ambiguous questions into clear analytical frames — and doesn't wait to be handed one. You spot what's worth investigating and drive it yourself.
  • Strong written communication — your analysis only lands if the narrative does
  • Proactive and collaborative — you share context before being asked and work with the analytics engineer, not around them
  • Genuinely curious about the business, not just the data
  • Experience supporting a senior audiences is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse is a plus
  • Python experience is a plus, particularly for automation or analysis outside of SQL

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

  • Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team
  • Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits
  • Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration
  • Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday
  • Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
  • Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

In Short

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Title: Analyst, BI & Data
Description:
Our culture lifts you up—there is no ego in the way. Our common purpose? We all want to win for our customers. We aim to always be evolving, dynamic, and ambitious. We believe in the power of genuine connections. Each employee is a part of what makes us unique on the market: agile and dedicated.

Time Type


Regular

Job Description


Role Overview

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence & Analytics team, you will bridge the gap between complex telecom data and strategic execution. Embedded in an agile environment, you will work across our core domains (Executive Metrics & Revenue, Sales & Marketing, or Operations) to support our growing base of 1.5M+ customers across Canada and the US.

Your mandate goes beyond traditional reporting. You will not only empower internal stakeholders with robust dashboards and deep-dive analyses but also pioneer the next generation of self-service analytics by developing and integrating Agentic AI tools (e.g., AI data assistants, automated insight agents) into our data ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities



Advanced Analytics & Solution Delivery
Translate Data into Value: Act as a trusted data advisor to internal squads, answering complex business questions regarding subscriber growth, churn, revenue assurance, and operational efficiency.
Modern Deliverables: Support internal customers by delivering outcomes through four primary channels:
Reports & Decks: High-impact, strategic deep-dives and executive summaries.
Interactive Tools: Traditional, robust dashboards that monitor health and performance.
Governed Self-Service Data: Design and provision certified, highly optimized, and well-documented datasets. This enables data-savvy power users across marketing and operations to safely build their own ad-hoc analyses without risking data integrity.
Agentic AI Solutions: Innovative AI-driven assistants or automated workflows that allow stakeholders to converse with data and fetch immediate insights.
Telecom Insights: Analyze heavy data workloads related to ARPU (Average Revenue Per User), CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), LTV, network utilization, and cross-border market dynamics (Quebec/Ontario vs. US).
AI & Data Product Innovation
Agentic AI Integration: Design, test, and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered tools that interface with our data layer to automate routine queries and democratize data access.
Modern BI Modeling: Build and optimize scalable data models specifically structured to feed both visual dashboards (Tableau) and AI/LLM interfaces.
Technical Execution & Agile Collaboration
Cloud Data Warehousing: Write complex, highly optimized SQL queries in Google BigQuery to extract, transform, and analyze massive telecom datasets.
Data Visualization: Design and maintain intuitive, high-performance dashboards in Tableau.
Agile Methodology: Actively participate in cross-functional marketing or operational squads (sprints, stand-ups, grooming) under the guidance of BI Chapter Leads.


Qualifications & Skills


Technical Toolkit


SQL Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Google BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses) handling massive data volumes.
Data Visualization: Strong portfolio of building actionable dashboards in Tableau.
AI & Automation (The Frontier): Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM APIs, or framework development (e.g., LangChain, custom AI agents) to build data-querying bots. Python skills are a major asset.
Data Modeling: Solid understanding of star schemas, data warehousing concepts, and preparing data for consumption by both humans and AI models.


Experience & Soft Skills



Experience: 3–5+ years in a Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Product role. Experience in Telecom or subscription-based industries is highly preferred.
Agile Mindset: Proven experience working inside agile squads and managing a backlog of analytical requests.
Consultative Approach: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical data jargon into clear business recommendations for North American stakeholders.
Language: Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset due to our market presence in Quebec, Ontario and USA.

The opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven analytics in the telecom sector.
A collaborative, mature agile environment with clear mentorship from dedicated Chapter Leads.
A modern tech stack (BigQuery, Tableau, GenAI tools) with the scale of 1.5 million customers to analyze.

Department: Retail Sales

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: English is required, French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

The Associate Data & Reporting Analyst contributes by enhancing and maintaining the ongoing operational and BAU tasks. You design (with support) and autonomously deliver data and reporting solutions that will help drive operational efficiency by ongoing examination of data and reporting workflows. You understand insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives. You communicate findings to colleagues and managers in an effective manner. With guidance from your manager, you communicate findings to a business audience.

How You Will Create Impact


Execute regularly scheduled operational and BAU tasks and processes
Develop and/or update data and reporting process documentation
Monitor, document and respond to ad-hoc and support requests and ensure the issue and resolution are accurate, complete and to the client’s satisfaction.
Conduct thorough testing and reconciliation practices on data and metrics
Support in the development of new data and reporting workflows with guidance from senior peers
Able to work with stakeholders to gather and document requirements for Data, Dashboard, and reporting needs.



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



To Join Our Team


You have experience with descriptive analytics tools and languages (MicroStrategy, Power BI, Excel, SQL, SAS, R, etc)
General knowledge of business operations tools (SalesForce, PolicyCentre, ClaimCentre, BillingCentre) is an asset.
You have a post-secondary education.
Strong communication, time management, problem solving and attention to detail skills.
General P&C knowledge, specifically for home/property insurance is an asset.
This position primarily works with majority non-francophone groups, and teams located outside of Québec, and requires proficiency in English. The essential non-French duties are not assignable to adjacent or other team members. 



What You Need To Know

Training and development opportunities to grow your career.

Manage and maintain pricing systems, tools, and pricing administration processes while ensuring effective deployment of corporate pricing strategies

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Access, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to interpret and communicate data-driven insights
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment


This position is based in our Niagara-on-the-Lake Corporate Office and follows a hybrid work model requiring in-office attendance two (2) days per week.
