Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.

Description:
Work Location Type: Hybrid

As a leading industrial distributor with operations primarily in North America, Japan and the United Kingdom, We Keep The World Working® by serving more than 4.5 million customers worldwide with products delivered through innovative technology and deep customer relationships. We’re dedicated to providing value for customers, fostering an engaging culture for team members and driving strong financial results.

Our welcoming workplace enables you to learn, grow and make a difference by keeping businesses running and their people safe. As a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company, we’re looking for passionate people to join our team as we continue leading the industry over our next 100 years.

Position Summary

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing contract and non‑contract pricing program strategies and supporting the execution and analysis of WFS overall pricing approach. Reporting to the Business Intelligence Manager, this role will conduct detailed pricing and financial analyses and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive profitable growth.

The role supports the implementation of pricing and discounting strategies by providing analysis, modeling, and insights that inform execution across the business.

The successful candidate brings a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and business economics and knows how to bring pricing strategies to life across multiple channels.

This position partners with business leaders to support and advance pricing strategies and plans through rigorous analysis, modeling, and insights that inform decision-making.

Job Responsibilities (You Will)


Pricing Strategy & Analysis
Develops contract and non-contract pricing strategies using customer, financial, and market data.
Evaluates competitive pricing activity and recommends responses based on quantified business impact.
Modeling & Advanced Analytics
Builds and maintains pricing, forecasting, and financial impact models.
Applies statistical and data modeling techniques to transactional data to inform pricing recommendations.
Execution & Enablement
Supports pricing execution through QRP price-point maintenance and post-implementation analysis.
Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure pricing decisions are operationalized effectively.
Insight & Communication
Synthesizes complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
Conducts post-implementation reviews and recommends continuous improvements.
Process & Governance
Contributes to the improvement of pricing tools, processes, and governance frameworks.

Education/Experience (You Have)


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
3–5 years of experience in pricing, analytics, or a data-focused analytical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL; experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights.
Experience with Snowflake and Power BI.
Experience with R or Python.
Exposure to pricing, commercial analytics, or revenue management.
Experience partnering with cross-functional business teams.


Rewards And Benefits

Our programs provide choice and flexibility to meet your individual needs. Check out some of the benefits available to you with Grainger (may vary based on hours worked):


Medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
Paid time off (PTO) and up to 12 company holidays per year (dependent on home province)
Life insurance coverage, including spousal and dependent life insurance.
Employee Family Assistance Program to help team members with physical, emotional, mental, financial and other concerns
Registered Retirement Savings Plan & Defined Contribution Pension Plan to help you save for your financial future
Educational & Professional Membership Fee Assistance program
Employee discounts, team member perks and more!

Title: Quality Improvement Decision Support Specialist
Description:
Together, we do amazing things every day.




Imagine a supportive employer, a career that fits your lifestyle, and many learning opportunities. With the Hamilton Family Health Team, you can have all of that, and more. We work hard to create an innovative and diverse workplace that values the contributions of our employees. No matter what your role, working with us is about making a difference – every day!




Your Opportunity:

The Quality Improvement Decision Support Specialist (QIDSS) is responsible for supporting primary care practices across the Hamilton Family Health Team (HFHT). Facilitates development and implementation of quality improvement plans/initiatives, and engaging teams in the use of data to support quality improvement goals and clinical process change.




Roles and Responsibilities:

• Collaborate closely with teams engaged in quality improvement to identify, performance measurement information and data quality needs,

• Support the development and implementation of quality improvement plans,

• Support decision making by developing, generating, analyzing and interpreting extracted health information,

• Ensure high quality data is available for extraction by developing and implementing systems to identify, tract, correct and prevent errors,

• Identify gaps in data availability, and define and implement solutions to close the gaps,

• Provide consultative and analytical support regarding the collection, interpretation, analysis and presentation of data to teams,

• Act as a change agent and coach to teams on data management and performance measurement,

• Provide guidance and support to teams regarding the collection, interpretation, analysis and presentation of data to improve patient care and align with best practice,

• Facilitates the development of effective working relationships with diverse teams,

• Take leadership roles in connecting teams and spreading best practices,

• Contribute actively to local and provincial quality improvement initiatives,




Qualifications and Skills:

• A university degree in a related discipline (E-Health /Health Informatics, Business Administration, Statistics, Health Sciences or Information Management), where possible combined with clinical experience in primary care or equivalent education and experience,

• Highly effective communication, presentation and interpersonal skills and a proven ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with partners, Working knowledge of adult education theory and methods,

• Experience creating a positive and inclusive learning environment,

• Understanding of the importance of vision and enthusiasm in creating and promoting change,

• Knowledge of primary care practice and demonstrated interest in the use of data for quality improvement,

• Ability to handle a variety of concurrent assignments and to work independently,

• Valid Ontario driver’s license,

• Strong applied knowledge of one or more EMR/HER systems currently in use in Ontario and willingness to become proficient in other systems,

• Demonstrates proficiency in programming in a language used to extract data from EMR (e.g. SQL) is required,

• Knowledge of additional report writing and statistical analysis packages (SSRS, SSIS, SSAS or Crystal Reports ) and a demonstrated ability to learn similar packages quickly will be considered an asset,




Why join the HFHT?

Competitive Employee Value Proposition including, but not limited to:

• Healthcare of Ontario Pension (HOOPP)

• Meaningful, purpose-based work

• 12 paid Stat holidays and one (1) extra float day

• Flexible work schedule

• Ongoing green initiatives

Primary Location: Hamilton; Hybrid work

Employee Class: Full-Time; 40hrs/week

Schedule: Monday-Friday; 8hrs/day

Salary: $74,600 - $85,226.50

This is a hands-on role for an analyst who is energized by turning product and customer data into insights that shape strategy — and who builds those insights on a foundation others can trust and reuse.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health

Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team
Conduct deep-dive analyses and design experiments to establish conversion baselines, measure business impact, and uncover the “why” behind performance trends
Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions

Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion

Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Those who are new to the role may join below the midpoint and develop their skills over time. Title: Software Developer L2 - Data and AI
Description:
Hammond Power Solutions Inc. is a global manufacturer headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada. HPS has grown to become the leader in North America in the custom design and manufacture of dry type transformers. For the past century, HPS has grown to deliver electrical power solutions to global markets and provides solutions for complex applications like, mining, rectifier, drives, traction, wind, solar and many other electrical power applications. The world relies on HPS to continually conceive and produce state-of-the-art transformer technology. We currently have an opening for a Software Developer, Data and AI– 12 month contract, come grow with us!

Reporting to the Manager, Software Development, this role designs, develops and maintains enterprise data solutions that support business operations and strategic decision-making, including data solution architecture, integration and transformation. The incumbent also contributes to AI project lifecycle activities --- data preparation, model implementation, deployment, and ongoing support --- while building scalable, cloud-ready software applications.

Working closely with business stakeholders across departments, this role gathers requirements, implements and delivers data and AI-driven solutions, and ensures effective knowledge transfer through user training and support.

Key Responsibilities Include


Design end-to-end data solutions (data models, data warehouse, data marts, semantic layers and OLAP cubes) to support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
Implement modernization and cloud migration for legacy warehouses and pipelines
Ensure data quality, lineage and observability across pipelines and models;
Design and deliver BI dashboards, self-service reports.
Document architecture, data flows and data definitions to support maintainability
Collaborate on AI/ML project design; translate business problems into data and modeling requirements.
Prepare datasets: cleaning, enrichment and feature engineering
Assist with model integration, deployment, monitoring and retraining procedures
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Efficiently leverage AI-powered coding assistants to develop and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Create and maintain efficient, scalable, and secure code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
Streamline business processes by creating seamless data flows.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to existing data systems and software applications.


Do you qualify? We are seeking:


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years’ professional experience in SQL and ETL design, with solid understanding dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval and analysis of large datasets.
Experience with AI/ML technologies including: LLM, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, AI Agents, Agentic AI, AI-powered coding, and MCP.
Prior experience in Azure Technologies such as Data Fabric, Synapse, ADFS, App Service, CI/CD pipeline and Power BI.
AI-powered programming experience with Python, C or C#.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for software development.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Title: MarTech Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:


Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist


What We Offer


Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network


Overview

The Data Activation Specialist will be responsible for utilizing digital platforms and transforming vast data sets into actionable insights that inform targeting and optimization; specifically,

connecting or extracting data, tracking, measuring, and analyzing and optimizing digital media for improved conversion and business performance. You will be part of a growing team, reporting to the Data Activation Manager and will have the opportunity to learn and grow in the emerging field of data strategy, data activation and data analysis.

Responsibilities


Ingest disparate digital data sources across Paid, Owned and Earned Digital Media into a consolidated environment for tracking
Learn how to set up automated process for data extraction, via API, SFTP, SQL etc.
Extract, transform and load data for ingestion into business intelligence platforms
Learn how to build dashboards in business intelligence platforms
Build and deploy semi-automated Excel and PowerPoint digital reporting solutions such as campaign performance tracking
Provide the Planning and Buying teams with analysis, insights and data-informed recommendations from the aforementioned reporting areas
Opportunity to work across key business intelligence platforms for digital media, mainly Datorama
Translate strategy into implementation tactics Data mapping and enhancement
Create segments relevant to objectives that can be pushed to relevant destinations for activation
Translate objectives into digital media measurement plans
Analyze and report on campaign performance through standardized ad-server attribution models
Learn how to build simplistic algorithmic attribution models and implement them
Work alongside data scientists to deploy more complex algorithmic attribution models
Make data-informed recommendations for optimizing digital media and content
Opportunity to work on key attribution platforms such as Google’s Data-Driven
Attribution model with DoubleClick, and proprietary Publicis Media platforms


Qualifications


3-4 years’ experience in Digital Media in Planning/Buying and/or 1 – 2 years Data Science experience
Technically competent and capable of working with and learning new digital and tech platforms
Strong numerical and analytical skills
Demonstrated ability to convert data analysis into meaningful action for brands
Experience with or strong knowledge of ad servers and web analytics platforms such as
DoubleClick, Adobe Media Optimizer, Sizmek, Google Analytics or Adobe Omniture
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to cope under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines autonomously.


Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $45 - 50k per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted

We are seeking a Data Management Analyst to work closely with our stakeholders to evaluate business requirements from a data requirement perspective. You will implement data integrations, develop data models and ensure BI reports are aligned with business objectives. You will build advanced SQL scripts and programs, ETL pipelines, reports and dashboards within various platforms such as Oracle databases, MS- Fabric, Power BI and different enterprise IT systems.




As The Newest Member Of Our Team, You’ll

Develop and implement BI solutions using different frameworks, technologies and best practices.
Create and manage datasets by writing scripts and programs using SQL, Python, excel and other reporting tools.
Develop business-focused reports and dashboards using Power BI, leveraging data models aligned with organizational objectives.
Design and Develop ETL processes and unit tests in a data warehouse environment.
Measure and ensure Data Quality improvements by identifying and resolving Data Quality issues.
Participate in data requirements analysis for new projects and enhancement requests and produce technical specification documentation.
Support the overall BI and data solutions delivery and on-going operations.
Effectively collaborate with team members and people from different departments with varying degrees of business and/or technical experience

A university degree or college diploma in related discipline or a combination of education, training and experience deemed equivalent.

Strong experience in analyzing varying levels of business needs and developing appropriate data models.
Proven ability to communicate effectively clearly with team members and be able to convey technical concepts into clear, simple language.
Excellent analytical thinking skills for translating data into informative visuals and reports.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Certifications in DP-600 Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or DP-700: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate are considered assets.

Title: Data Analyst, Product
Description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

We are looking for a Data Analyst, Product who will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights with strategic business decisions as Relay enters an exciting new chapter of growth. As we’ve grown, we need support from you in bridging the gap between data insights and strategic product or business decisions, influencing the direction and success of Relay. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that our product & business teams are empowered with deep, actionable insights, enabling us to make informed, data-driven decisions that resonate with our customers' needs.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborating with cross-functional teams by proactively proposing analytical solutions and data insights that drive improvement in key strategic pillars
Ensuring teams have the necessary data they need to function effectively by identifying and tracking core KPIs on top of building dashboards and reports
Performing in-depth analysis to drive fresh insights, and inform business recommendations by presenting trends to stakeholders
Monitoring and evaluating data quality to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data
Consistently delivering high-quality data models, easy-to-interpret visuals (such as charts, graphs and dashboards), and reports that demonstrate a strong understanding of business needs and objectives
Apply statistical methods to dissect and interpret data, aiding in the prediction and evaluation of new product features and market opportunities. This includes conducting A/B tests and measuring the impact of product changes on user behaviour
Synthesize information from diverse sources. Integrate and analyze data from user feedback, surveys, operational metrics, and event logs to connect insights directly to business outcomes
Regularly reporting outcomes and insights to stakeholders across Relay, including the senior leadership team, providing a clear narrative of the impact on business objectives, thereby influencing future data-driven decision-making


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in another data-focused role
You are fluent in SQL, including writing complex queries, working with window functions, optimizing performance, and understanding data warehousing concepts and security best practices. You're able to clearly explain your approach and reasoning, not just produce a working query

Description:
Job ID: 965

Position Type: Union Permanent

Department: Performance Analytics & Reporting

Salary Grade: 6 ($86,210 - $101,349)

Job Posting Close Date: 08/06/2026

The Ontario Energy Board is proud to be recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for four years running.

Our success resides with our people and we take great pride in fostering a workplace culture that attracts top-tier professionals passionate about shaping Ontario’s energy future. Our reputation as a preferred employer reflects our commitment to helping deliver clean, reliable, affordable and secure energy that enables economic growth across the province.

Our One OEB culture promotes a values-driven, collaborative workplace where diverse perspectives come together to deliver regulatory excellence, and where we encourage curiosity and agility in an environment that is grounded in mental health, wellbeing and a foundational commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

We are the ONTARIO ENERGY BOARD.

Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Performance Analytics and Reporting, the Analyst is responsible for supporting the OEB’s utility performance analysis and reporting activities. This includes working with other OEB groups to manage utility data submission processes and providing analytical insight to assist the Board in policy development and decision making. The Performance Analytics and Reporting department monitors financial and non-financial performance of Ontario’s electricity and natural gas distributors, as well as other regulated entities.

Responsibilities


Initiates and develops plans to achieve, and deliver data analytics based on financial accounting, customer and performance reported by utilities.
Identifies relevant issues and provides in-depth analysis associated with financial and non-financial data for regulated entities.
Provides analytics expertise to internal and external stakeholders regarding data gathered and insights into correlations & trends seen through utility reporting.
Working closely with other departments supports policy implementation through specialized reporting requirements and data analysis.
Conceptualizes and builds analytical models to improve reporting and industry analytics and presents information to both internal and external stakeholders.
Delivers on projects related to performance assessment (e.g., enhancement of utilities scorecard).
Collaboratively works with other team members on analytics best practices and utility operations.
Prepares and/or reviews monthly, quarterly, and annual statistical and project status reports/publications, ensuring information published is accurate and thorough.
Develops and/or enhances new and/or existing policies and procedures.


Qualifications


Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance; Economics; Data Science; Engineering or a related field.
An accounting, engineering or finance professional designation is highly preferred.
3+ years of relevant experience in the energy sector including performance assessment, industry insights, asset management or system planning.
2+ years’ experience translating large data sets into actionable information and valuable insights for decision making purposes.
Experience and knowledge of electric utility performance metrics, including key drivers and challenge.
2+ years’ experience in a utility or regulatory environment is preferred.
Previous working experience with data analytical solutions and tools such as Excel, SQL, VBA, Oracle BI, SAS, R, Tableau, Alteryx.
Knowledge of financial/management reporting.
Practical knowledge supporting projects with interdisciplinary teams, understanding stakeholder expectations, and managing own project timelines / deliverables.
Excellent oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of the Ontario Energy Board Act, 1998 and related regulatory policies is an asset.


This job posting represents an existing vacancy.

Title: BI Analyst, Poker Data & Insights
Description:
BI Analyst, Poker Data and Insights

Location: Toronto, 100% on site required

Salary: $60,000~80,000

Bonus: Maximum 50% per annum

Vacancies: 1 new




Company:

Join our creative and innovative team as we connect and entertain players all around the world, creating exciting experiences and lasting connections, on the world’s largest online poker network and biggest poker events!




Home of World Champion Daniel Negreanu, Winner of the Best Poker Software, and Guinness World Records holder of the largest ever online poker prize pool, GGPoker has taken the poker world by storm.




Headquartered in Toronto with offices in 9 major cities and 700 top international talents, NSUS is an industry-leading global company dedicated to shaping the future of gaming. GGPoker holds the largest online poker market share globally, and we are looking for dynamic, innovative, and passionate team members to be part of the World’s #1.




Join us and be part of the very best in the iGaming space!




Position:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our lean, fast-moving Business Intelligence team at GGPoker, the leading online poker platform in the world. You’ll work in a high-impact environment where data drives every decision.




This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, moves fast, and thrives at uncovering the story behind the numbers. You won't just build reports, you'll own them, evolve them, and proactively bring insights to the table before anyone has to ask. If you're the type of person who spots something off in a dataset and can't let it go until you understand why, we want to hear from you.




You will report directly to the Head of Business Intelligence.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Proactive Monitoring & Issue Detection: Stay ahead of the numbers. Identify trends, anomalies, and performance shifts before they become problems and bring clear, actionable findings to stakeholders
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build, own and maintain dynamic Tableau dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can understand instantly.
Player & Business Analysis: Analyze large, complex datasets to understand player behavior, product performance, and business trends, connecting quantitative patterns to real business impact
Data Design: Write and optimize SQL queries against our Snowflake data warehouse to extract critical information that meets evolving stakeholder needs
KPI Development: Lead and support the development and improvement of core business metrics including LTV, Churn, CAC, and regional performance indicators
Forecasting & Budgeting: Monitor and track performance against forecasting models, flagging deviations and contributing to planning cycles
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear, concise executive summaries that drive decisions, not just inform them
A/B Testing & Experimentation: Support the design and evaluation of experiments on product and promotional changes




Requirements - Soft Skills:




Fast learner who thrives under pressure. You pick things up quickly, adapt on the fly, and don't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed
Resourceful and self-directed. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it. You figure things out independently before escalating
Genuinely curious. You ask why, not just what. You dig into the data because you actually want to understand it, not just because someone asked you to
Strong ownership mentality. You treat your work like it's yours and don't wait to be told something needs fixing
Business and finance intuition. You understand what the numbers mean for the business, not just what they say on the surface
Clear, confident communicator. You can explain a complex finding to a non-technical executive in two sentences
Organized and detail-oriented. You QA your own work, catch your own errors, and don't ship something you're not confident in




Requirements - Technical Skills:




Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently
Experience with Tableau or other BI visualization tools (required)
Experience with Snowflake or equivalent cloud-based data warehouses (required)




Definitely Apply if You Have:




Experience in iGaming, fintech, or high-volume data environments (strong asset)
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment (asset)
Passion for poker, strategy games, or competitive gaming (asset)
Familiarity with KPI frameworks in a gaming or subscription or retention business
Experience supporting forecasting or budgeting cycles
Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks




Total Rewards:




Annual salary and level review
Max 50% bonus per annum
Paid vacation and sick time off
Flexible and comprehensive benefits
Commute coverage
Birthday Gift
GGPoker Swag
Preferred Gym rate
Endless snacks and beverages

As such, NSUS will make accommodations available to applicants with disabilities upon request during the recruitment process

To request an accommodation or ask about our process, contact us at hr@nsusgroup.com.

We are looking for a Data Science Expert to support the development of advanced data and analytics solutions within a highly regulated manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to transform complex process and operational data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

Location & Work Mode



Location: Toronto, ON
Work Mode: Hybrid
Seniority: Middle (4–6 years of experience)
Schedule: Flexibility to work with European time zones, including availability for an early shift (approximately 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM)



Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and maintain ready-to-use data and analytics systems.
Extract, organize, contextualize, and transform data from multiple source systems into business-ready formats.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT), Automation, Digital, Quality, and other functions to gather analytics requirements.
Map process parameters and manufacturing data to source systems such as MES, PI Historian, LIMS, iShift, and cloud-based data platforms.
Develop data contextualization pipelines within cloud-based AI and analytics environments.
Build and maintain data visualization solutions and dashboards to support operational and business needs.
Develop and support machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across multiple platforms.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and process monitoring.

4–6 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or related fields.
Strong experience working with manufacturing, process, or operational data.
Hands-on experience with:
Python
SQL (MS SQL Server)
Power BI
Snowflake
GitHub
Experience working with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems), and process data platforms.
Knowledge of data modeling, data pipelines, data contextualization, and analytics solution development.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


Nice-to-Have Qualifications



Experience with PI Historian and PI Vision.
Experience with JMP, SIMCA, and SIMCA-online.
Exposure to Machine Learning and AI platforms.
Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or other regulated industries.

We are looking for a Data Analyst, Product who will play a pivotal role in bridging data insights with strategic business decisions as Relay enters an exciting new chapter of growth. As we’ve grown, we need support from you in bridging the gap between data insights and strategic product or business decisions, influencing the direction and success of Relay. You'll be instrumental in ensuring that our product & business teams are empowered with deep, actionable insights, enabling us to make informed, data-driven decisions that resonate with our customers' needs.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborating with cross-functional teams by proactively proposing analytical solutions and data insights that drive improvement in key strategic pillars
Ensuring teams have the necessary data they need to function effectively by identifying and tracking core KPIs on top of building dashboards and reports
Performing in-depth analysis to drive fresh insights, and inform business recommendations by presenting trends to stakeholders
Monitoring and evaluating data quality to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data
Consistently delivering high-quality data models, easy-to-interpret visuals (such as charts, graphs and dashboards), and reports that demonstrate a strong understanding of business needs and objectives
Apply statistical methods to dissect and interpret data, aiding in the prediction and evaluation of new product features and market opportunities. This includes conducting A/B tests and measuring the impact of product changes on user behaviour
Synthesize information from diverse sources. Integrate and analyze data from user feedback, surveys, operational metrics, and event logs to connect insights directly to business outcomes
Regularly reporting outcomes and insights to stakeholders across Relay, including the senior leadership team, providing a clear narrative of the impact on business objectives, thereby influencing future data-driven decision-making


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in another data-focused role
You are fluent in SQL, including writing complex queries, working with window functions, optimizing performance, and understanding data warehousing concepts and security best practices. You're able to clearly explain your approach and reasoning, not just produce a working query
You have experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Sigma, Periscope, Mode, or similar platforms
You have a track record of using data to influence business decisions. You enjoy turning complex analyses into clear, actionable insights that drive meaningful outcomes.
You start with the business problem before jumping into the data, asking thoughtful questions to understand the context and objectives
You have experience working with large datasets, from exploration and analysis through to delivering insights. You're comfortable working independently while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across multiple teams
You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities, processes, and data infrastructure continue to evolve


Bonus Points


Experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP or Azure) and familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Bigquery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Familiarity with dbt for data modelling, automation, or experimentation
Experience with a data-oriented programming language (Python, R)
You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale


The Interview Process


Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent Team
Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Hiring Manager
Stage 3: A take-home case study, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call with members of our Data team.
Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our Leadership team


Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $99,000 CAD to $121,000 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $110,000 CAD. You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.

Description:
Charger logistics Inc. is a world- class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continue to grow.

We are seeking an individual with excellent communication and leadership skills to join the company. Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies.

We are looking for a data-driven Operations Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with industry knowledge to drive continuous improvement in our damage mitigation programs.

Responsibilities:

Support Sales, Operations, and Customer Service teams with competitive pricing, in-depth performance analysis, and data-driven insights
Perform costing analysis and develop multi-scenario pricing options to support customer negotiations
Assist in building and evaluating pricing strategies; analyze volume, profit potential, and market trends
Monitor customer performance across volume, revenue, and margin; identify gaps and inconsistencies
Respond to pricing inquiries and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from internal operational databases
Build custom reports and analytics dashboards using Tableau and other BI tools; present findings to leadership
Ensure accurate, clean reporting flows directly to leadership and upper management
Organize and maintain internal and external databases to support decision-making
Generate monthly and quarterly damage analysis reports and performance summaries for senior management
Conduct thorough investigations of equipment damage incidents — tractors, trailers, and cargo handling equipment
Analyze damage patterns and root causes; prepare detailed reports with photographic documentation and cost assessments
Review and process damage claims from initial report through full resolution
Coordinate with insurance carriers, repair vendors, and legal teams on complex claims
Negotiate settlements and manage vendor relationships for cost-effective repairs
Maintain accurate claims databases and tracking systems
Identify high-risk routes, facilities, and operational scenarios through trend analysis
Develop and maintain SOPs to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency
Create and implement driver training programs focused on damage prevention
Work with safety teams to establish best practices; conduct cost-benefit analyses for prevention initiatives
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or insurance industries is an asset.
Strong analytical skills is preferred.
Experience with claims management systems and processes.
Knowledge of commercial vehicle operations and equipment types.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in trucking, freight, or transportation industry.
Professional certifications in risk management or claims analysis.
Familiarity with DOT regulations and commercial vehicle safety standards.
Background in fleet management or equipment maintenance.



Benefits


Competitive Salary
Healthcare Benefit Package
Career Growth

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$147,900 - CA$221,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
  • Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
  • Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
  • Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
  • Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
  • Strong statistical knowledge
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$147,900 - CA$221,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range* for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.


Our salary bands are designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and to allow room for growth at Clio. For experienced individuals, we typically hire at or around the midpoint of the band. The top portion of the salary band is reserved for employees who demonstrate sustained high performance and impact at Clio. Those who are new to the role may join below the midpoint and develop their skills over time. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on geographical region, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. Title: BI Analyst, Poker Data & Insights
Description:
BI Analyst, Poker Data and Insights

Location: Toronto, 100% on site required

Salary: $60,000~80,000

Bonus: Maximum 50% per annum

Vacancies: 1 new




Company:

Join our creative and innovative team as we connect and entertain players all around the world, creating exciting experiences and lasting connections, on the world’s largest online poker network and biggest poker events!




Home of World Champion Daniel Negreanu, Winner of the Best Poker Software, and Guinness World Records holder of the largest ever online poker prize pool, GGPoker has taken the poker world by storm.




Headquartered in Toronto with offices in 9 major cities and 700 top international talents, NSUS is an industry-leading global company dedicated to shaping the future of gaming. GGPoker holds the largest online poker market share globally, and we are looking for dynamic, innovative, and passionate team members to be part of the World’s #1.




Join us and be part of the very best in the iGaming space!




Position:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our lean, fast-moving Business Intelligence team at GGPoker, the leading online poker platform in the world. You’ll work in a high-impact environment where data drives every decision.




This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, moves fast, and thrives at uncovering the story behind the numbers. You won't just build reports, you'll own them, evolve them, and proactively bring insights to the table before anyone has to ask. If you're the type of person who spots something off in a dataset and can't let it go until you understand why, we want to hear from you.




You will report directly to the Head of Business Intelligence.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Proactive Monitoring & Issue Detection: Stay ahead of the numbers. Identify trends, anomalies, and performance shifts before they become problems and bring clear, actionable findings to stakeholders
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build, own and maintain dynamic Tableau dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can understand instantly.
Player & Business Analysis: Analyze large, complex datasets to understand player behavior, product performance, and business trends, connecting quantitative patterns to real business impact
Data Design: Write and optimize SQL queries against our Snowflake data warehouse to extract critical information that meets evolving stakeholder needs
KPI Development: Lead and support the development and improvement of core business metrics including LTV, Churn, CAC, and regional performance indicators
Forecasting & Budgeting: Monitor and track performance against forecasting models, flagging deviations and contributing to planning cycles
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear, concise executive summaries that drive decisions, not just inform them
A/B Testing & Experimentation: Support the design and evaluation of experiments on product and promotional changes




Requirements - Soft Skills:




Fast learner who thrives under pressure. You pick things up quickly, adapt on the fly, and don't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed
Resourceful and self-directed. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it. You figure things out independently before escalating
Genuinely curious. You ask why, not just what. You dig into the data because you actually want to understand it, not just because someone asked you to
Strong ownership mentality. You treat your work like it's yours and don't wait to be told something needs fixing
Business and finance intuition. You understand what the numbers mean for the business, not just what they say on the surface
Clear, confident communicator. You can explain a complex finding to a non-technical executive in two sentences
Organized and detail-oriented. You QA your own work, catch your own errors, and don't ship something you're not confident in




Requirements - Technical Skills:




Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently
Experience with Tableau or other BI visualization tools (required)
Experience with Snowflake or equivalent cloud-based data warehouses (required)




Definitely Apply if You Have:




Experience in iGaming, fintech, or high-volume data environments (strong asset)
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment (asset)
Passion for poker, strategy games, or competitive gaming (asset)
Familiarity with KPI frameworks in a gaming or subscription or retention business
Experience supporting forecasting or budgeting cycles
Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks




Total Rewards:




Annual salary and level review
Max 50% bonus per annum
Paid vacation and sick time off
Flexible and comprehensive benefits
Commute coverage
Birthday Gift
GGPoker Swag
Preferred Gym rate
Endless snacks and beverages

  • Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently

Title: Data Scientist, Analytics (Remote, Canada)
Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI's products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:


Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
Own data quality of ZestyAI data products
Spearhead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and owning dashboards and KPIs
Develop automated ETL and data workflows
Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with


What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:


BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
Proficient in SQL
Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:


1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics
Familiarity with, or an interest in, experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical methods
DBT Experience
Prefect (or another workflow tool like Airflow) Experience
Data Visualization Experience


Why ZestyAI:


Be part of a well-funded growth-stage company
Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future
Comprehensive health care plan
Flexible Time Off
An upbeat and collaborative work culture
Company-sponsored outings and offsites

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe.
